Discover your 100% YOU with Beepo!

  • Position: AU Tile Estimator
  • Location: Clark, Pampanga

What's in it for you?

  • Competitive Total Rewards (Compensation, Allowance, HMO, and Paid Time Off)
  • Employee Referral Program
  • Work Life Balance﻿

Your Role
As an AU Tile Estimator, you are responsible for:

  • Review drawings, specifications, and project requirements.
  • Prepare Bills of Quantities (BOQ) and Bills of Materials (BOM).
  • Measure and estimate quantities for floor and wall tiling, waterproofing, screeding, and related works.
  • Prepare material lists for tiles, adhesives, grout, trims, and other tiling products.
  • Request and review supplier and subcontractor quotations.
  • Submit RFIs when additional project information is required.
  • Ensure all project requirements are included in estimates.
  • Prepare and compile tender pricing and supporting documentation.
  • Identify any discrepancies or missing information in project documents.
  • Present estimates to management for review and approval.
  • Submit tenders within required deadlines.
  • Maintain pricing records and estimating databases.
  • Communicate with clients, suppliers, subcontractors, and internal teams throughout the estimating process.

Qualifications:

  • 1-2 years of estimating experience in the Australian or local construction, tiling, flooring, or fit-out industry
  • Experience preparing quantity take-offs and cost estimates for tiling projects.
  • Experience preparing Bills of Quantities (BOQ) and Bills of Materials (BOM).
  • Understanding of tile installation, waterproofing, screeding, and floor preparation works.
  • Ability to accurately calculate material, labour, and project costs.
  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and specifications.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
  • Positive attitude, strong work ethic, and willingness to learn.
  • Able to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Experience working with Australian builders or commercial contractors is an advantage.

﻿﻿About Beepo
Beepo is a Probe Group company, a full-service Australian-owned outsourcing company, with a team of 15,000 across 6 countries — the largest, and most diverse Australian-owned customer experience outsourcing provider.

Our Beepo office is located in Clark, Pampanga. We provide exceptional workforce support to clients all over the world. Our primary focus is to help businesses grow sustainably with the help of fantastic Philippine talent.

You will be supported by a great working environment, leading benefits, and an opportunity to meet your career goals. You will be able to apply your skills and innovative thinking to this role. This is an opportunity to grow your career quickly.

*Terms and conditions apply

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and commercially minded Product Director to lead the evolution of our audience, media, and advertising platform capabilities. This leader will define and deliver product strategy across audience solutions, programmatic advertising, and the integration of owned media into a unified commercial experience.

The role will turn audience insights, media assets, and performance data into differentiated products that are easy to sell, plan, activate, measure, and optimize. It is an opportunity to shape a foundational growth platform at the intersection of product, data, advertising technology, and commercial transformation.

What You Will Own

Audience Strategy & Product Development

Define and execute the vision, product strategy, and roadmap for audience capabilities.

Build differentiated products using first-party, behavioral, contextual, geographic, and advertiser-permissioned data.

Create packaging, activation, pricing, measurement, and reporting frameworks.

Advance segmentation, enrichment, identity, insights, and responsible data use.

Owned Media Integration & Unified Workflows

Integrate owned media inventory and audience signals into planning, selling, delivery, and reporting workflows.

Define the target experience across planning, order management, inventory, campaign delivery, optimization, and measurement.

Connect advertising, commercial, data, and reporting capabilities through clear platform boundaries.

Simplify fragmented workflows and reduce manual handoffs.

Programmatic Monetization

Own the strategy for direct and automated media offerings across multiple buying models.

Improve yield and inventory utilization while protecting customer value and premium experiences.

Advance forecasting, pricing, packaging, decisioning, and campaign optimization.

Use performance data and market insights to prioritize investment and validate product-market fit.

Commercialization & Leadership

Build business cases, launch plans, adoption strategies, and success measures.

Lead across Sales, Client Success, Marketing, Data, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Privacy.

Guide roadmap, investment, dependency, and trade-off decisions with senior stakeholders.

Develop product talent and influence matrixed teams across the organization.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of product management experience in digital advertising, advertising technology, media platforms, data products, or related fields.

5+ years leading complex platform products, major integrations, or multi-team transformation initiatives.

Strong understanding of programmatic advertising, digital media monetization, audience products, campaign workflows, and advertising operations.

Experience translating customer and commercial problems into platform strategy, roadmaps, product requirements, and measurable outcomes.

Strong analytical and commercial judgment, executive communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Technical & Domain Expertise

Deep working knowledge of Google Ad Manager or a comparable enterprise ad server, including orders, line items, targeting, pacing, creative trafficking, and reporting integrations.

Experience with advertising order-to-cash ecosystems, including booking, pricing, fulfillment, billing, and revenue-recognition processes to connect with ad-serving and reporting platforms.

Understanding modern cloud data platforms and warehouses, such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or Databricks, including audience tables, identity graphs, data marts, and scalable reporting layers.

Expertise in audience and identity architecture, including first-party identity resolution, consumer graphs, segment taxonomies, known and anonymous audiences, and deterministic and probabilistic matching.

Experience defining API and integration patterns, including REST or GraphQL, event-driven contracts, system-of-record boundaries, and data synchronization across commercial, advertising, and reporting systems.

Strong understanding of media monetization and yield concepts, including CPM pricing, rate cards, floor strategies, margin structures, premium and remnant inventory, and cross-channel revenue attribution.

Knowledge of cross-channel audience activation from owned environments into social, video, and demand-side advertising platforms.

Knowledge of data-modeling and SQL, including dimensional models for campaign, impression, audience, and revenue data; sold-versus-delivered reconciliation; complex joins; window functions; and performance optimization on large datasets.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience launching audience-based solutions and enabling commercial teams to bring new capabilities to the market.

Experience integrating advertising, customer-management, order-management, reporting, or revenue platforms.

Familiarity with AI-assisted media planning, campaign optimization, and decision-support products.

Experience integrating customer relationship management and commercial workflow platforms, including campaign planning, quote-to-cash, and opportunity-to-order processes in a media sales environment. Experience with Salesforce or an equivalent platform is beneficial.

Experience with business intelligence and reporting platforms that surface campaign, audience, and revenue insights to commercial teams and customers. Familiarity with tools such as Looker, Tableau, or comparable reporting solutions is beneficial.

Understanding of creative fulfillment workflows, including how creative assets are requested, produced, approved, and routed into advertising delivery systems. Experience with commercial creative workflow platforms is beneficial.

Working knowledge of Python or a similar language for prototyping, data validation, analysis, and workflow automation.

MBA or equivalent experience leading product strategy and commercial transformation.

The annualized base salary for this role will range between $160000 and $180000. Variable incentive compensation, including commissions, is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, education level, location, and union representation, if applicable

Job Title: Sr. Clinical Project Manager, IQVIA Biotech

Job Location: Overland Park, Kansas, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

IQVIA Biotech is seeking a Sr. Clinical Project Manager with experience in the following therapeutics: Cardiovascular, Renal, and Metabolic.

IQVIA Biotech is a full-service CRO purpose-built to serve biotech sponsors. With over 25 years of experience, we offer agile, therapeutically aligned solutions and trusted partnerships that help bring breakthrough treatments to patients faster.

Overview
The Senior Clinical Project Manager is a key leader in the delivery of clinical trials, partnering with cross-functional teams and clients to accelerate the development of life-changing therapies. This role is responsible for end-to-end clinical study execution, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget, while maintaining the highest standards of quality and compliance. The Senior Clinical Project Manager provides strategic oversight, operational leadership, and serves as the primary point of contact for sponsors.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of medium to large, multi-regional clinical studies in alignment with contractual requirements, SOPs, and regulatory standards.
  • Develop and implement integrated study management plans, ensuring consistency in processes, tools, and training.
  • Serve as the primary liaison with sponsors, building strong client relationships and ensuring transparent communication on project status, risks, and deliverables.
  • Set direction and objectives for cross-functional project teams; monitor performance and drive accountability to meet milestones.
  • Partner with Business Development on bid defenses and contribute to winning new business, including leading presentations when applicable.
  • Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate risks; lead issue resolution and implement corrective and preventative action plans.
  • Collaborate with internal functional groups to support study execution and overcome operational challenges.
  • Monitor project progress against timelines, budget, and quality metrics; provide regular updates to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure financial performance by managing budgets, forecasting revenue, and identifying opportunities to accelerate delivery.
  • Manage scope changes and oversee change control processes in collaboration with stakeholders.
  • Promote continuous improvement by sharing lessons learned and best practices.
  • Mentor and support the development of junior team members and contribute feedback on team performance.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Requires greater than 7 years of clinical research experience, including at least 4 years of project management experience, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, global clinical trials and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, timelines, and risk proactively.
  • Experience leading bid defenses and client engagements is preferred.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

IQVIA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable law.

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

The potential base pay range for this role, when annualized, is $93,100.00 - $232,800.00. The actual base pay offered may vary based on a number of factors including job-related qualifications such as knowledge, skills, education, and experience; location; and/or schedule (full or part-time). Dependent on the position offered, incentive plans, bonuses, and/or other forms of compensation may be offered, in addition to a range of health and welfare and/or other benefits.

Job Description: Video Knowledge Engineer

Are you passionate about Computer Vision, Gen AI, and ready to dive into a thrilling project that blends cutting-edge technology with the vibrant world of entertainment?
Were seeking a skilled Computer Vision Knowledge Engineer to participate in building an AI platform that revolutionizes how we create, curate, and deliver short-form content. You'll work alongside product, engineering, AI, and machine learning experts to build real-world AI systems that shape the future of entertainment.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of Gen AI, machine learning, and software engineering, with a passion for building innovative AI products.

Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate with internal teams and vendors to identify and implement optimal metadata and video knowledge extraction solutions for the AI platform, enabling effective creation, curation, and delivery of short-form content.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to evaluate, utilize, and enhance computer vision tools and libraries, ensuring robust video content analysis and metadata extraction.
  • Work closely with the team, partners and vendors to design and implement computer vision algorithms that extract actionable insights and high-quality metadata from video content.
  • Partner with DevOps and engineering teams to integrate computer vision models and metadata extraction solutions into scalable, containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Engage with data scientists, machine learning engineers, DevOps, and vendors to deliver cohesive, scalable solutions for video knowledge extraction and metadata optimization.

Qualifications/Requirements:

  • Proficiency in Python.
  • Solid experience with development and deployment tools, including containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and workflow orchestration (Temporal or similar).
  • Familiarity with video analysis tools and libraries such as OpenCV, FFmpeg, or similar.
  • Experience in computer vision algorithms, preferably with broad familiarity and use of existing tools and libraries (e.g., OpenCV, PySceneDetect) for building CV applications.
  • Expertise in multiple areas listed below:
  • Object and people detection (must)
  • Facial recognition (must)
  • Image and video segmentation
  • Activity recognition
  • Video summarization
  • Video identification
  • Video behavior analysis

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Practical knowledge of artificial neural networks for computer vision, especially in Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs).
  • Exposure to deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
  • Expertise in any additional CV areas listed below:
  • Edge detection
  • Style detection
  • Gesture recognition
  • Video tracking
  • Object co-segmentation

Position: Senior Director, Digital Forensics & Incident Response
Location: Remote, US
Work Authorization: US Citizenship Required

BlueVoyant is seeking a Senior Director, DFIR to lead high-impact cyber investigations and act as incident commander during complex, high-pressure security incidents.

This is a client-facing leadership role responsible for guiding organizations through critical moments—from initial response through investigation, containment, and recovery—while advising executives, legal counsel, and technical teams.

What You’ll Do:

  • Act as incident commander for complex DFIR engagements end-to-end
  • Serve as the primary client lead, advising executives, legal counsel, insurers, and stakeholders
  • Lead investigations across ransomware, BEC, cloud/identity compromise, insider threat, and advanced attacks
  • Direct forensic analysis across endpoints, cloud, identity, SaaS, email, and network environments
  • Translate technical findings into clear business risk and remediation guidance
  • Lead executive briefings, client updates, and post-incident reviews
  • Manage multiple concurrent incidents in fast-paced, high-pressure environments
  • Mentor and develop DFIR consultants and technical teams
  • Support incident readiness, tabletop exercises, and client growth initiative.
What You'll Bring:
  • 3–5 years of hands-on DFIR experience in real-world incidents
  • 6–10 years in client-facing consulting, incident response, or cyber advisory roles
  • Proven experience as an incident commander or senior DFIR lead
  • Strong background in ransomware, cloud/identity compromise, and complex attack investigations
  • Experience working directly with executives, legal counsel, insurers, and technical teams
  • Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, workstreams, and timelines under pressure
  • Leadership experience mentoring or managing technical teams
Technical Expertise:
  • Strong knowledge across endpoint, cloud, identity, SaaS, and network forensics
  • Experience with tools such as EnCase, FTK, Magnet AXIOM, Velociraptor, Splunk, Sentinel, CrowdStrike (or similar)
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Azure, AWS, Okta, Google Workspace
  • Understanding of attacker tradecraft, including persistence, lateral movement, and data exfiltration
  • Working knowledge of KQL, SPL, SQL, PowerShell, Python, or Bash
Leadership & Communication:
  • Exceptional communication skills—able to translate technical issues into business impact
  • Strong judgment in high-stress, ambiguous environments
  • Composed, credible, and client-focused under pressure
  • Collaborative leader with a focus on quality, mentorship, and outcomes
Nice to Have:
  • Experience working with breach counsel, insurers, or regulators
  • Incident readiness, tabletop, or IR planning experience
  • Certifications such as CISSP, GCFA, GCIH, GCFE, GNFA, OSCP
Education:

Bachelor’s degree preferred (Cybersecurity, Computer Science, DFIR, or related), or equivalent professional experience.

Why BlueVoyant?

  • Work alongside experienced DFIR leaders and experts, including former government cyber professionals and industry veterans.
  • Lead high-impact, global cyber investigations, supporting clients through critical, business-defining incidents
  • ​​​​Gain exposure to complex environments, executive stakeholders, and advanced threat scenarios across industries
  • Join a global, mission-driven cybersecurity company defending organisations worldwide with cutting-edge data, technology, and expertise
  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package, with support for wellbeing, development, and career growth

About BlueVoyant
BlueVoyant is an AI-driven cybersecurity company dedicated to standing between our customers and cyber threats. By combining human, artificial, and proprietary intelligence, we deliver a unified solution that protects every organization’s network, identities, vendors, and digital footprints as a single attack surface. The company’s award-winning Microsoft Security expertise helps organizations maximize their security investments while reducing risk and ensuring compliance.

Led by CEO, John Hernandez, BlueVoyant’s highly skilled team includes former government cyber officials with extensive frontline experience in responding to advanced cyber threats on behalf of the National Security Agency, Federal Bureau of Investigation, Unit 8200, and GCHQ, together with private sector experts. BlueVoyant services utilize large real-time datasets with industry leading analytics and technologies.

Founded in 2017 by Fortune 500 executives, including Chairman of the Board, Jim Rosenthal, Vice Chairman, Tom Glocer, and former Government cyber officials, BlueVoyant is headquartered in New York City and has offices in Maryland, Tel Aviv, San Francisco, London, Budapest, and Latin America and is committed to building a workplace where talented people are empowered to do their best work in the fight against global cyber threats..

All employees must be authorized to work in the United States of America. BlueVoyant provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, BlueVoyant complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities.

Disclaimer: Please note that pursuant to contractual requirements and applicable law, for employees to perform work on some of the company’s federal contracts, U.S. citizenship is required. Accordingly, an employee’s ability to perform work on such contracts is contingent upon the company’s verification of the employee’s citizenship status.

raw.description:
Technical Woodworks and Metalworks Draftsman

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our client is seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Technical Draftsman (Woodworks & Metalworks) to develop accurate technical drawings, 3D models, and production-ready documentation for custom wood and metal fabrication projects.

The role involves translating design concepts, sketches, and engineering specifications into detailed fabrication drawings for projects such as kitchens, closets, built-in cabinetry, custom furniture, pergolas, shading structures, roof frameworks, gates, doors, and other bespoke fabrication works.

The successful candidate will collaborate closely with designers, architects, engineers, project managers, and production teams to ensure all drawings meet project specifications, fabrication requirements, quality standards, and deadlines.

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Our client is a design studio specializing in technical design and production drawings for custom wood and metal fabrication.

Their work focuses on bridging the gap between concept and manufacturing by translating ideas, sketches, and specifications into accurate 3D models and clear technical documentation ready for real-world production.

They work closely with carpenters, metal workshops, architects, and designers to ensure every drawing is optimized for fabrication processes, materials, and assembly requirements.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Prepare detailed technical drawings, plans, schematics, and 3D models for custom wood and metal fabrication projects.
  • Translate sketches, design concepts, engineering data, and project specifications into accurate and production-ready technical drawings.
  • Develop shop drawings, cutting lists, joinery details, exploded views, and fabrication details for woodworking and cabinetry projects.
  • Produce detailed fabrication drawings for metalwork projects, including pergolas, shading structures, roof frameworks, gates, doors, and steel structures.
  • Incorporate technical details such as dimensions, materials, joints, screws, bolts, hinges, and assembly requirements.
  • Apply CNC machining and modeling techniques where required for woodworking and production.
  • Review, update, and revise drawings to reflect design changes, project developments, and actual site conditions.
  • Coordinate with designers, architects, engineers, project managers, carpenters, and metal fabrication teams to ensure alignment with project requirements.
  • Ensure all technical drawings are accurate, complete, and compliant with project specifications, fabrication standards, and quality requirements.
  • Provide technical support and clarification to production teams throughout the fabrication and installation process.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Proven hands-on experience in technical drafting, woodworking, carpentry, cabinetry, or metal fabrication.
  • Strong understanding of wood and metal materials, fabrication methods, and manufacturing processes.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and execute technical drawings, sketches, and engineering specifications.
  • Proficiency in relevant technical design and CAD software, such as:
    • SolidWorks
    • Inventor
    • Cabinet Vision
    • TopSolid
  • Experience producing accurate, detailed, and production-ready 2D and 3D technical drawings.
  • Hands-on experience with CNC machining and modeling, particularly for woodworking projects.
  • Experience in kitchens, closets, built-ins, doors, custom furniture, steel structures, or other bespoke fabrication projects.
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and technical documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and meet project deadlines.
  • Professionalism, accountability, and effective communication skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with Rhino for 3D modeling and technical design.
  • Experience with Grasshopper for design automation.
  • Knowledge of both woodworking and metal fabrication processes.
  • Experience in complex fabrication projects and on-site installation.
  • Background in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, Woodwork Furniture Design, or a related field.
  • Practical carpentry or metalworking experience.

REQUIREMENTS

Interested candidates are invited to submit their updated CV/resume and portfolio showcasing relevant technical drafting and fabrication projects.

Portfolio should ideally include:

  • Detailed 2D and 3D technical drawings labeled with the software used.
  • Woodworking projects such as kitchens, closets, cabinetry, doors, and custom furniture.
  • Metal fabrication projects such as pergolas, roof structures, gates, doors, and steel frameworks.
  • Technical fabrication details, including dimensions, joints, screws, bolts, hinges, and assembly specifications.
  • Examples of CNC modeling and production-ready shop drawings.

SHOREXTRA PERKS

  • ﻿Day 1 HMO Coverage
  • Equipment provided
  • 15 annual paid leaves
  • Referral Incentives – Get rewarded for bringing top talent to the team via our referral program.
  • Statutory Benefits: Maternity, Paternity, and Solo Parent Leaves, Magna Carta for Women, OT, and Premium Pays

WORK SET-UP

  • Remote
  • Mid-Shift, Friday and Saturday Off
  • Full-Time

raw.description:
About HostGPO:
HostGPO is the leading group purchasing organization for the short-term rental and hospitality industry. We help operators save money, move faster, and simplify the way they furnish and operate properties.

Our members include boutique hotels, vacation rental operators, corporate housing providers, outdoor hospitality brands, real estate developers, and large-scale hospitality groups across North America. Through our collective buying power and vendor partnerships, they get access to better pricing, stronger procurement options, and a more efficient way to buy what they need.

We are growing quickly and building the procurement backbone for the next era of hospitality.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a systems-minded marketer who enjoys building the infrastructure that powers growth. This person will own and optimize our HubSpot instance, build scalable workflows, ensure clean and reliable data, and turn analytics into actionable insights that improve acquisition, retention, and revenue.

We're also looking for someone who is genuinely excited about AI-powered operations — not just using AI tools, but building agentic systems that automate and scale marketing workflows. Experience with Claude Cowork (Anthropic's desktop automation tool) is a strong signal that you know how to put AI to work in a real operational context.

Beyond execution, we're looking for someone who can proactively identify opportunities within our funnel and recommend improvements that drive measurable impact.

What You'll Be Doing

HubSpot & Marketing Automation

  • Build and optimize workflows across lifecycle stages.
  • Manage segmentation, automation, and campaign execution inside HubSpot.
  • Maintain clean properties, consistent data structure, and scalable CRM processes.
  • Help launch and track campaigns effectively.

AI-Powered Operations & Agentic Systems

  • Design and deploy agentic workflows that automate repetitive marketing tasks — from lead enrichment to reporting — using tools like Claude Cowork.
  • Identify processes across marketing ops that can be handed off to AI agents, and own the implementation end-to-end.
  • Stay current on the agentic AI landscape and bring forward tools and techniques that give the team leverage.

Analytics & Performance Optimization

  • Own marketing dashboards and reporting across HubSpot and Google Analytics (GA4).
  • Ensure accurate tracking, event setup, attribution, and UTM structure.
  • Identify bottlenecks and optimization opportunities across the marketing funnel and propose data-backed solutions.
  • Translate data into clear recommendations to improve ROI and customer lifetime value.
  • Test and measure experiments that improve conversion and retention.

Growth & Paid Media Support

  • Support campaigns in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
  • Ensure proper tracking, pixel implementation, and CRM integration.
  • Manage performance reporting and analysis.

Project & Process Management

  • Organize marketing initiatives, timelines, and task tracking.
  • Build documentation and SOPs for marketing systems and reporting.
  • Improve cross-functional workflows to create clarity and accountability.

What You'll Bring

  • 2–5 years of experience in marketing operations, growth marketing, or CRM management.
  • Strong hands-on experience with HubSpot (workflows, lists, reporting, automation).
  • Hands-on experience with Claude Cowork or comparable AI desktop/automation tools — you've used agentic AI in a real work context, not just experimented with it.
  • Experience designing or building agentic systems — multi-step AI workflows that operate autonomously to complete marketing or operational tasks.
  • Working knowledge of Google Analytics (GA4), attribution, and conversion tracking.
  • Experience with Meta and Google Ads platforms.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to turn data into action.
  • High attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to operate independently while collaborating across teams.

  • Kehitystyö onnistuujoustavasti ja saat myös itse päättää, mistä päin Suomea työsi teet.

  • Meillä on oma, kehittyvä integraatioalusta Frends - tuotekehitystiimi on vieressä ja vastaa kun kysyt.

  • Olemme vakaa, järkevästi kasvava ja moderni integraatiotalo - pääset kehittymään turvallisessa ympäristössä.

  • Laajasta asiakaskunnastamme löydät kansallisesti ja kansainvälisesti tunnettuja yrityksiä eri toimialoilta, jotka johtavat mielenkiintoisiin ja mielekkäisiin projekteihin ja erilaisiin tekniikoihin(mm. Aalto Yliopisto, Lähitaksi, St1).

"Integraatiopuolella rajapinnat ja teknologiat kehittyvät ja muuttuvat jatkuvasti, eli meillä saa koko ajan tutkia ja oppia uutta. Täällä näkee myös hyvin mielenkiintoisesta näkökulmasta oman integraatioalustamme kehittymistä.” -Jura, Integration Developer.

➡️ Tutustu lisää blogeistamme Integraatiokehittäjän työhön ja kenelle työ sopii.

🏆 Tarjoamme

  • kilpailukykyisen palkan riippuen kokemuksestasi 44-69K

  • mahdollisuuden kehittää ja laajentaa osaamistasi mielenkiintoisten ja merkityksellisten projektien parissa

  • oman, kehittyvän integraatioalustan Frendsin, joka on saanut tunnustusta kansainvälisessä Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ -tutkimuksessa

  • joustavat työajat ja lokaation, etänäkin hommat hoituu

  • työnantajan joka tukee erilaisissa elämäntilanteissa

  • tukea antavan esihenkilön ja oman tiimin

  • turvallisen ja vakaan työpaikan

  • kattavat työsuhde-edut (mm. laaja työterveyshuolto ja sairaskuluvakuutus, koulutusmahdollisuuksia, sertejä, lounasetu, virikesetelit, kulttuuri- ja liikuntakerho, kuntosali, hieronta)

💻 Teknologiat

Erikoisuutenamme on oma integraatioalustamme Frends, jota käytämme useimmiten projekteissamme. Frends on täysin suomalainen low-code, hybridi-integraatioalusta. Tuotteen tuoreimmassa inkarnaatiossa käytetään moderneja teknologioita ja pilvipalveluita. Frends on pohjautuu C#:iin ja pyörii Azuren päällä.

➡️ Lue, millaista Frendsillä on tehdä kehitystyötäblogistamme ja katso myös lyhyt demo-video. Voit myös tutustua Frendsiin lisää tuotteemme dokumentaatio-sivuilta.

Töissämme pääset tutustumaan myös Azuren eri teknologioihin kuten Machine Learning ja Data Factory. Taikasanoja töissämme ovat REST, JSON, XML, XSLT ja SQL. Tuntemus API-arkkitehtuureista, API Managementista, GraphQL:stä ja LINQ:sta ovat asioita, joita arvostamme - ja joita pääset oppimaan.

🧐 Frendszone

Lyhyesti kuvattuna, olemme IT-konsulttitalo ja palvelemme hyvin monenlaisia asiakkaita laidasta laitaan niin yksityisellä kuin julkisella sektorilla ja useilla eri toimialoilla.

Frendsissä on noin 250 asiantuntijaa, joista reilu 170 toimii omissa pienkonsulttitiimeissämme. Tiimeissä on kehittäjiä, arkkitehtejä, palvelupäälliköitä ja projektipäälliköitä. Osa kehittäjistä on keskittynyt täysin kehitystyöhön, osa tekee tämän lisäksi esimerkiksi määrittelyä, kouluttamista tai myynnin tukea. Kuuntelemme tekijöitämme ja pyrimme muokkaamaan roolia ja urapolkua jokaiselle mieluisaksi.

➡️FAQ-blogissa vastaamme yleisimpiin kysymyksiin, joita keskusteluissa on herännyt. Arjestamme voit myös lukea lisää täältä. Arvoista ja kulttuuristamme kerromme lisää täällä. Panostamme myös paljon perehdytykseen ja tuemme sinua. Tutustu myös blogiimme miksi talentit valitsevat Frendsin ja miksi meillä viihdytään.

⭐ Miltä kuulostaa?

Jos mielenkiintosi on herännyt, toivomme, että kohtaamme! Voit olla meihin näppärästi ja nopeasti yhteydessä ilman CV:tä ja tarkennellaan yhdessä lisää. Jätä yhteystietosi meille hakulinkin kautta (esim. LinkedIn-profiilin avulla), niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä.

Kaipaatko lisätietoja ja haluat jutella lisää? Olethan yhteydessä suoraan Jesseen, .

Rekrytointiprosessimme on nopea, avoin ja informatiivinen. Voit lukea prosessistamme lisää blogistamme. Aloitus on sovittavissa joustavasti tilanteesi mukaan ja työnteko onnistuu ympäri Suomea. Roolissa vaaditaan sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.

Mitä maailmamme olisi ilman integraatioita? 🌎

  • Sähkömittarit luettaisiin käsin.

  • Tavaratilaukset hoidettaisiin yhä puhelimella.

  • Laivat eivät pääsisi satamiin ilman ennakolta lähetettyjä tulli-ilmoituksia.

  • Vanhat järjestelmät vanhenisivat ennen aikojaan, jos niiden päälle ei integraatiokeinoin pystyttäisi rakentamaan moderneja käyttöliittymiä.

  • Raha ei liikkuisi. Ihmiset jonottaisivat pankkikonttoreissa maksamassa laskuja ja nostamassa rahaa.

raw.excerpt: Bei egg schaffen wir Erlebnisse.  Echte Erlebnisse.
raw.description:
Bei egg schaffen wir Erlebnisse. Echte Erlebnisse.

Die Art von Erlebnissen, die Kreativität, kluges Denken, Liebe zum Detail und hin und wieder auch eine gute Portion Humor erfordern, wenn sich fünf Minuten vor dem Go-live plötzlich alles ändert.

Wir arbeiten über Ländergrenzen, Kulturen und Kunden hinweg. Deshalb geht es bei uns oft schnell, und kein Tag gleicht dem anderen. Genau das mögen wir. Es bedeutet aber auch, dass wir Menschen brauchen, die auch unter Druck einen kühlen Kopf bewahren, mehrere Bälle gleichzeitig in der Luft behalten können, Verantwortung übernehmen und Wert auf Kundenzufriedenheit legen.

Keine großen Egos. Keine Fehler verstecken. Keine stillen Hühner in diesem Nest.

Und jetzt zu dir

Du bleibst ruhig, wenn es chaotisch wird, denkst klar, wenn sich Prioritäten verschieben, und übernimmst Verantwortung, ohne dass alles bis ins letzte Detail vorgegeben sein muss (denn das ist es selten). Du legst Wert auf Ergebnisse, Qualität und kontinuierliche Verbesserung. Du liebst Prozesse. Außerdem bist du neugierig auf intelligentere Arbeitsweisen – einschließlich KI, Automatisierung und moderner Tools, die Arbeit einfacher und wirkungsvoller machen.

Und vor allem: Du bringst Dinge zu Ende. Richtig. Keine halbgaren Eier.

Deine Aufgaben

In dieser Rolle arbeitest du zu 100 % für einen unserer wichtigsten Pharmakunden.

  • Du leitest die End-to-End-Umsetzung mehrerer groß angelegter und hochkomplexer Projekte und stellst deren erfolgreiche Durchführung vom Briefing bis zum Abschluss sicher.

  • Du fungierst als zentrale Ansprechperson auf Senior-Level für unsere Kunden, baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf und berätst zu Projektstrategie, Umsetzung und Best Practices.

  • Du steuerst die Zusammenarbeit zwischen internen Teams, Lieferanten und Stakeholdern und stellst gleichzeitig die Einhaltung von Kundenstandards, Tools, Prozessen und regulatorischen Anforderungen im Gesundheitsbereich sicher.

  • Du verantwortest die Projektsteuerung inklusive Zeitplänen, Budgets, Risikomanagement, Ressourcenplanung und Reporting.

  • Du erkennst Herausforderungen frühzeitig, steuerst Eskalationen und behältst auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen sowie bei kurzfristigen Änderungen den Überblick.

  • Du unterstützt und entwickelst Teammitglieder weiter und trägst aktiv zum Wissensaustausch sowie zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung im Unternehmen bei.

Das bringst du mit

(Und wir meinen das wirklich ernst: Kandidat:innen, die die folgenden Kriterien nicht erfüllen, können leider nicht berücksichtigt werden.)

Erfahrung & Fähigkeiten

  • 8–10+ Jahre Erfahrung im Event-Projektmanagement, mit umfangreicher Erfahrung mit Kunden aus der Pharma- und/oder Gesundheitsbranche, insbesondere HCP events.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse der regulatorischen Anforderungen und Compliance-Vorgaben im Gesundheitswesen in Deutschland und international.

  • Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Steuerung komplexer internationaler Projekte, zahlreicher Stakeholder und bedeutender Veranstaltungsbudgets.

  • Nachweisliche Fähigkeit, als vertrauenswürdige:r Berater:in aufzutreten und Senior-Stakeholder auf Kundenseite zu beeinflussen.

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Cvent

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

So arbeiten wir bei egg

Menschen, die bei egg erfolgreich sind, zeichnen sich in der Regel dadurch aus, dass sie:

  • Verantwortung übernehmen und Dinge voranbringen

  • Resilient sind

  • Ruhe bewahren, wenn sich Prioritäten ändern

  • Sich auf Ergebnisse und Qualität konzentrieren

  • Mit Unklarheit und Veränderung umgehen können

  • Nach intelligenteren Arbeitsweisen suchen – inklusive KI und Technologie

  • Kreativität mit Struktur und Umsetzungsstärke verbinden

Bonuspunkte gibt's, wenn du außerdem ...

  • Bereits Projektteams geführt oder Mitarbeitende gecoacht bzw. entwickelt hast.

  • Ein gutes kommerzielles Verständnis sowie Erfahrung im Finanz- und Budgetmanagement mitbringst.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Flexible Arbeitsmodelle (je nach Standort remote oder hybrid)

  • Attraktives Gehalt plus leistungsabhängigen Bonus

  • Homeoffice-/Technologie-Zuschuss und eine Pluxee Benefits Karte

  • Smarte, hilfsbereite Kolleg:innen, die wirklich gerne zusammenarbeiten

  • Internationale Karrieremöglichkeiten und ein globales Offsite-Event an großartigen Orten

  • Dort wo wir Büros haben, kostenlosen Kaffee, haustierfreundliche Büros und eine Unternehmenskultur, die sich genauso um Menschen wie um Leistung kümmert

(Ja, der Kaffee ist wirklich gut. Wir sind schließlich keine Monster.)

Der Bewerbungsprozess

  • Online-Bewerbung

    (Du hast nach rechts gewischt.)

  • Erstes Kennenlerngespräch

    (Wir haben auch nach rechts gewischt – schauen wir, ob die Chemie stimmt.)

  • Erstes Interview

    (Wir mögen dich! Jetzt wird es Zeit, ein wenig tiefer einzusteigen.)

  • Zweites Interview

    (Okay, wir mögen dich wirklich sehr. Lust, die Familie kennenzulernen? Keine Sorge, die meisten Eier benehmen sich ganz ordentlich.)

  • Angebot

    (Wir sind verliebt. Hoffentlich du auch.)

Der wichtigste Teil

Bei egggeht Feedback in alle Richtungen: nach oben, nach unten und zur Seite. Wir glauben daran, dass Verantwortung und Freundlichkeit perfekt zusammenpassen.

Fehler sind hier erlaubt – solange wir dazu stehen, daraus lernen und sie nicht wiederholen.

Wir sind stolz auf ein Team aus Menschen mit unterschiedlichsten Lebenswegen, Hintergründen und Perspektiven. Wir sind überzeugt, dass genau das unsere Arbeit besser, unser Denken schärfer und unsere Ergebnisse stärker macht.

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen aller Geschlechter, einschließlich trans- und nicht-binärer Personen, sowie von Menschen aus BIPOC-Communities, LGBTQ2S+-Communities und von Menschen mit sichtbaren oder nicht sichtbaren Behinderungen.

Außerdem sind wir ein ESG-orientiertes Unternehmen und setzen uns dafür ein, positive Auswirkungen zu erzielen – weit über die Grenzen unseres eigenen Unternehmens hinaus.tive impact beyond our own walls.

raw.title: Sales Manager (m/w/d) für SIMON [Bangkok/Remote] – Neukundengewinnung B2B SaaS
raw.excerpt: (This job is only available in german) Worum es gehtSIMON ist die Außendienst-Plattform für alle, die beim Kunden vor Ort arbeiten.
raw.description:
(This job is only available in german)

Worum es geht

SIMON ist die Außendienst-Plattform für alle, die beim Kunden vor Ort arbeiten. Das reicht von der Pharmareferentin in der Apotheke über den Merchandiser im Lebensmittelmarkt bis zum Techniker im Heizungskeller. SIMON setzt auf die vorhandenen ERP- und CRM-Systeme auf und ist technisch in vier bis sechs Wochen startklar. Seit über zehn Jahren arbeiten anspruchsvolle Außendienstteams im Pharmabereich damit.

Jetzt bringen wir SIMON zu weiteren mittelständischen Herstellern, vor allem im Handel und FMCG sowie im technischen Kundendienst. Dafür suchen wir dich: jemanden, der die richtigen Leute findet, anspricht und vom ersten Kontakt bis zum produktiven Einsatz begleitet.

Wie wir verkaufen

Wir verkaufen SIMON so, wie man einen neuen Kollegen einstellt. Zuerst kommt das Kennenlernen: Der Interessent probiert einen Prototyp für seine Branche selbst aus. Darauf folgt das Vorstellungsgespräch, eine Demo mit einem Klickdummy in seinen eigenen Begriffen. Danach kommt die Probearbeit, ein Pilot mit fünf bis zehn Nutzern und vorab vereinbarten Erfolgskriterien. Erst dann folgt die Festanstellung, also Vertrag und Rollout. Nach drei Monaten gibt es ein Mitarbeitergespräch mit echten Zahlen.

Wir versprechen dabei nichts, was nicht stimmt. In jeder Demo sagen wir klar, was Standard ist, was konfiguriert und was entwickelt werden muss.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du identifizierst passende mittelständische Hersteller mit eigenem Außendienst und findest dort die richtigen Ansprechpartner, vor allem über LinkedIn und den Sales Navigator.
  • Du sprichst Vertriebs- und Serviceleitungen persönlich an, über LinkedIn und am Telefon, und gewinnst sie für ein erstes Gespräch.
  • Du baust dein LinkedIn-Profil zu einer erkennbaren fachlichen Stimme für Außendienstthemen aus.
  • Du qualifizierst eingehende Anfragen von der Website und aus unseren Branchenprototypen.
  • Du führst Demos und stimmst dafür kundenspezifische Prototypen mit unserem Produktteam ab.
  • Du begleitest Interessenten durch ihre Entscheidung und bindest dabei Fachbereich, IT, Geschäftsführung, Datenschutz und Betriebsrat ein.
  • Du verhandelst Pilotprojekte und Verträge.
  • Du bleibst nach dem Vertrag Ansprechpartner für deine Kunden, gemeinsam mit unserem Beratungsteam, und entwickelst die Zusammenarbeit weiter.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Software oder erklärungsbedürftigen Lösungen für den Mittelstand.
  • Du hast nachweislich selbst Kunden gewonnen. LinkedIn-Direktansprache und Telefonakquise sind für dich Handwerk.
  • Du schreibst Nachrichten, die nach Mensch klingen, und führst am Telefon ein Gespräch statt eines Skripts.
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Entscheidungen über mehrere Monate und mehrere Beteiligte, zum Beispiel mit IT-Abteilungen und Betriebsräten.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau. Englisch ist ein Plus.
  • Ein großer Vorteil wäre eigene Erfahrung im Außendienst, im Handel oder im technischen Service.

Was du bekommst

  • Gehalt mit Erfolgsbeteiligung: Gute Leistung zahlt sich bei uns aus, auch jenseits der Führungsebene. Wir vergüten nicht nur Abschlüsse, sondern auch qualifizierte Demo-Termine und Erweiterungen bei Bestandskunden.
  • Werkzeuge, die verkaufen helfen: Prototypen, die Interessenten selbst ausprobieren, ein Produktteam, das kundenspezifische Klickdummys in wenigen Tagen baut, LinkedIn Sales Navigator und Zeit für den Aufbau deines Profils.
  • Karriere und Weiterbildung: DMG Academy, Mentoring und Zugriff auf Lernplattformen zu KI, Kundenportalen und mehr.
  • Agiles Arbeiten: Feedback, Mitgestaltung und Verantwortung statt Micromanagement. Du hast kurze Wege zu Geschäftsführung, Produkt und Beratung und echten Einfluss darauf, wie wir in neue Branchen gehen.
  • Arbeitsmodelle nach Maß: Vollzeit, Teilzeit oder remote, mit nur zwei Stunden Kernzeit.
  • Weltweit arbeiten: Du willst von Thailand, Bali oder einem Coworking-Space in Hamburg aus arbeiten? Go for it.
  • Zusatzleistungen: Krankenversicherung, private Rente, Top-Equipment und Zuschüsse.

raw.description:
ALDI is one of the fastest-growing retailers in the nation, and we are charting an aggressive growth course with plans to add 800 new stores by 2028, increasing to nearly 3,200 locations nationwide. You can play a vital part by joining our Legal team. Our Legal team is key to our strategic direction and the management of a wide range of legal matters impacting the business. As a member of this team, you'll support ALDI in achieving our company initiatives and upholding our core values.

Position Type: Full-Time
Starting Salary: $233,000
Salary Increases: Year 2 - $245,750 | Year 3 - $258,750
Work Location: This is a remote opportunity.
Duties and Responsibilities:
Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Provides input to their direct leader concerning personnel hiring.
    • Identifies legal issues and recommends responsive action, with an emphasis on risk mitigation in California.
    • Engages with executive leadership, various business units, and external parties involved in the legal process.
    • Partners and liaises with outside counsel on legal matters and manages relevant external consultants.
    • Collaborates closely with cross-functional teams to integrate California legal considerations into business operations and initiatives.
    • Evaluates and analyzes legal issues in multiple jurisdictions, particularly California, and nationwide and reports findings, as well as recommendations, to direct leader.
    • Advises on any changes or actions to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the team.
    • Informs management of recurring issues or when additional team training may be required.
    • Provides strategic counsel to assigned business units on a wide range of California legal issues without significant oversight to minimize risk and potential legal liability.
    • Works strategically to provide expert legal advice to key business functions in multiple jurisdictions, including California, to drive strategy and operational goals.
    • Provides expert legal advice on special projects to drive company strategy and operational goals.
    • Researches, monitors, and assesses emergent legal trends, new legal issues and laws, legislation, regulations, and court decisions; identifies and communicates impactful updates to relevant business units with an emphasis on California state and local jurisdictions.
    • Monitors the evolution of the changing legal landscape in the United States, including California state and local jurisdictions, and incorporates new laws and regulations into policies, procedures, and initiatives as applicable.
    • Drafts legal memorandums, case assessments, reports, attorney correspondence, and other work product to identify exposures and risk.
    • Performs pre-litigation work to minimize risks and potential legal liability.
    • Manages outside counsel with respect to complex legal matters.
    • Partners in the development of and/or review of operating policies, practices, procedures, agreements, and training to ensure ongoing compliance, consistency, and risk mitigation.
    • Manages complex legal negotiations with key stakeholders while collaborating with cross-functional business teams.
    • Manages strategies for reducing costs and transferring risk.
    • Provides proactive analysis of current projects and analytical review of reported results.
    • Leads strategic planning related to their area of subject matter expertise in order to support tactical business growth.
    • Communicates complex information and legal concepts to a broad range of clients, from front-line staff to executive management.
    • Supports Corporate Counsels in providing the business with accurate and timely advice and counseling on a wide variety of legal matters.
    • Reviews work performed by Corporate Counsels and suggests substantive improvements.
    • Provides guidance and mentors team members in best practices.
    • Assists in training and developing team members to retain a motivated and professional workforce.
    • Collaborates with team members and communicates relevant information to leadership.
    • Complies with ALDI privacy and security requirements and policies if job responsibilities include possible access to confidential and/or sensitive information.
    • Other duties as assigned.

Job-specific Competencies:
Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • Consistently demonstrates the Mindsets, ALDI Acts Competencies and Professional Skills (M.A.P.) as outlined for the role.
    • Gives attention to detail and follows instruction.
    • Prepares written materials to meet purpose and audience.
    • Develops and maintains positive relationships with internal and external parties.
    • Works cooperatively and collaboratively within a group.
    • Understands the history, strategy, organizational authority, interdependence of job duties, products, systems, and services of the company.
    • Demonstrated skills in the areas of time management, interpersonal skills, relationship building, collaboration, presentation, and problem solving.
    • Excellent verbal and written communication and customer service skills, including the ability to professionally communicate with a wide variety of individuals and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
    • Ability to work independently and within a team environment.
    • Proficient in legal analysis, drafting, research, and presentation skills.
    • Knowledge of relevant United States employment law, labor law regulatory law, California employment, labor, and regulatory requirements, and ability to assist in defending the company against various types of litigation.
    • Knowledge of how legal issues, particularly those in California state and local jurisdictions, affect organizations and the ability to develop strategies to coordinate legal considerations to business objectives.
    • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.
    • Ability to analyze and present complex data.
    • Ability to anticipate legal risks as well as utilize excellent judgment and analytical skills.
    • Ability to interpret and apply company policies and procedures.
    • Ability to multi-task and independently prioritize and work under strict deadlines.
    • Knowledge of retail industry standards and practices.
    • Negotiation skills.
    • Ability to apply creative solutions.
    • Proficient in assessing data to determine accuracy and completeness

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's Degree required.
    • A minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in a legal environment required, preferably in a combination of law firm and corporate or in-house experience.
    • Experience in a law firm, corporate legal department or in-house legal counsel required.
    • J.D. from an ABA accredited law school required.
    • Licensed to practice in California, or immediate ability to become licensed in California, required.
    • Experience in employment law, labor law, regulatory law, litigation, and California legal matters required.
    • Or, a combination of education and experience providing equivalent knowledge.

Physical Requirements:

  • Work may be performed in an office, remote office, or a combination of both where a computer and office equipment may be used as needed to perform duties.
    • Regularly required to sit, reach, grasp, stand and move from one area to another.
    • Constantly and repeatedly use keyboard/mouse.
    • Occasionally required to push, pull, bend, lift and move up to 25 lbs.

Travel:

  • Domestic travel required.
    • Up to 10%.

raw.description:
On behalf of UKRI we are looking for anIdentity & Collaboration Architect(Inside IR35) for an initial 4 month contract. Remote working with occasional office travel.

The Identity & Collaboration Architect will lead the architecture and design of a large-scale Microsoft 365 consolidation programme involving the migration of multiple Microsoft 365 tenancies, mail domains and identity platforms into a single strategic environment.

The role is accountable for developing the future-state architecture for identity, authentication, directory services, email namespace, collaboration services and associated governance models. The architect will work across technical, operational and business stakeholders to establish a coherent, sustainable target operating model that balances organisational requirements with Microsoft's strategic cloud architecture.

A key aspect of the role is the development of target-state identity and namespace strategies, including the transition from multiple independentlymanaged directories and Microsoft 365 tenancies to a consolidated identity platform centred on Microsoft Entra ID.

As an Identity & Collaboration Architect your main responsibilities will be to:

  • Develop target-state identity architecture for a multi-organisational Microsoft 365 environment.
  • Define authoritative sources for identity information and attribute ownership.
  • Establish identity lifecycle architecture covering joiners, movers and leavers.
  • Define future-state email namespace strategy.
  • Develop mail domain architecture covering multiple existing SMTP domains.
  • Analyse impacts of domain consolidation, retention and rationalisation.
  • Support definition of future-state architecture for Microsoft 365 services and ancillary solutions
  • Support tenant consolidation strategy and migration planning.
  • Design core platform services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online and OneDrive.
  • Develop architectural principles and standards.
  • Establish decision frameworks for identity and namespace management.
  • Lead discovery activities across multiple organisations.
  • Analyse current-state identity, directory and messaging environments.
  • Engage senior stakeholders across IT, security, HR and business functions.
  • Facilitate workshops to define identity, namespace and governance requirements.

Essential:

  • Demonstrable experience in designing and delivering Identity Architecture within complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong understanding of directory services, domain architecture and identity lifecycle management.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID, including authentication, conditional access, identity governance and privileged identity management.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing Microsoft 365 architectures.
  • Experience developing target-state architectures, migration strategies and transition roadmaps across multiple organisations or business units.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to facilitate workshops and present architectural recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience defining governance frameworks, operating models and architectural standards.

Desirable:

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure and/or AWS cloud platforms.
  • Experience working within hybrid or legacy technology environments.
  • Experience within the Public Sector or similarly regulated environments.
  • Familiarity with security, compliance and identity governance requirements in complex organisations.

Please be aware that this role can only be worked within the UK and not Overseas.

Disability Confident

The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to leadLedgerline, an AI-native accounting roll-up. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Ledgerlineacquires and partners with accounting practices across the US and Canada, rebuilding each one to run AI-native. For every firm, Ledgerline embeds a small technical team that learns the close, tax, and advisory workflows end to end, then builds a fleet of AI agents around what the firm already does well. With AI, a firm can deliver accounting faster, cheaper, and more accurately to small businesses that have always treated clean books as a luxury. The people stay. Agents take the routine work, and staff move into advisory and client work where accountability and judgment matter most. Every agent built compounds into a reusable platform across a growing network of firms.

Market Context

There are roughly 10,000 US and Canadian firms in Ledgerline's target band, and the profession is aging out faster than it can replace itself: 57% of multi-owner US firms have no written succession plan, 44% of solo practitioners expect to retire within five years, and new CPA exam candidates dropped from 42,626 to 28,082 in a single year. The model is already proven.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across fintech and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight’s cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the direction of the venture and lead its execution.

  • Strategy: Define the target firm profile, deal thesis, and value creation playbook

  • Deal Sourcing: Build the funnel from the ground up, identifying practice owners and running outreach through to signed deals

  • Deal Structuring: Lead valuation and terms across both paths, full acquisitions and equity partnerships, including navigating CPA ownership rules

  • Transformation: Partner with the embedded FutureSight team to take each firm AI-native and document the capacity and margin gains

  • Capital: Lead the seed raise and deal financing, supported by FutureSight's network

  • Team: Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

DecisionPoint seeks a Senior Database Administrator to provide enterprise-wide leadership of database operations supporting a major federal and DoD-aligned mission environment. This role oversees secure hosting of IL5-compliant database platforms, ensuring optimal performance, schema governance, RMF control alignment, and full integration with the SDLC, DevSecOps, and application development teams.

The Senior DBA is responsible for database engineering, performance tuning, replication, failover strategies, backup and recovery, and vulnerability remediation while leading a technical team of database administrators. This role ensures the reliability, resilience, and security of mission-critical data systems across multiple environments.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Provide senior-level leadership over database operations, engineering, and administration in IL5 cloud and on-premise environments.
  • Oversee schema governance, indexing strategies, data modeling, and optimization for performance and scalability.
  • Ensure database platforms comply with DoD security requirements, RMF controls, STIG baselines, and audit readiness.
  • Lead performance tuning efforts, query optimization, and troubleshooting of complex database issues.
  • Manage backup, recovery, replication, clustering, and failover strategies to support high availability.
  • Coordinate with DevSecOps engineers on database integration within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Support secure SDLC processes, including database change control and release planning.
  • Manage database access controls, permissions, service accounts, and privileged user oversight.
  • Oversee vulnerability scanning, patch planning, and remediation for database technologies.
  • Collaborate with application developers to align database design with business logic, data workflows, and mission requirements.
  • Maintain database documentation, ER diagrams, configuration baselines, and operational runbooks.
  • Lead and mentor a team of DBAs, ensuring adherence to best practices, consistent processes, and high operational readiness.
  • Provide technical input to modernization initiatives, cloud migration strategies, and new platform evaluations.

Qualifications

Clearance Requirement

Must hold an active Top Secret clearance, supported by a Tier 5 background investigation.

Education (Required)

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Experience (Required)

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in database administration, engineering, or architecture roles.
  • Demonstrated leadership in managing enterprise-class database systems in secure federal or DoD environments.
  • Experience implementing IL5 database security controls, RMF requirements, and STIG compliance.
  • Experience supporting SDLC integration, release cycles, and DevSecOps workflows.
  • Experience with performance tuning, complex queries, indexing, and database optimization.
  • Experience managing replication, clustering, failover, and backup/recovery operations.

Technical Knowledge (Required)

  • Strong expertise with relational database systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL).
  • Proficiency in database security, encryption, auditing, and privileged access management.
  • Knowledge of RMF, STIGs, IL5 cloud security controls, and DoD cybersecurity requirements.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automation tools, and DevSecOps concepts.
  • Experience with database monitoring tools, log analysis, and performance analytics.

Certifications

Required:

  • CompTIA Security+

Skills

  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to manage and mentor technical teams.
  • Excellent analytical and problem solving abilities, especially for complex data and performance issues.
  • Clear communication skills for working with developers, security teams, and federal stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail with disciplined documentation and configuration management practices.
  • Ability to manage priorities across multiple environments in a mission-critical setting.

The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Closeline, an AI-native mortgage origination venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Closeline is building the AI-native infrastructure for mortgage origination, purpose-built for brokers and mid-market IMBs. The agent owns the full loan file lifecycle: reading documents, checking them against investor and agency guidelines, and routing each loan through to a decision, acting rather than waiting on a human, and earning more autonomy as trust builds loan by loan. Customer discovery validates a real, recurring cost problem in this segment: lenders spend thousands of dollars to originate a single loan today, a cost that's climbed roughly 35% over the past three years, with up to 80% of that time spent on manual document review.

The US mortgage market processes roughly 6.5 million loans a year across close to 5,000 lending institutions, an estimated $3.25B in addressable software spend at Closeline's pricing. Brokers and mid-market IMBs alone originate about 5.3 million loans a year, representing a $2.65B segment, our initial target market. At target pricing, firms see an estimated 8 to 10x return on what they're currently paying to originate a loan.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across fintech and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight’s cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning

  • Customer Development — Lead pilots with underwriters, processors, and operations leads, convert them to paid engagements, and build the go-to-market motion

  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback

  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction

  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

  • Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement

  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

  • Direct exposure to mortgage origination and lending operations

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

raw.description:
Technical Woodworks and Metalworks Draftsman

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our client is seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Technical Draftsman (Woodworks & Metalworks) to develop accurate technical drawings, 3D models, and production-ready documentation for custom wood and metal fabrication projects.

The role involves translating design concepts, sketches, and engineering specifications into detailed fabrication drawings for projects such as kitchens, closets, built-in cabinetry, custom furniture, pergolas, shading structures, roof frameworks, gates, doors, and other bespoke fabrication works.

The successful candidate will collaborate closely with designers, architects, engineers, project managers, and production teams to ensure all drawings meet project specifications, fabrication requirements, quality standards, and deadlines.

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Our client is a design studio specializing in technical design and production drawings for custom wood and metal fabrication.

Their work focuses on bridging the gap between concept and manufacturing by translating ideas, sketches, and specifications into accurate 3D models and clear technical documentation ready for real-world production.

They work closely with carpenters, metal workshops, architects, and designers to ensure every drawing is optimized for fabrication processes, materials, and assembly requirements.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Prepare detailed technical drawings, plans, schematics, and 3D models for custom wood and metal fabrication projects.
  • Translate sketches, design concepts, engineering data, and project specifications into accurate and production-ready technical drawings.
  • Develop shop drawings, cutting lists, joinery details, exploded views, and fabrication details for woodworking and cabinetry projects.
  • Produce detailed fabrication drawings for metalwork projects, including pergolas, shading structures, roof frameworks, gates, doors, and steel structures.
  • Incorporate technical details such as dimensions, materials, joints, screws, bolts, hinges, and assembly requirements.
  • Apply CNC machining and modeling techniques where required for woodworking and production.
  • Review, update, and revise drawings to reflect design changes, project developments, and actual site conditions.
  • Coordinate with designers, architects, engineers, project managers, carpenters, and metal fabrication teams to ensure alignment with project requirements.
  • Ensure all technical drawings are accurate, complete, and compliant with project specifications, fabrication standards, and quality requirements.
  • Provide technical support and clarification to production teams throughout the fabrication and installation process.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Proven hands-on experience in technical drafting, woodworking, carpentry, cabinetry, or metal fabrication.
  • Strong understanding of wood and metal materials, fabrication methods, and manufacturing processes.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and execute technical drawings, sketches, and engineering specifications.
  • Proficiency in relevant technical design and CAD software, such as:
    • SolidWorks
    • Inventor
    • Cabinet Vision
    • TopSolid
  • Experience producing accurate, detailed, and production-ready 2D and 3D technical drawings.
  • Hands-on experience with CNC machining and modeling, particularly for woodworking projects.
  • Experience in kitchens, closets, built-ins, doors, custom furniture, steel structures, or other bespoke fabrication projects.
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and technical documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and meet project deadlines.
  • Professionalism, accountability, and effective communication skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with Rhino for 3D modeling and technical design.
  • Experience with Grasshopper for design automation.
  • Knowledge of both woodworking and metal fabrication processes.
  • Experience in complex fabrication projects and on-site installation.
  • Background in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, Woodwork Furniture Design, or a related field.
  • Practical carpentry or metalworking experience.

REQUIREMENTS

Interested candidates are invited to submit their updated CV/resume and portfolio showcasing relevant technical drafting and fabrication projects.

Portfolio should ideally include:

  • Detailed 2D and 3D technical drawings labeled with the software used.
  • Woodworking projects such as kitchens, closets, cabinetry, doors, and custom furniture.
  • Metal fabrication projects such as pergolas, roof structures, gates, doors, and steel frameworks.
  • Technical fabrication details, including dimensions, joints, screws, bolts, hinges, and assembly specifications.
  • Examples of CNC modeling and production-ready shop drawings.

SHOREXTRA PERKS

  • ﻿Day 1 HMO Coverage
  • Equipment provided
  • 15 annual paid leaves
  • Referral Incentives – Get rewarded for bringing top talent to the team via our referral program.
  • Statutory Benefits: Maternity, Paternity, and Solo Parent Leaves, Magna Carta for Women, OT, and Premium Pays

WORK SET-UP

  • Remote
  • Mid-Shift, Friday and Saturday Off
  • Full-Time
