raw.description:
About HostGPO:
HostGPO is the leading group purchasing organization for the short-term rental and hospitality industry. We help operators save money, move faster, and simplify the way they furnish and operate properties.

Our members include boutique hotels, vacation rental operators, corporate housing providers, outdoor hospitality brands, real estate developers, and large-scale hospitality groups across North America. Through our collective buying power and vendor partnerships, they get access to better pricing, stronger procurement options, and a more efficient way to buy what they need.

We are growing quickly and building the procurement backbone for the next era of hospitality.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a systems-minded marketer who enjoys building the infrastructure that powers growth. This person will own and optimize our HubSpot instance, build scalable workflows, ensure clean and reliable data, and turn analytics into actionable insights that improve acquisition, retention, and revenue.

We're also looking for someone who is genuinely excited about AI-powered operations — not just using AI tools, but building agentic systems that automate and scale marketing workflows. Experience with Claude Cowork (Anthropic's desktop automation tool) is a strong signal that you know how to put AI to work in a real operational context.

Beyond execution, we're looking for someone who can proactively identify opportunities within our funnel and recommend improvements that drive measurable impact.

What You'll Be Doing

HubSpot & Marketing Automation

  • Build and optimize workflows across lifecycle stages.
  • Manage segmentation, automation, and campaign execution inside HubSpot.
  • Maintain clean properties, consistent data structure, and scalable CRM processes.
  • Help launch and track campaigns effectively.

AI-Powered Operations & Agentic Systems

  • Design and deploy agentic workflows that automate repetitive marketing tasks — from lead enrichment to reporting — using tools like Claude Cowork.
  • Identify processes across marketing ops that can be handed off to AI agents, and own the implementation end-to-end.
  • Stay current on the agentic AI landscape and bring forward tools and techniques that give the team leverage.

Analytics & Performance Optimization

  • Own marketing dashboards and reporting across HubSpot and Google Analytics (GA4).
  • Ensure accurate tracking, event setup, attribution, and UTM structure.
  • Identify bottlenecks and optimization opportunities across the marketing funnel and propose data-backed solutions.
  • Translate data into clear recommendations to improve ROI and customer lifetime value.
  • Test and measure experiments that improve conversion and retention.

Growth & Paid Media Support

  • Support campaigns in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
  • Ensure proper tracking, pixel implementation, and CRM integration.
  • Manage performance reporting and analysis.

Project & Process Management

  • Organize marketing initiatives, timelines, and task tracking.
  • Build documentation and SOPs for marketing systems and reporting.
  • Improve cross-functional workflows to create clarity and accountability.

What You'll Bring

  • 2–5 years of experience in marketing operations, growth marketing, or CRM management.
  • Strong hands-on experience with HubSpot (workflows, lists, reporting, automation).
  • Hands-on experience with Claude Cowork or comparable AI desktop/automation tools — you've used agentic AI in a real work context, not just experimented with it.
  • Experience designing or building agentic systems — multi-step AI workflows that operate autonomously to complete marketing or operational tasks.
  • Working knowledge of Google Analytics (GA4), attribution, and conversion tracking.
  • Experience with Meta and Google Ads platforms.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to turn data into action.
  • High attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to operate independently while collaborating across teams.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working with Shopify (integrations, ecommerce tracking, reporting).
  • HubSpot certifications.
  • Startup experience.
  • Vacation rental or ecommerce industry experience.
  • Experience with tools like Slack, Notion, and modern project management platforms.
  • Built or contributed to internal AI tooling or prompt libraries for marketing use cases.
  • Based in Los Angeles.

Compensation

  • $70–$100k OTE (annual salary + performance bonus incentives) dependent on experience.
  • Equity options commensurate with role.

Perks & Benefits

  • Health Insurance
  • 401(k) with matching
  • Flexible PTO
  • Paid educational opportunities
  • Fast career progression in a rapidly growing startup
  • Collaborative and high-ownership environment
  • Free HostGPO Membership 🙂

You'll be joining a fast-growing startup where your work directly impacts revenue and member experience. This opportunity is about more than salary — it's about building meaningful systems at a company transforming the short-term rental industry. Belief in our mission is a must. We are creating a community, outside of rental platforms, for short-term rental operators — a club by hosts, for hosts.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and celebrate our employees' differences.

Tule sukeltamaan integraatioiden ja APIen pariin ja pyörittämään maailmaa kanssamme 🌍

  • Teemme työtä, jolla on aito merkitys- ilman integraatioita maailma ei pyörisi.

  • Töitä tehdään omissaFrends-tiimeissä- opit tuntemaan kollegasi, tiimihenki on vahva ja saat tekniset asiantuntijat ympärillesi.

  • Kehitystyö onnistuujoustavasti ja saat myös itse päättää, mistä päin Suomea työsi teet.

  • Meillä on oma, kehittyvä integraatioalusta Frends - tuotekehitystiimi on vieressä ja vastaa kun kysyt.

  • Olemme vakaa, järkevästi kasvava ja moderni integraatiotalo - pääset kehittymään turvallisessa ympäristössä.

  • Laajasta asiakaskunnastamme löydät kansallisesti ja kansainvälisesti tunnettuja yrityksiä eri toimialoilta, jotka johtavat mielenkiintoisiin ja mielekkäisiin projekteihin ja erilaisiin tekniikoihin(mm. Aalto Yliopisto, Lähitaksi, St1).

"Integraatiopuolella rajapinnat ja teknologiat kehittyvät ja muuttuvat jatkuvasti, eli meillä saa koko ajan tutkia ja oppia uutta. Täällä näkee myös hyvin mielenkiintoisesta näkökulmasta oman integraatioalustamme kehittymistä.” -Jura, Integration Developer.

➡️ Tutustu lisää blogeistamme Integraatiokehittäjän työhön ja kenelle työ sopii.

🏆 Tarjoamme

  • kilpailukykyisen palkan riippuen kokemuksestasi 44-69K

  • mahdollisuuden kehittää ja laajentaa osaamistasi mielenkiintoisten ja merkityksellisten projektien parissa

  • oman, kehittyvän integraatioalustan Frendsin, joka on saanut tunnustusta kansainvälisessä Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ -tutkimuksessa

  • joustavat työajat ja lokaation, etänäkin hommat hoituu

  • työnantajan joka tukee erilaisissa elämäntilanteissa

  • tukea antavan esihenkilön ja oman tiimin

  • turvallisen ja vakaan työpaikan

  • kattavat työsuhde-edut (mm. laaja työterveyshuolto ja sairaskuluvakuutus, koulutusmahdollisuuksia, sertejä, lounasetu, virikesetelit, kulttuuri- ja liikuntakerho, kuntosali, hieronta)

💻 Teknologiat

Erikoisuutenamme on oma integraatioalustamme Frends, jota käytämme useimmiten projekteissamme. Frends on täysin suomalainen low-code, hybridi-integraatioalusta. Tuotteen tuoreimmassa inkarnaatiossa käytetään moderneja teknologioita ja pilvipalveluita. Frends on pohjautuu C#:iin ja pyörii Azuren päällä.

➡️ Lue, millaista Frendsillä on tehdä kehitystyötäblogistamme ja katso myös lyhyt demo-video. Voit myös tutustua Frendsiin lisää tuotteemme dokumentaatio-sivuilta.

Töissämme pääset tutustumaan myös Azuren eri teknologioihin kuten Machine Learning ja Data Factory. Taikasanoja töissämme ovat REST, JSON, XML, XSLT ja SQL. Tuntemus API-arkkitehtuureista, API Managementista, GraphQL:stä ja LINQ:sta ovat asioita, joita arvostamme - ja joita pääset oppimaan.

🧐 Frendszone

Lyhyesti kuvattuna, olemme IT-konsulttitalo ja palvelemme hyvin monenlaisia asiakkaita laidasta laitaan niin yksityisellä kuin julkisella sektorilla ja useilla eri toimialoilla.

Frendsissä on noin 250 asiantuntijaa, joista reilu 170 toimii omissa pienkonsulttitiimeissämme. Tiimeissä on kehittäjiä, arkkitehtejä, palvelupäälliköitä ja projektipäälliköitä. Osa kehittäjistä on keskittynyt täysin kehitystyöhön, osa tekee tämän lisäksi esimerkiksi määrittelyä, kouluttamista tai myynnin tukea. Kuuntelemme tekijöitämme ja pyrimme muokkaamaan roolia ja urapolkua jokaiselle mieluisaksi.

➡️FAQ-blogissa vastaamme yleisimpiin kysymyksiin, joita keskusteluissa on herännyt. Arjestamme voit myös lukea lisää täältä. Arvoista ja kulttuuristamme kerromme lisää täällä. Panostamme myös paljon perehdytykseen ja tuemme sinua. Tutustu myös blogiimme miksi talentit valitsevat Frendsin ja miksi meillä viihdytään.

⭐ Miltä kuulostaa?

Jos mielenkiintosi on herännyt, toivomme, että kohtaamme! Voit olla meihin näppärästi ja nopeasti yhteydessä ilman CV:tä ja tarkennellaan yhdessä lisää. Jätä yhteystietosi meille hakulinkin kautta (esim. LinkedIn-profiilin avulla), niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä.

Kaipaatko lisätietoja ja haluat jutella lisää? Olethan yhteydessä suoraan Jesseen, .

Rekrytointiprosessimme on nopea, avoin ja informatiivinen. Voit lukea prosessistamme lisää blogistamme. Aloitus on sovittavissa joustavasti tilanteesi mukaan ja työnteko onnistuu ympäri Suomea. Roolissa vaaditaan sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.

Mitä maailmamme olisi ilman integraatioita? 🌎

  • Sähkömittarit luettaisiin käsin.

  • Tavaratilaukset hoidettaisiin yhä puhelimella.

  • Laivat eivät pääsisi satamiin ilman ennakolta lähetettyjä tulli-ilmoituksia.

  • Vanhat järjestelmät vanhenisivat ennen aikojaan, jos niiden päälle ei integraatiokeinoin pystyttäisi rakentamaan moderneja käyttöliittymiä.

  • Raha ei liikkuisi. Ihmiset jonottaisivat pankkikonttoreissa maksamassa laskuja ja nostamassa rahaa.

raw.description:
Bei egg schaffen wir Erlebnisse. Echte Erlebnisse.

Die Art von Erlebnissen, die Kreativität, kluges Denken, Liebe zum Detail und hin und wieder auch eine gute Portion Humor erfordern, wenn sich fünf Minuten vor dem Go-live plötzlich alles ändert.

Wir arbeiten über Ländergrenzen, Kulturen und Kunden hinweg. Deshalb geht es bei uns oft schnell, und kein Tag gleicht dem anderen. Genau das mögen wir. Es bedeutet aber auch, dass wir Menschen brauchen, die auch unter Druck einen kühlen Kopf bewahren, mehrere Bälle gleichzeitig in der Luft behalten können, Verantwortung übernehmen und Wert auf Kundenzufriedenheit legen.

Keine großen Egos. Keine Fehler verstecken. Keine stillen Hühner in diesem Nest.

Und jetzt zu dir

Du bleibst ruhig, wenn es chaotisch wird, denkst klar, wenn sich Prioritäten verschieben, und übernimmst Verantwortung, ohne dass alles bis ins letzte Detail vorgegeben sein muss (denn das ist es selten). Du legst Wert auf Ergebnisse, Qualität und kontinuierliche Verbesserung. Du liebst Prozesse. Außerdem bist du neugierig auf intelligentere Arbeitsweisen – einschließlich KI, Automatisierung und moderner Tools, die Arbeit einfacher und wirkungsvoller machen.

Und vor allem: Du bringst Dinge zu Ende. Richtig. Keine halbgaren Eier.

Deine Aufgaben

In dieser Rolle arbeitest du zu 100 % für einen unserer wichtigsten Pharmakunden.

  • Du leitest die End-to-End-Umsetzung mehrerer groß angelegter und hochkomplexer Projekte und stellst deren erfolgreiche Durchführung vom Briefing bis zum Abschluss sicher.

  • Du fungierst als zentrale Ansprechperson auf Senior-Level für unsere Kunden, baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf und berätst zu Projektstrategie, Umsetzung und Best Practices.

  • Du steuerst die Zusammenarbeit zwischen internen Teams, Lieferanten und Stakeholdern und stellst gleichzeitig die Einhaltung von Kundenstandards, Tools, Prozessen und regulatorischen Anforderungen im Gesundheitsbereich sicher.

  • Du verantwortest die Projektsteuerung inklusive Zeitplänen, Budgets, Risikomanagement, Ressourcenplanung und Reporting.

  • Du erkennst Herausforderungen frühzeitig, steuerst Eskalationen und behältst auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen sowie bei kurzfristigen Änderungen den Überblick.

  • Du unterstützt und entwickelst Teammitglieder weiter und trägst aktiv zum Wissensaustausch sowie zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung im Unternehmen bei.

Das bringst du mit

(Und wir meinen das wirklich ernst: Kandidat:innen, die die folgenden Kriterien nicht erfüllen, können leider nicht berücksichtigt werden.)

Erfahrung & Fähigkeiten

  • 8–10+ Jahre Erfahrung im Event-Projektmanagement, mit umfangreicher Erfahrung mit Kunden aus der Pharma- und/oder Gesundheitsbranche, insbesondere HCP events.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse der regulatorischen Anforderungen und Compliance-Vorgaben im Gesundheitswesen in Deutschland und international.

  • Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Steuerung komplexer internationaler Projekte, zahlreicher Stakeholder und bedeutender Veranstaltungsbudgets.

  • Nachweisliche Fähigkeit, als vertrauenswürdige:r Berater:in aufzutreten und Senior-Stakeholder auf Kundenseite zu beeinflussen.

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Cvent

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

So arbeiten wir bei egg

Menschen, die bei egg erfolgreich sind, zeichnen sich in der Regel dadurch aus, dass sie:

  • Verantwortung übernehmen und Dinge voranbringen

  • Resilient sind

  • Ruhe bewahren, wenn sich Prioritäten ändern

  • Sich auf Ergebnisse und Qualität konzentrieren

  • Mit Unklarheit und Veränderung umgehen können

  • Nach intelligenteren Arbeitsweisen suchen – inklusive KI und Technologie

  • Kreativität mit Struktur und Umsetzungsstärke verbinden

Bonuspunkte gibt's, wenn du außerdem ...

  • Bereits Projektteams geführt oder Mitarbeitende gecoacht bzw. entwickelt hast.

  • Ein gutes kommerzielles Verständnis sowie Erfahrung im Finanz- und Budgetmanagement mitbringst.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Flexible Arbeitsmodelle (je nach Standort remote oder hybrid)

  • Attraktives Gehalt plus leistungsabhängigen Bonus

  • Homeoffice-/Technologie-Zuschuss und eine Pluxee Benefits Karte

  • Smarte, hilfsbereite Kolleg:innen, die wirklich gerne zusammenarbeiten

  • Internationale Karrieremöglichkeiten und ein globales Offsite-Event an großartigen Orten

  • Dort wo wir Büros haben, kostenlosen Kaffee, haustierfreundliche Büros und eine Unternehmenskultur, die sich genauso um Menschen wie um Leistung kümmert

(Ja, der Kaffee ist wirklich gut. Wir sind schließlich keine Monster.)

Der Bewerbungsprozess

  • Online-Bewerbung

    (Du hast nach rechts gewischt.)

  • Erstes Kennenlerngespräch

    (Wir haben auch nach rechts gewischt – schauen wir, ob die Chemie stimmt.)

  • Erstes Interview

    (Wir mögen dich! Jetzt wird es Zeit, ein wenig tiefer einzusteigen.)

  • Zweites Interview

    (Okay, wir mögen dich wirklich sehr. Lust, die Familie kennenzulernen? Keine Sorge, die meisten Eier benehmen sich ganz ordentlich.)

  • Angebot

    (Wir sind verliebt. Hoffentlich du auch.)

Der wichtigste Teil

Bei egggeht Feedback in alle Richtungen: nach oben, nach unten und zur Seite. Wir glauben daran, dass Verantwortung und Freundlichkeit perfekt zusammenpassen.

Fehler sind hier erlaubt – solange wir dazu stehen, daraus lernen und sie nicht wiederholen.

Wir sind stolz auf ein Team aus Menschen mit unterschiedlichsten Lebenswegen, Hintergründen und Perspektiven. Wir sind überzeugt, dass genau das unsere Arbeit besser, unser Denken schärfer und unsere Ergebnisse stärker macht.

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen aller Geschlechter, einschließlich trans- und nicht-binärer Personen, sowie von Menschen aus BIPOC-Communities, LGBTQ2S+-Communities und von Menschen mit sichtbaren oder nicht sichtbaren Behinderungen.

Außerdem sind wir ein ESG-orientiertes Unternehmen und setzen uns dafür ein, positive Auswirkungen zu erzielen – weit über die Grenzen unseres eigenen Unternehmens hinaus.tive impact beyond our own walls.

raw.description:
(This job is only available in german)

Worum es geht

SIMON ist die Außendienst-Plattform für alle, die beim Kunden vor Ort arbeiten. Das reicht von der Pharmareferentin in der Apotheke über den Merchandiser im Lebensmittelmarkt bis zum Techniker im Heizungskeller. SIMON setzt auf die vorhandenen ERP- und CRM-Systeme auf und ist technisch in vier bis sechs Wochen startklar. Seit über zehn Jahren arbeiten anspruchsvolle Außendienstteams im Pharmabereich damit.

Jetzt bringen wir SIMON zu weiteren mittelständischen Herstellern, vor allem im Handel und FMCG sowie im technischen Kundendienst. Dafür suchen wir dich: jemanden, der die richtigen Leute findet, anspricht und vom ersten Kontakt bis zum produktiven Einsatz begleitet.

Wie wir verkaufen

Wir verkaufen SIMON so, wie man einen neuen Kollegen einstellt. Zuerst kommt das Kennenlernen: Der Interessent probiert einen Prototyp für seine Branche selbst aus. Darauf folgt das Vorstellungsgespräch, eine Demo mit einem Klickdummy in seinen eigenen Begriffen. Danach kommt die Probearbeit, ein Pilot mit fünf bis zehn Nutzern und vorab vereinbarten Erfolgskriterien. Erst dann folgt die Festanstellung, also Vertrag und Rollout. Nach drei Monaten gibt es ein Mitarbeitergespräch mit echten Zahlen.

Wir versprechen dabei nichts, was nicht stimmt. In jeder Demo sagen wir klar, was Standard ist, was konfiguriert und was entwickelt werden muss.

Deine Aufgaben

raw.description:
On behalf of UKRI we are looking for anIdentity & Collaboration Architect(Inside IR35) for an initial 4 month contract. Remote working with occasional office travel.

The Identity & Collaboration Architect will lead the architecture and design of a large-scale Microsoft 365 consolidation programme involving the migration of multiple Microsoft 365 tenancies, mail domains and identity platforms into a single strategic environment.

The role is accountable for developing the future-state architecture for identity, authentication, directory services, email namespace, collaboration services and associated governance models. The architect will work across technical, operational and business stakeholders to establish a coherent, sustainable target operating model that balances organisational requirements with Microsoft's strategic cloud architecture.

A key aspect of the role is the development of target-state identity and namespace strategies, including the transition from multiple independentlymanaged directories and Microsoft 365 tenancies to a consolidated identity platform centred on Microsoft Entra ID.

As an Identity & Collaboration Architect your main responsibilities will be to:

  • Develop target-state identity architecture for a multi-organisational Microsoft 365 environment.
  • Define authoritative sources for identity information and attribute ownership.
  • Establish identity lifecycle architecture covering joiners, movers and leavers.
  • Define future-state email namespace strategy.
  • Develop mail domain architecture covering multiple existing SMTP domains.
  • Analyse impacts of domain consolidation, retention and rationalisation.
  • Support definition of future-state architecture for Microsoft 365 services and ancillary solutions
  • Support tenant consolidation strategy and migration planning.
  • Design core platform services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online and OneDrive.
  • Develop architectural principles and standards.
  • Establish decision frameworks for identity and namespace management.
  • Lead discovery activities across multiple organisations.
  • Analyse current-state identity, directory and messaging environments.
  • Engage senior stakeholders across IT, security, HR and business functions.
  • Facilitate workshops to define identity, namespace and governance requirements.

Essential:

  • Demonstrable experience in designing and delivering Identity Architecture within complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong understanding of directory services, domain architecture and identity lifecycle management.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID, including authentication, conditional access, identity governance and privileged identity management.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing Microsoft 365 architectures.
  • Experience developing target-state architectures, migration strategies and transition roadmaps across multiple organisations or business units.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to facilitate workshops and present architectural recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience defining governance frameworks, operating models and architectural standards.

Desirable:

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure and/or AWS cloud platforms.
  • Experience working within hybrid or legacy technology environments.
  • Experience within the Public Sector or similarly regulated environments.
  • Familiarity with security, compliance and identity governance requirements in complex organisations.

Please be aware that this role can only be worked within the UK and not Overseas.

Disability Confident

As a Disability Confident employer, UKRI encourage applications from disabled and neurodivergent candidates. Applications from candidates who identify as having a disability and meet the essential criteria for the role will be prioritised for review. Where application volumes are high, additional role-specific and desirable criteria may be applied as part of the shortlisting process which may include holding active security clearance.

In applying for this role, you acknowledge the following "this role falls in scope of the Off Payroll Working in the Public Sector legislation. Any rates of payment quoted will reflect the gross rate per day for the assignment and will be subject to appropriate taxes and statutory costs. As such the payment to the intermediary and your income resulting from this contract will be different".

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We’re looking for an Automation QA Engineer with strong automation skills who also takes ownership of manual testing for our desktop and mobile applications.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain desktop and mobile test automation for critical user flows.

  • Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines and keep them fast and reliable.

  • Investigate failures, fix flaky tests, and manage test data and environments

  • Report clear, reproducible bugs and verify fixes

  • Work with developers and product on testability and acceptance criteria

  • Perform hands-on functional, exploratory, and regression testing of new features

  • Choose manual or automated coverage based on risk; maintain regression suites.

Requirements

Mandatory:

  • 4+ years in QA automation, plus hands-on manual and exploratory testing experience.

  • Strong programming skills in TypeScript/JavaScript.

  • Experience running tests in CI/CD pipelines (for example, GitHub Actions).

  • Hands-on experience with Playwright for desktop or web, and WebdriverIO + Appium for mobile.

  • Experience testing Electron and/or React Native apps, including on real iOS and Android devices.

  • Experience using AI tools in QA and critically reviewing their output. Testing AI-powered applications is a plus.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Job Title: Senior Migration Consultant - Clinical Data Programming

Job Location: Cambridge, United Kingdom

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva's Vault Clinical Data Management System (CDMS) is changing how life sciences companies manage clinical trial data, bringing EDC, coding, and Data Quality System (DQS) together in one platform. The Migration Team works within this group, focusing on migrating customers off legacy systems—such as Medidata Rave and Oracle InForm—into Vault CDMS.

We are looking for a Senior Migration Consultant with hands-on experience programming and processing extremely large clinical datasets. In this full-time, customer-facing role, you will serve as a trusted, customer-facing technical lead, partnering directly with Sponsors throughout active migration programs.

What You’ll Do

    • Partner directly with Sponsors and CROs to interpret legacy clinical database structures, protocol specifications, and data mapping requirements, applying Veeva migration best practices.
    • Perform data transformation, mapping, and script validation on large, complex clinical datasets extracted from legacy platforms (e.g., Medidata Rave, Oracle InForm).
    • Lead end-to-end data migration delivery across complex, active clinical trials per the project plan, coordinating closely with cross-functional technical teams.
    • Develop and configure validation scripts, and custom SQL-based listings to ensure data integrity, auditability, and cleanliness during ingestion into Veeva DQS and Vault CDMS.
    • Provide feedback to the Vault CDMS & DQS product teams based on real-world customer migration challenges, data volume bottlenecks, and client requirements.
    • Contribute to reusable migration tools, data mapping templates, and automation initiatives, mentoring junior team members throughout the migration lifecycle.

Requirements

    • 5+ years of experience with EDC clinical software, covering end-to-end data management (database design, data collection, data analysis, query resolution, datasets, statistical reporting)
    • Solid understanding of clinical trial processes, particularly around data collection and review
    • Programming experience in languages such as SAS, R, Python, or SQL, with the ability to pick up new SQL-based languages
    • Background in the life sciences industry (pharma, biotech, medical device, CRO, or academic/public health), with experience across project assessment, planning, development, training, and implementation
    • Experience in a customer-facing role, ideally within software professional services or consulting
    • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while meeting project timelines
    • Strong verbal and written communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills
    • Willingness to travel up to 10%, potentially including international travel

Nice to Have

    • Knowledge of DBT
    • Familiarity with data management standards (GCDMP, CDISC, SDTMIG, CDASH, ADaM)
    • Experience working with system integrators for IVRS, medical coding, eSource, CTMS, eTMF, or similar clinical technologies
    • Experience integrating or programming with REST-based APIs
    • Experience translating clinical protocols into software specifications, including technical documentation
    • Experience with Veeva applications
    • Located near a major life sciences hub
    • Degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related field

Interview with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Private health insurance
    • Flexible paid time off plus local public holidays
    • Pension / retirement plan contributions
    • 1% charitable giving program

raw.description:
1. JOB PURPOSE

To provide strategic and operational leadership of the company's Human Resources function, ensuring the organisation has the people, leadership capability, organisational structure, culture, systems and governance required to deliver its corporate strategy and successfully transition from a credit-only microfinance institution into a fully-fledged, deposit-taking bank regulated by the relevant central bank authorities.

The role will serve as a strategic advisor to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team on workforce strategy, organisational effectiveness, talent, leadership, performance, employee engagement, succession, reward, employee relations and change management.

The Head of Human Resources will be responsible for building a scalable, high-performance and bank-ready people function that supports sustainable business growth while ensuring compliance with employment legislation, regulatory expectations and internal governance standards.

2. STRATEGIC CONTEXT

The company is executing a strategic transformation from a leading credit-only microfinance institution into a fully-fledged, deposit-taking bank regulated by the central bank.

This transformation will require significant organisational, cultural and workforce readiness. The Head of Human Resources will therefore play a critical role in ensuring that the company's people strategy, organisational structure, leadership capability, talent pipeline, policies, performance systems and HR governance evolve in line with the banking transition roadmap.

The role will lead the development of a future-ready workforce capable of operating within a more complex, highly regulated financial-services environment while maintaining the company's entrepreneurial culture and customer-focused orientation.

The priority is to build the right organisation, with the right people, capabilities, leadership and controls, at the right time to support profitable growth and regulatory readiness.

3. KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

A. HR Strategy and Business Partnership

  • Develop and execute the annual Human Resources strategy aligned with the company's corporate strategy and banking transition roadmap.

  • Act as a strategic advisor and trusted business partner to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team on people, organisational and workforce matters.

  • Translate business strategy into workforce requirements, organisational capability priorities and people initiatives.

  • Provide executive leadership with workforce insights, HR analytics and recommendations to support evidence-based decision-making.

  • Establish HR as a strategic business function with clear service standards, governance and measurable business outcomes.

  • Participate in strategic planning, executive reviews and other forums where organisational capability and workforce considerations influence business decisions.

B. Organisation Design and Workforce Planning

  • Lead organisation-wide workforce planning to ensure the company has the capacity and capabilities required to achieve its strategic objectives.

  • Review and optimise organisational structures, reporting lines, spans of control and job architecture in line with business growth and the transition to banking.

  • Develop workforce plans covering headcount, critical roles, succession, capability gaps and future talent requirements.

  • Lead organisational restructuring and change initiatives where required to support strategic priorities.

  • Conduct workforce analysis to identify productivity opportunities, capability gaps, critical roles and emerging people risks.

  • Develop and maintain a clear organisation structure and job architecture appropriate for a regulated financial institution.

C. Talent Acquisition and Talent Management

  • Develop and implement a strategic talent acquisition framework covering executive, managerial, specialist, technical, sales and operational positions.

  • Partner with business leaders to define critical roles, capability requirements and succession priorities.

  • Build talent pipelines for key and hard-to-fill positions, particularly roles required for the company's banking transition.

  • Establish robust recruitment, selection, onboarding and talent assessment processes.

  • Strengthen employer positioning and employee value proposition to attract high-quality talent.

  • Develop talent review processes to identify high-potential employees and critical capability gaps.

  • Establish succession plans for executive, management and other business-critical positions.

D. Performance Management and Organisational Effectiveness

  • Design and implement an enterprise-wide Performance Management Framework aligned with the company's strategic objectives and KPIs.

  • Ensure individual and departmental objectives are clearly cascaded from the corporate strategy.

  • Establish regular performance review and calibration processes across the organisation.

  • Develop mechanisms for identifying and addressing underperformance while recognising and retaining high performers.

  • Use performance data and organisational insights to identify capability, productivity and leadership-development priorities.

  • Embed a culture of accountability, performance ownership and continuous improvement.

E. Learning, Development and Leadership Capability

  • Develop and implement an organisation-wide Learning and Development strategy aligned with current and future business capability requirements.

  • Establish structured leadership-development programmes for current and emerging leaders.

  • Identify critical technical, behavioural and regulatory capabilities required for the company's transition to banking.

  • Develop competency frameworks and career-development pathways for key functions.

  • Establish mechanisms for measuring learning effectiveness and return on investment.

  • Build internal capability and reduce organisational dependency on external recruitment for critical positions through targeted development and succession planning.

  • Partner with senior leaders to strengthen management capability, coaching and people leadership.

F. Culture, Employee Engagement and Change Management

  • Define and champion a high-performance organisational culture aligned with the company's values, strategy and future banking identity.

  • Lead culture transformation initiatives required to support the company's growth and transition into a regulated banking environment.

  • Develop and monitor employee engagement initiatives, using employee feedback and workforce data to drive improvement.

  • Lead communication and change-management initiatives associated with organisational restructuring, systems implementation, policy changes and the banking transition.

  • Strengthen employee experience across the employee lifecycle.

  • Develop employee wellbeing and financial-wellness initiatives that support attraction, engagement and retention.

G. HR Digital Transformation and People Analytics

  • Lead the digital transformation of HR processes and employee lifecycle management.

  • Evaluate, implement and optimise HRIS and other people technology solutions.

  • Digitise and streamline recruitment, onboarding, performance management, leave, employee records, learning and other HR processes.

  • Establish reliable HR dashboards and management reporting covering headcount, recruitment, turnover, engagement, performance, diversity, absenteeism and workforce costs.

  • Provide regular people analytics and workforce insights to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team.

  • Use data to identify trends, risks and opportunities relating to workforce productivity, retention and organisational effectiveness.

H. Compensation, Benefits and Reward

  • Develop and maintain a competitive and sustainable compensation and benefits framework aligned with market practices and the company's financial capacity.

  • Lead periodic salary benchmarking and remuneration reviews.

  • Develop reward mechanisms that support performance, retention and achievement of strategic business objectives.

  • Ensure compensation structures maintain internal equity and appropriate market competitiveness.

  • Partner with Finance and Executive Management on workforce cost planning and remuneration budgets.

I. Employee Relations, Employment Law and HR Governance

  • Provide strategic advice on employee relations, disciplinary matters, grievances, investigations and workplace disputes.

  • Ensure HR policies, employment contracts and practices comply with applicable local employment legislation and regulatory requirements.

  • Develop, review and maintain HR policies, procedures and governance frameworks.

  • Ensure appropriate documentation and controls across the employee lifecycle.

  • Manage employee relations risks and provide timely advice to management on labour-law matters.

  • Promote fair, consistent and transparent application of HR policies and employment practices.

  • Maintain appropriate HR records and reporting to support governance, audit and regulatory requirements.

J. Regulatory and Banking Transition Readiness

  • Partner with the CEO, Executive Leadership Team, Compliance, Risk and other functions to ensure people-related requirements for the banking transition are addressed.

  • Develop a workforce and capability roadmap aligned with the company's licensing and regulatory-readiness programme.

  • Ensure critical banking capabilities, leadership positions and specialist functions are identified and appropriately staffed.

  • Support the development of governance structures, accountability frameworks and role clarity required for a regulated financial institution.

  • Ensure employees receive appropriate training on regulatory, compliance, risk, customer protection and conduct requirements relevant to their roles.

  • Provide people-related documentation, workforce data and HR governance information required for regulatory, audit and internal assurance processes.

  • Support organisational readiness for the increased governance, risk management and operational requirements associated with becoming a bank.

K. HR Leadership and Team Management

  • Build, lead and develop a high-performing Human Resources team.

  • Establish clear HR operating models, responsibilities, service standards and performance measures.

  • Develop HR capability in business partnering, analytics, talent management, employee relations and strategic HR.

  • Establish strong working relationships between HR and all business functions.

  • Promote a culture of professionalism, confidentiality, integrity, responsiveness and business partnership within the HR function.

  • Prepare and present HR reports and workforce insights to the CEO, Executive Leadership Team and Board as required.

4. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, Industrial Relations, Psychology or a related field.

  • Professional qualification in Human Resources Management (e.g., CHRP or equivalent national/international professional body certification).

  • A Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organisational Development or a related discipline is an added advantage.

  • At least 10 years' progressive experience in Human Resources, with at least 5 years in a senior HR management / strategic HR leadership role.

  • Demonstrable experience partnering with CEOs, Executive Leadership Teams and/or Boards on strategic people and organisational matters.

  • Experience within banking, microfinance, financial services or another highly regulated environment is strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrable experience implementing HRIS, HR digital transformation and/or people analytics.

  • Strong knowledge of relevant employment law, HR governance and employee-relations practices.

We're seeking an intermediate to senior software developer with deep Linux expertise and a passion for open-source software to build innovative solutions for patients, healthcare providers, and medical staff. As a core member of our team, you'll architect, develop, and maintain the Linux distribution that powers our myHealthHub IBT platform. This role offers the unique opportunity to work at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and meaningful healthcare outcomes. What You'll Do Core Development & Architecture

Design, develop, integrate, and package core Linux applications and system components Create and maintain software packages using modern Linux packaging systems (Arch Linux AUR/ABS preferred, but experience with Debian/Ubuntu, RedHat/Fedora, or Yocto welcomed) Build and optimize React-based applications integrated with native Linux services Develop system daemons, hardware abstraction layers, and device management services

Collaboration & Innovation

Work closely with cross-functional teams to translate healthcare user needs into robust technical solutions Participate in architectural decisions that enhance platform performance and user experience Mentor team members and engage in collaborative code reviews Contribute to the transition from legacy systems to next-generation healthcare platforms

DevOps & Quality Assurance

Implement CI/CD pipelines for continuous deployment of system components Write comprehensive, test-supported code following best practices Maintain deployment-ready software in an agile development environment

What We're Looking For Essential Skills

Linux Expertise: Deep familiarity with Linux systems including package creation (Arch Linux preferred), system administration, shell scripting, or OS architecture Web Development: Proficiency in React, TypeScript/JavaScript, and Python System Integration: Experience with native integration libraries (Electron, React Native) Architecture: Strong understanding of application architecture, MVC patterns, and greenfield development DevOps: Hands-on experience with GitLab, CI/CD tools (GitLab CI, Travis CI, CircleCI)

Education & Experience

B.Sc in Computer Science, B.Eng in Software Engineering, or equivalent experience Professional experience in software development with demonstrable Linux systems knowledge Experience working remotely in agile development environments Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to usability and accessibility

Bonus Points

Experience in embedded Linux, automotive systems, smart TV platforms, kiosks, or healthcare technology Cloud platform experience (AWS, Azure) French language proficiency Open-source contribution history

What Matters Most We value curiosity and growth potential! If you understand the open-source Linux ecosystem, have experience with system-level programming, and are excited about learning healthcare technology, we want to hear from you. Why You'll Love Working Here Comprehensive Benefits

Competitive compensation package Full health benefits (medical, dental, vision, RRSP, disability, life insurance) Fully remote with optional access to offices in Ontario and Quebec

Culture & Growth

Individual-focused: We celebrate diverse backgrounds and expertise Practical approach: Good planning over crunch time, async communication over unnecessary meetings Continuous learning: Comprehensive onboarding, mentorship opportunities (both giving and receiving) Team connection: Regular social activities and monthly company-wide events Purpose-driven: Work alongside passionate professionals making a real impact in healthcare

Outcome-driven culture Team ceremonies refined through regular retrospectives Various committees and professional development opportunities Warm, welcoming atmosphere that prioritizes swift, successful integration

Ready to build the future of healthcare technology? We're looking for developers who are excited to dive deep into Linux systems while contributing to meaningful healthcare solutions. Your technical expertise and problem-solving skills will directly impact patient care and medical workflows.

raw.description:
Our clinical operations activities are growing rapidly, and we are currently seeking full-time, remote-based Regulatory Submissions Coordinator to join our Clinical Operations team. This position works both independently and collaboratively with a team to meet common goals and plays a key role in the study start-up process at Medpace. As a Regulatory Submissions Coordinator with Medpace Canada, you will gain exposure to diverse, challenging studies across all phases and multiple therapuetic areas. On a day-to-day basis, you will have the opportunity to use your study start-up expertise to guide and administer internal processes, as well as advise clients on Health Canada requirements. With our continued growth in Canada, we are looking for proactive, positive, and self-motivated individuals with a shared commitment to quality to join our supportive and dynamic team.


Responsibilities

  • Act as the point of contact with sites during the study start up process;
  • Prepare, review, and file clinical trial applications to Health Canada;
  • Ensure submissions comply with applicable regulations and guidance documents;
  • Advise study teams on changing regulations and compliance requirements;
  • Track and ensure timely filing of all essential start-up documents including Health Canada submissions.

Qualifications

  • Proficiency in English (required) and French (preferred)
  • Ability to work in a remote setting;
  • Bachelor’s degree in a science or health-related field;
  • Experience working at a CRO is preferred;
  • At least 3-5 years of clinical research industry experience with HealthCanada and Ethics submissions;
  • Knowledge of ICH guidelines and applicable local regulations; and
  • Excellent written and oral skills.


Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.


Why Medpace?

When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.

Purpose-Driven Work

    • Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence

Collaborative Culture

    • Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
    • Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable

Continuous Growth & Development

    • Office based environment with on-site mentors
    • Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
    • Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
    • Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
    • An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

Other Employee Benefits

    • Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
    • Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
    • Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
    • Company-sponsored social events and intramural sports

Cincinnati Headquarters Experience

    • A modern corporate campus designed to support collaboration and productivity
    • Multiple on-site dining options in the heart of Madison Square
    • Free on-site parking
    • Convenient access to on-site 24-7 fitness and wellness facilities

What to Expect Next

A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

raw.description:
VP/SVP, Insurance Compliance

Company Description

Lightstone, founded by David Lichtenstein, is one of the most diversified privately held real estate companies in the United States. Headquartered in New York City, Lightstone is active in 27 states across the country, developing, managing, and investing in all sectors of the real estate market, including residential, hospitality, commercial, and retail. With nearly $12 billion in assets under management, Lightstone's portfolio currently includes over 15 million square feet of industrial, logistics, life sciences, and commercial properties, over 25,000 residential units, and over 5,100 hotel keys.

Lightstone's insurance operations comprise a growing multi-entity group of domestic and international insurance companies. The group includes an Arizona-domiciled P&C insurer, an international insurer operating under the Puerto Rico International Insurance Center, a recently acquired 50% interest in a Kansas City-based life and retirement company, and a new life and annuity insurance company currently being formed in either Oklahoma or Arizona.

For more information, please visit www.lightstonegroup.com.

Position Summary

Lightstone is seeking an experienced VP or SVP of Insurance Compliance to manage regulatory compliance across its growing multi-entity insurance and reinsurance group. Reporting to senior leadership, this individual will be responsible for the day-to-day compliance function across a portfolio of domestic P&C, life and annuity, and international insurance companies. The ideal candidate is a hands-on compliance professional with deep regulatory knowledge, strong relationships with state insurance departments, and the ability to keep a complex, multi-jurisdictional insurance operation in good standing with its regulators.

This position reports to the General Counsel and/or Chief Executive Officer.

Key Responsibilities

Multi-Entity Regulatory Compliance

  • Manage ongoing regulatory compliance across all entities in the insurance group
  • Monitor, interpret, and apply insurance laws and regulations across all relevant jurisdictions, including Arizona, Indiana, Oklahoma, and Puerto Rico
  • Ensure all holding company structures, inter-company agreements, affiliated transactions, and enterprise arrangements comply with applicable insurance holding company acts and related statutes
  • Support compliance oversight for the international insurer operating under the Puerto Rico International Insurance Center framework

Examination & Regulatory Relations

  • Lead preparation for and management of all state regulatory examinations, including financial and market conduct examinations
  • Act as a primary point of contact with applicable insurance departments and regulatory bodies
  • Maintain examination readiness programs; ensure all companies are in a continuous state of audit preparedness
  • Respond to regulatory inquiries and work to resolve issues before escalation
  • Prepare, review, and submit all required regulatory filings across all entities and jurisdictions on a timely basis

Transactions, Structures & Agreements

  • Review transactions, inter-company agreements, affiliated arrangements, and reinsurance contracts for regulatory compliance — the group operates primarily as a reinsurance business
  • Support domicile selection, licensing, and regulatory structuring for the new life and annuity company formation
  • Ensure all inter-company transactions and agreements are properly structured, documented, and filed in accordance with applicable law

Financial, Investment & Statutory Compliance

  • Monitor investment management and structuring across entities for compliance with applicable investment laws and statutory requirements
  • Support statutory accounting compliance and the accuracy of regulatory financial reporting
  • Review day-to-day transactions across the group for compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies
  • Escalate financial compliance issues to senior leadership and outside counsel as appropriate

Policies, Training & Compliance Program

  • Develop and maintain compliance policies, procedures, and internal controls across all entities
  • Maintain a compliance calendar tracking all regulatory deadlines, renewal dates, and filing obligations
  • Provide compliance guidance and training to management and staff
  • Coordinate with outside regulatory counsel and compliance consultants as needed

Qualifications

Required

  • Minimum 5-8 years of insurance regulatory compliance experience
  • Working knowledge of NAIC model laws, insurance holding company acts, and multi-state regulatory practices
  • Experience with state insurance department examinations, whether as a regulator, examiner, or company-side compliance professional
  • Ability to manage compliance obligations across multiple entities and jurisdictions simultaneously
  • Strong analytical and writing skills; ability to produce clear regulatory memoranda, compliance summaries, and management-level reports
  • Sound judgment and effective communication skills with regulators, management, and outside counsel

Strongly Preferred

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school; active bar membership preferred but not required
  • Prior experience working for or with a state insurance department or the NAIC
  • Experience with both P&C and life/annuity compliance
  • Experience supporting insurance company acquisitions or formations
  • Familiarity with reinsurance structures and related regulatory considerations

Personal Attributes

  • Detail-oriented and proactive with a practical, solutions-focused approach
  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities across entities and jurisdictions in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment
  • High integrity and sound judgment; a reliable resource for senior leadership on compliance matters
  • Strong independent work ethic with excellent attention to detail

Compensation & Benefits

Offered salary commensurate with experience, plus discretionary bonus.

$175 - $200k

Lightstone offers our employees a comprehensive and competitive benefits program inclusive of:

  • Paid time off for vacation and sick leave
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance, and wellness programs
  • 401(k) and Roth retirement plans
  • Flexible spending accounts (medical & dependent care)
  • Life and AD&D insurance with options for supplemental employee, spouse, and child
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance
  • Commuter spending accounts (transit and parking)
  • Tuition assistance and employee assistance program

Overview

Who We Are

Because health is personal. That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.

Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.

Responsibilities

Ready to be the go-to expert who turns stop loss complexity into reimbursement wins?

Why This Role Matters

Every self-funded plan we serve depends on getting stop loss right, and that starts with someone who knows the contracts inside and out. As Stop Loss Lead, you’re the department’s technical authority, the person who makes sure eligible reimbursements get submitted, tracked, and collected instead of left on the table. Your audits catch problems early, your training makes the whole team sharper, and your process improvements make every claim move faster and cleaner. The stronger your expertise and the quality of your work, the stronger our reimbursement outcomes, our client relationships, and the department as a whole.

What You’ll Actually Do

  • Serve as the stop loss authority: Act as the department’s subject matter expert on administration, reimbursement, and contract interpretation, giving the team a trusted source for answers on complex questions.
  • Dig into contracts and carrier requirements: Review stop loss contracts, plan documents, and carrier requirements in depth to ensure compliance and capture every reimbursement opportunity available.
  • Drive reimbursements to resolution: Support the submission, tracking, and reconciliation of stop loss claims, and work aging items, carrier inquiries, disputes, and escalated cases through to closure.
  • Audit for quality: Conduct regular reviews of claim submissions, reimbursement tracking, documentation, and correspondence to confirm accuracy and completeness, then report results and performance metrics to leadership.
  • Turn findings into fixes: Spot recurring errors, trends, and process gaps in audit results, develop corrective action recommendations, and partner with leadership to put them in place.
  • Build and coach the team: Onboard new Stop Loss Specialists, create and maintain training materials and standard operating procedures, and deliver coaching and refresher sessions that close knowledge gaps.
  • Improve how we work: Evaluate workflows, lead or support process improvement initiatives, and help roll out new tools and best practices, including testing and validating system updates.
  • Own reporting and audit readiness: Review and help prepare monthly stop loss and reimbursement reporting and carrier submissions, support internal and external audit requests, and keep documentation accurate and current.
  • Step in where it counts: Process stop loss claims and handle related operational work when workflow demands require it, and contribute to special projects that advance department goals.

Qualifications

What You Bring to Our Team

Education & Experience:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • 3-5 years of experience in stop loss, self-funded health plan administration, claims, or related healthcare required
  • Advanced claims processing and reimbursement experience strongly preferred
  • Experience interpreting stop loss contracts and plan documents preferred
  • Experience conducting audits, quality reviews, or process improvement initiatives preferred
  • Experience training or mentoring team members preferred

Technical Skills:

  • Advanced knowledge of stop loss administration, reimbursement processes, and contract interpretation
  • Working knowledge of medical terminology and CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding (preferred)
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and reporting tools
  • Auditing and data analysis skills, including identifying trends and building data-driven recommendations

Benefits

The Highlights:

  • Competitive base salary and benefits effective day one
  • Comprehensive medical and dental through our own health solutions (yes, we use what we build)
  • Unlimited PTO—rest and recharge time is non-negotiable
  • Mental health support, retirement planning, and financial protection
  • Professional development with clear career progression and learning budgets
  • Mission-driven culture where diverse perspectives drive real impact on people's health

Want the full picture? Visit personifyhealthbenefits.com to explore our complete benefits package, wellness programs, and other employee perks.

Compensation: This position offers a base salary range of $65,000 - $73,000, depending on location, skills, and experience. You're eligible for our full benefits package starting day one.

Our Commitment: Personify Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We cultivate a work environment where differences are celebrated, and employees of all backgrounds are empowered to thrive—because diversity is core to who we are and critical to our work in health and wellbeing.

Stay Safe: Personify Health will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information like social security numbers during hiring. All official communication comes from verified company email addresses and or our secure applicant tracking system. Suspicious requests? Report them to . View all legitimate openings at personifyhealth.com/careers.

Mission Critical Business Solutions Manager - Europe


Location: Europe (Flexible)

At Tait Communications, we help organisations that protect lives, critical infrastructure and communities stay connected when it matters most.

We are looking for an experienced Mission Critical Business Solutions Manager to lead some of Europe’s most strategic communications opportunities.

This role will focus on shaping and winning complex Public Safety, Government and Critical Infrastructure programmes spanning mission-critical radio, broadband, software, AI-enabled solutions and strategic partner ecosystems.


What You'll Do

  • Lead the pursuit of major mission-critical communications opportunities across Europe.
  • Engage customers to understand operational requirements and desired outcomes.
  • Shape winning solution strategies and business cases.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams across Sales, Product Management, Engineering and Services.
  • Build strategic relationships with customers and industry partners.
  • Provide market insights that influence future portfolio and roadmap decisions.

About You

You will bring experience in mission-critical communications, public safety, telecommunications or critical infrastructure markets, along with a successful track record supporting complex, high-value solution pursuits. You are commercially minded, technically credible and comfortable engaging senior stakeholders across customer, partner and executive organisations.


Why Tait?

This is an opportunity to influence some of Europe's most significant mission-critical transformation programmes while helping shape the future of Tait's mission-critical portfolio and growth strategy.


Join us and help deliver communications solutions that make a real difference when it matters most.

For more than 50 years, Tait Communications has been designing, delivering, and supporting critical communications networks for public safety, transportation and utility customers around the world. Founded in Christchurch by Sir Angus Tait, we now have a network of customers and offices that spans the globe.


Our employees value being part of a creative team committed to providing technological solutions that make a real difference to the communities we support. By joining Tait, you'll be joining a community of people with a wealth of knowledge and expertise, who care deeply about their work and the genuine impact it has for our customers, and who support each other to grow and develop.


Diversity & Inclusion Statement

Tait Communications is committed to fostering a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and empowered to succeed.
We are encourage applications from all backgrounds to apply.


How to Apply


Sound like your kind of role? Only applications submitted through the official application process will be considered.


Applications will be assessed as they are received, and your CV will be held unless you contact us to request this to be removed.


For more information about the company, our products and solutions offered to our customers, please visit our website: www.taitcommunications.com

We encourage applications from all backgrounds to apply.

About Shore360:

Shore360 is a 100% Australian-owned BPO firm based in the Philippines, providing customized staffing and administrative support for international companies, handling recruitment, HR, IT, and office facilities so clients can focus on core business, offering transparent pricing, dedicated teams, and flexible setups.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Diagnose and troubleshoot software application issues, including errors, bugs, and performance problems
  • Collaborate with software developers and other relevant teams to investigate and resolve complex application issues

  • Respond to user inquiries via phone, email, or ticketing system and

    provide clear and concise explanations or instructions
  • Assist in the testing and deployment of application hotfixes and new releases
  • Ensure that new unassigned tickets are triaged and responded to within SLA timeframes (First Reply Time)
  • Ensure that backlog tickets are resolved or escalated to JIRA within SLA timeframes (Agent Work Time)
  • Ensure that backlog tickets are updated promptly with current developments within SLA timeframes (Next Reply Time or Periodic Reply Time)
  • Ensure that the client is provided with any known workarounds immediately or within SLA timeframes
  • Ensure that regular requests for follow-up are issued to tickets that are pending the client’s response daily
  • When required, ensure testing is performed in test environments before the configuration is implemented into production environments
  • Required to learn application configuration and apply understanding of infrastructure or development constraints for diagnosis
  • Required to participate in product training to learn updates and support all Janison Products or Clients
  • Participate in handover training for new clients transitioning into BAU Support
  • Ensure regular participation is met in development sprint demos to maintain current knowledge of functional, operational, and technical aspects of the Janison products
  • Escalate tickets into JIRA with the appropriate level of detail – Jira Bug template, for acceptable handover and assign the appropriate Scrum team
  • Effectively and accurately communicate relevant product knowledge to clients and Janison staff promptly
  • Determine feature requests that have been raised as an Incident and establish if the client is willing to fund the new feature request.
  • Gather all details and send them to the Support Manager, Account Manager, and/or Product Owner to engage the client when required
  • Support testing SIT/UAT, report bugs and deficiencies identified in the product immediately
  • Coordinate with the Support Team Lead on any site configuration changes to meet the client’s requirements to determine any costs or approval needed

  • Prepare Post Incident Reports with the Support Team Lead if required

  • Perform deep-dive analysis on incidents tagged for review to reduce escalations to Level 3 teams
  • Update client site configuration documentation with any changes that have been made within agreed timeframes and uploaded to the knowledge bank
  • Create or update Knowledge Bank articles for identifying workarounds to be promoted to client-facing resources

Required Experience

  • At least 3 years' experience in a Technical IT Ops/System Admin role

  • At least 3 years of experience in a Customer Service role

  • Experience in SaaS-based application support

  • Experience in Microsoft Office Operating Systems

  • Experience in Customer Service or Service desk/call logging systems i.e. Zendesk, Jira, Freshdesk, Genesys

Minimum Qualifications

  • Tertiary qualifications or equivalent experience

  • Good understanding of computer systems (hardware, software, and applications), mobile devices, and other tech products

  • Excellent problem-solving and logical aptitude

  • Analytical Mindset

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Understanding of networks, databases, and other technology

  • Work experience in technical writing of software documentation

ShoreXtra Perks

  • HMO Coverage upon regularization

  • 20 Leave credits available upon regularization

  • Join our Social Passion Clubs to connect with like-minded peers and bring your whole self to work every day: Photography Club, Dance Club, Fitness Club, Book Club, Music Club
  • Engaging Monthly Events – Experience a vibrant culture with regular team activities and celebrations with amazing prizes and rewards
  • Bronze Referral Incentives – Get rewarded for bringing top talent to the team via our referral program.
  • Statutory Benefits: Maternity, Paternity, and Solo Parent Leaves, Magna Carta for Women, OT, and Premium Pays

Work Set Up:

raw.title: Data Architect - Managed Services
raw.excerpt: Are you looking for a role that motivates and challenges you?
raw.description:
Are you looking for a role that motivates and challenges you? Are you ready for an opportunity for growth? Do you want to work on teams where people roll up their sleeves to take on tough problems together, and regularly blow the doors off our clients with their outstanding teamwork? If you answered yes to those questions, 3Cloud might just be for you!

At 3Cloud, we hire people who aren’t afraid to experiment or fail. We hire people who are willing to give direct and candid feedback to their managers, leaders, and team members. We hire people who jump at those opportunities because they care about our collective growth and success. We hire people who challenge and hold each other accountable for living 3Cloud’s core values because they know that it will result in amazing experiences and solutions for our clients and each other.

This Data Architect position is a member of 3Cloud’s Managed Services team. He or she is responsible for ongoing development, support, escalations, and proactive maintenance for our client’s Azure Data Platform solution through the Managed Services teams processes, procedures, and tools. As a Data Architect, you will be a critical part of our core team that is essential to the success of our Managed Services division.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Lead support of client’s Azure Data platform and Power BI Environment, including response to any escalations while helping to analyze and resolve incidents for customers environment.
  • Consult, develop, and advise on solutions in Microsoft Azure with tools such as Synapse, Data Factory, Databricks, Azure ML, Data Lake, Data Warehouse, and Power BI.
  • Consult, develop, and advise on Power BI, including governance, strategy, report development, performance.
  • Consistently learn, apply, and refine skills around data engineering and data analytics.
  • Proactively mentors junior team members and actively gives feedback on their work and performance.
  • Design and deploy data pipelines, models, and AI-driven solutions for clients in various industries.
  • Understand and work with customers on licensing involving Microsoft data solutions and understand the limits/advantages of each licensing platform.
  • Takes responsibility for the quality of deliverables and solutions.
  • Supports and participates in the estimating of work to be done by self and others.
  • Communicate ticket status information to all associated parties and escalate cases as appropriate.
  • Interact with clients to identify issues, troubleshoot expediently, and follow up on issues via e-mail, ticketing system, and phone calls. Communicate technical issues and solutions with clients in business terms.
  • Intentionally builds relationships with client teams.
  • Prioritizes work appropriately, asks questions when priorities are unclear, and completes work accordingly.
  • Quickly recognizes when escalation is needed and promptly acts.
  • Create and maintain updated documentation for each client’s environment.
  • Promote best practices for clients and internally to enhance and improve organizational processes.
  • Periodically contributes to one or more 3Cloud internal communities.

Architecture & Solution Design

  • Ability to design large-scale Databricks Lakehouse architectures for healthcare environments.
  • Deep understanding of Delta Lake patterns, medallion architecture, optimization and governance.
  • Skilled at designing ingestion frameworks, transformation models, semantic layers, and orchestration patterns.
  • Experience evaluating and improving existing data platforms, codebases, and pipelines.

Technical Leadership

  • Ability to guide a team of engineers on best practices, code reviews, standards, and design patterns.
  • Lead technical discovery sessions with clients.
  • Create architectural documentation, mapping ~80–100 source systems into the data platform.

Enterprise Data Skills

  • Advanced SQL/Spark SQL performance expertise.
  • Experience handling large codebases (100k+ LOC) and high-volume ingestion workloads.
  • Experience with orchestration (ADF, Fabric, Databricks workflows, or similar).

Healthcare Data Expertise

  • Strong familiarity with multi-source healthcare environments: Epic Clarity, Caboodle, Health Catalyst, claims, EHR, scheduling, etc.
  • Understanding of data quality issues common in clinical and operational systems.
  • Experience architecting solutions that meet HIPAA-compliant requirements.

Power Platform & Accelerator Awareness

  • Ability to understand the Health Catalyst Power Platform accelerator at an architectural level.
  • Define extension patterns and integration approaches between Databricks and Power Platform.

Soft Skills

  • Strong client-facing communication and consulting presence.
  • Ability to work across delivery and managed services teams.
  • Able to set standards, train others, and support a train-the-trainer model.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or related field, or equivalent certification and experience.
  • Experience working in a support role and understanding standard support processes (i.e., ITIL)
  • 3+ years working with data and business intelligence solutions on the Microsoft tool stack for Business Intelligence (ADF, SQL DW, Synapse, Databricks, Power BI, etc.), or other vendor Business Intelligence tools (Business Objects, MicroStrategy, Qlik, SAP)
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • A passion for problem solving and learning new technologies.
  • Client relationship skills and experience managing vendors.
  • Ability to work in a fast paced, rapidly changing environment.
  • Strong desire for personal development and learning, including commitment to continuously upgrading your technical skills as the data landscape change.
  • Work remote, but not alone – with a team filled top to bottom with data analytics professionals.

This Job Posting will expire on August 10th, 2026.

3Cloud Total Rewards Highlights Include: 

  • Flexible work location with a virtual first approach to work! 
  • 401(K) with match up to 50% of your 6% contributions of eligible pay 
  • Generous PTO providing a minimum of 15 days in addition to 9 paid company holidays and 2 floating personal days 
  • Two medical plan options to allow you the choice to elect what works best for you!
  • Option for vision and dental coverage 
  • 100% employer paid coverage for life and disability insurance
  • Paid leave for birth parents and non-birth parents 
  • Option for Healthcare FSA, HSA, and Dependent Care FSA
  • $67.00 monthly tech and home office allowance
  • Utilization and/or discretionary bonus eligibility based on role 
  • Employee Assistance Program to help with everyday challenges

3Cloud offers competitive compensation. In addition to base pay employees are eligible to receive an annual discretionary/utilization bonus. If you are hired at 3Cloud your final base salary is based on factors such as skills, education, experience and/or geographic location. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above includes the full base salary range for the role. It is not typical for offers to be made at or near the top of the range.

Base Salary Range
$11,000—$165,000 USD

Don’t meet every single requirement? At 3Cloud we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.

At this time, we cannot sponsor applicants for work visas.
