Position Overview
The Contract Administrator is responsible for managing and coordinating contract
documentation, project administration, and compliance requirements to support the smooth delivery of air conditioning and HVAC projects. The role involves reviewing contracts, monitoring project milestones, coordinating with clients and suppliers, and ensuring all contractual documents are accurate, organized, and completed within agreed timelines.

The ideal candidate has strong administrative skills, excellent attention to detail, and
experience in contract administration, preferably within the HVAC, construction, or
mechanical services industry.

Key Responsibilities
1. Contract Administration
  • Prepare, review, and maintain contracts, subcontractor agreements, purchase
orders, and related documentation.
  • Ensure contract documents are accurate, complete, and properly filed.
  • Monitor contract terms, conditions, deliverables, and key deadlines.
  • Track contract variations, amendments, extensions, and approvals.
  • Assist in preparing contract submissions and supporting documentation.
  • Maintain a register of active contracts, renewal dates, and outstanding requirements.
  • Ensure documentation follows company procedures and applicable contractual
requirements.
2. Project Coordination
  • Coordinate with project managers, technicians, clients, suppliers, and subcontractors
regarding project requirements.
  • Monitor project schedules, milestones, and contractual deliverables.
  • Follow up on outstanding documentation, approvals, and project information.
  • Assist with the preparation of project reports and progress updates.
  • Maintain organized project files, including work orders, service agreements, and
completion certificates.
  • Support the coordination of HVAC installation, maintenance, and service projects.
3. Variations, Claims, and Invoicing Support
  • Assist in preparing and tracking contract variations and additional works.
  • Maintain records of approved and pending variations.
  • Coordinate with the finance team regarding progress claims, invoices, and payment
documentation.
  • Verify supporting documents before submitting claims or invoices.
  • Follow up on outstanding approvals and documentation required for billing.
  • Assist in tracking contract costs and identifying discrepancies in project
documentation.
4. Compliance and Document Control
  • Maintain records of insurance certificates, licences, safety documents, and
subcontractor compliance requirements.
  • Track expiry dates and follow up on documents requiring renewal.
  • Ensure required project documentation is submitted and stored appropriately.
  • Assist in maintaining compliance with client requirements, company policies, and
applicable Australian regulations.
  • Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of contractual and commercial information.
5. Client and Supplier Communication
  • Communicate professionally with clients, suppliers, subcontractors, and internal
teams.
  • Respond to contract-related inquiries and direct technical or commercial issues to the
appropriate personnel.
  • Follow up on pending contracts, purchase orders, approvals, and project
documentation.
  • Assist in preparing emails, letters, reports, and contract-related correspondence.

Qualifications and Requirements
  • Previous experience in au contract administration, project administration, or a similar
role.
  • Understanding of Australian construction or commercial contracting processes is an
advantage.
  • Experience in HVAC, air conditioning, construction, mechanical services, or facilities
management is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with contracts, purchase orders, variations, progress claims, and project
documentation.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
  • Experience with project management, job management, or document management
software is an advantage.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple contracts, deadlines, and priorities.
  • Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with different stakeholders.

Job Overview

The Solution Operations Associate Director plays a hands-on, tactical role at the intersection of product strategy, service operations, and client delivery. This position translates the strategy and direction for IQVIA information assets and solutions into clear, scalable operating processes that enable consistent execution across client service teams.

The role translates product strategy into scalable operational processes, policies, and service guidance that support effective delivery to customers. The Associate Director connects product and client service teams, influences cross-functional stakeholders to drive timely decisions, and uses customer feedback and operational performance insights to continuously improve the service experience.


Essential Functions

  • Translate product strategy and business direction into scalable operating models, service processes, policies, and client-facing execution plans.
  • Serve as the operational bridge across product, solutions management, account management, client service, and delivery teams to ensure alignment and consistent execution.
  • Establish and manage operating cadences, service standards, procedures, and commercial guidance, including pricing and discounting practices.
  • Gather customer and internal feedback to identify trends, resolve service gaps, and drive continuous improvement across products and the client experience.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives, managing priorities, timelines, and decisions while influencing stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Monitor operational performance, identifying risks and driving mitigation strategies to support service delivery.
  • Make informed decisions in ambiguous or evolving situations, balancing business needs and operational risks.
  • Lead change management efforts, building alignment and driving adoption of new processes and ways of working.
  • Develop training, enablement, and communications to ensure teams understand product offerings, processes, and service expectations.
  • Provide leadership and guidance to client service professionals and contribute to broader solution operations and client service strategy.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • 7+ years of experience in operations, product operations, client services, service delivery, information services, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate product or business strategy into practical operational processes and customer-facing execution.
  • Strong operational mindset with experience evaluating operational performance, identifying and mitigating risks, improving processes, establishing cadences, and driving cross-functional decisions.
  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional projects and partnering effectively with product, project management, and client-facing teams, including demonstrated ability to influence and drive outcomes without direct authority.
  • Healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceutical, or healthcare data experience preferred; experience in other data- or information-intensive industries may be considered.
  • Strong client orientation with experience incorporating customer feedback into improvements to products, services, or operating models.
  • Strong business acumen, communication, change leadership, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and make sound decisions with incomplete information.
  • Management or team leadership experience with the ability to develop talent and build effective partnerships.
  • Naturally curious, proactive, and comfortable operating in an evolving and sometimes ambiguous environment.
  • Knowledge of IQVIA information assets, databases, and products is preferred but not required; prior IQVIA client service experience is a plus.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

IQVIA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable law.

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

raw.description:
The Commercial Analytics Director leads ACV's commercial intelligence function, turning data into decisions that grow revenue, strengthen customer relationships, and improve operational performance across our physical and digital channels. The ideal candidate pairs strong business acumen with genuine mathematical and statistical depth, fluency with databases and BI tooling, and the ability to translate complex analysis into clear stories for both executives and customers. A significant part of the role is customer-facing: partnering with Commercial Solutions and Sales to produce custom, account-level analyses that show existing and prospective commercial customers how remarketing vehicles upstream or downstream with ACV advances their own KPIs. Familiarity with the automotive wholesale and remarketing industry is a strong plus. Key Responsibilities Analytics Leadership & BI Strategy

Define and own the commercial analytics and business-intelligence strategy, aligning the analytics and BI roadmap with ACV's growth objectives.

Establish best practices for analytics, reporting, data visualization, and data governance across commercial functions.

Partner with executive leadership to define the KPIs and executive dashboards that guide strategic decisions.

Drive automation and scalability in reporting to reduce manual effort and speed time-to-insight.

Manage departmental priorities, budgets, and vendor relationships; foster a culture of curiosity and continuous improvement.

Commercial Account Reporting & Business Development Analytics

Own recurring performance reporting for commercial accounts across dealer, fleet, financial-institution, rental, OEM, and commercial-consignor segments.

Partner with Commercial Solutions and Sales to run custom, account-level analyses that quantify the value ACV delivers to each customer.

Demonstrate to existing and prospective commercial customers how remarketing vehicles upstream or downstream with ACV supports their KPIs — for example, days-to-sale, net proceeds and price retention, transportation and reconditioning costs, and channel mix.

Translate findings into compelling, executive-ready and customer-ready materials that support business development, renewals, and account expansion.

Develop customer segmentation and lifetime-value views that identify high-value accounts and growth opportunities.

Remarketing Center Operations — KPIs & Dashboards

Establish and own KPI dashboards for Remarketing Center Operations, giving leadership clear visibility into throughput, cycle time, inspection and condition quality, inventory flow, and cost-to-process.

Partner with operations leadership to define metrics, targets, and reporting cadences.

Surface bottlenecks and improvement opportunities that increase operational efficiency and vehicle liquidity.

Revenue, Pricing & Margin Analytics

Analyze auction pricing, buyer demand, conversion rates, and vehicle performance to support revenue growth.

Support pricing analytics across auction fees, digital services, transportation, reconditioning, and ancillary products, including elasticity and profitability considerations.

Monitor gross margin, revenue mix, and profitability across customer segments.

Advanced Analytics & Statistical Modeling

Apply sound statistical methods and, where appropriate, machine learning to improve commercial performance.

Develop predictive and segmentation models spanning:

Customer retention and churn Revenue and demand forecasting Vehicle pricing optimization Inventory and buyer-propensity modeling Sales opportunity scoring

Bring quantitative rigor and clear judgment to how models are built, validated, and communicated.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Finance — partner on budgeting, forecasting, and profitability analysis.

Sales & Commercial Solutions — measure territory and pipeline performance, acquisition, retention, and account growth.

Marketing — evaluate campaign performance and customer-acquisition costs.

Operations & Digital Product — improve auction efficiency, inventory flow, and marketplace optimization.

Qualifications Required

Bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline — Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Analytics, Finance, or a related field.

10+ years in commercial analytics, business intelligence, revenue/strategy analytics, or a closely related field.

5+ years leading and developing analytics teams.

Strong foundation in applied statistics and quantitative methods (e.g., regression, forecasting, segmentation, experimentation, and statistical inference).

Advanced SQL, with hands-on experience working directly in relational and/or cloud databases and data models.

Proven ability to design and build executive-grade KPI dashboards in BI platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.

Director-level experience leveraging large language model (LLM) tools (such as Claude) to develop an industry-leading suite of analytics and business-intelligence tools.

Strong financial and quantitative modeling skills.

Track record partnering with sales, pricing, or commercial organizations and presenting to executive leadership.

Ability to translate complex analysis into clear narratives for both executive and customer audiences.

Preferred

Master's degree (MBA, Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, or a related field).

Experience in automotive, wholesale vehicle auctions, remarketing, fleet management, mobility, retail automotive, or marketplace businesses.

Proficiency in Python or R for advanced analytics.

Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

Experience with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred).

raw.description:
ABOUT CHANGING LIVES PRODUCTIONS:

Changing Lives Productions is the in-house video production company of Dhar Mann Studios, the #1 creator of scripted positive content online. With over 163 million followers and 82+ billion views across YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok, our videos receive more than 1 billion views each month.

We produce several hours of original content weekly with messages of compassion, kindness, and altruism that resonate with viewers of all ages. Our stories tackle real-life challenges and deliver powerful life lessons that resonate with global audiences.

Founded by Dhar Mann, named the “Moral Philosopher of YouTube” by The New York Times, a Time Top 100 Creator, and ranked #2 on Forbes’ 2025 Top Creators list—our founding principle is simple but ambitious: We’re not just telling stories. We’re changing lives.

BIG PICTURE:

We’re looking for an Assistant Editor who keeps our post-production pipeline organized and moving. You’ll collate and prep project files for our VFX and color teams, and manage the digital assets behind every episode we produce.

This is a hands-on support role. You’ll make sure editors, VFX artists, and colorists get clean, complete, correctly structured files on time, and that every piece of footage, project file, and finished master is ingested, organized, backed up, and archived.

Why this role matters

We deliver several hours of original content every week. Missing media, broken links, or poorly prepped turnovers cost our VFX and color teams hours they don’t have.

A well-run library, with clear naming, accurate metadata, and reliable archives, means faster turnarounds, easy re-versioning, and no lost work. You’ll be the person who makes handoffs between editorial, VFX, and color seamless.

HOW YOU’LL SPEND YOUR TIME:

Assistant editorial: file collation and handoffs

  • Collating all project files, media, graphics, music, and SFX for each episode into a complete, correctly structured package
  • Relinking offline media, consolidating projects, and making sure nothing is missing before a handoff
  • Organizing project bins, sequences, and timelines so editors can pick up work without delays
  • Syncing audio and video, and building stringouts or selects when requested
  • Tracking each episode’s status and flagging missing assets or technical issues early

VFX prep

  • Preparing VFX turnovers: exporting plates with handles, reference clips, and EDL/XML files to spec
  • Naming and numbering VFX shots consistently and logging them in the VFX tracker
  • Packaging shot notes, reference frames, and editor instructions with each turnover
  • Bringing returned VFX shots back into the timeline and checking them for sync, frame accuracy, and version

Color prep

  • Preparing locked cuts for color: simplifying timelines, flattening tracks, and removing unsupported effects
  • Exporting XML/AAF/EDL files and reference videos for the colorist
  • Confirming all source media is linked and accessible for the grade
  • Conforming and patching graded media back into the edit, then QC’ing against the reference

Digital asset management

  • Ingesting and verifying camera footage, audio, graphics, and music using checksum-verified offloads
  • Maintaining folder structures, file-naming conventions, and version control across raw footage, projects, and deliverables
  • Logging and tagging assets with accurate, searchable metadata (series, episode, talent, shoot date, usage rights)
  • Uploading all working files and backups to the server in the agreed path, so any editor can pick up a project
  • Creating proxies, transcodes, and alternate versions (textless, clean, localized) as needed
  • Exporting and QC’ing final masters to spec (resolution, codec, aspect ratio, captions, loudness)
  • Archiving completed projects to long-term cloud and offline storage, and retrieving archived media on request
  • Monitoring storage capacity and keeping drives and servers clean per retention guidelines
  • Keeping asset trackers, delivery logs, and archive records up to date

WHAT YOU HAVE:

  • 3–5+ years of experience as an assistant editor, media manager, or in post-production operations
  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, including Project Manager, consolidating and relinking media, and proxy workflows
  • Hands-on experience preparing VFX turnovers and color handoffs (EDL, XML, AAF, plates with handles)
  • Working knowledge of codecs, formats, frame rates, resolutions, and export settings, and the ability to spot technical issues during QC
  • Exceptional organization and attention to detail, with the discipline to keep naming, folder structures, and metadata consistent under tight deadlines
  • An understanding of backup and archival best practices (3-2-1 rule, checksum verification with tools like Hedge or ShotPut Pro, cloud and LTO storage)
  • Proficiency with Google Sheets, Excel, or Airtable for tracking assets, turnovers, and deliveries
  • Clear, proactive communication, especially when flagging missing files or delays

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with DaVinci Resolve and After Effects
  • Experience with DAM/MAM and review platforms (Frame.io, Iconik, Air, CatDV, or similar) and shared storage (Google Drive, Dropbox, LucidLink)
  • Basic understanding of music licensing, clearances, and usage rights
  • Experience in a high-volume content studio or episodic workflow

WHO OVERSEES YOU:

The Assistant Editor reports to the Jr. Post Production Manager.

WHO YOU OVERSEE:

No direct reports at this time.

WHERE IT ALL GOES DOWN:

You’ll work remotely from home or a personal office and log hours in Dhar Mann Studios’ time-tracking software.

WHEN THE MAGIC HAPPENS:

The typical schedule is 40 hours per week. Specific hours and shift overlap with the US team will be discussed during interviews

Salary: $15

raw.description:
AI Technology Partners (AITP) is a leader in delivering cutting-edge generative AI solutions and managed services, specializing in secure, customizable AI deployments for enterprises. Our offerings are designed to help organizations unlock the full value of AI while maintaining robust security and compliance across their infrastructures.

About the role

At AI Technology Partners (AITP), we empower enterprises to scale revenue & profit —with secure, compliant generative AI solutions.

In this role, you’ll lead the design and delivery of agentic systems that orchestrate tools, data, and policies to solve real business workflows—safely, reliably, and at scale. If you like greenfield architecture, fast iteration, and measurable impact with enterprise clients, this is your playground.

What you'll do

Architecture & System Design (Agentic)

  • Design multi-agent architectures with robust state management, memory, and routing.
  • Choose and implement leading frameworks such as LangGraph/LangChain Agents, Microsoft AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex Agents, Semantic Kernel, or Haystack Agents—and justify trade-offs.
  • Build modular components (planners, tool registries, policy guards, evaluators) that are reusable across clients and domains.

Tooling & Orchestration

  • Integrate enterprise tools and data sources via function/tool calling, webhooks, and event-driven flows (Queues/Service Bus/Functions).
  • Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns with vector stores (Azure AI Search, pgvector, MongoDB Atlas, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus) and structured knowledge (SQL/Graph).
  • Add deterministic fallbacks, circuit breakers, and caching to keep latency and cost predictable.

Reliability, Observability & MLOps

  • Define SLIs/SLOs for agent runs; implement tracing, metrics, and logging (e.g., Langfuse + OpenTelemetry) and build dashboards for run-level analytics.
  • Create evaluation harnesses (automatic + human-in-the-loop) using tools such as Ragas, DeepEval, promptfoo to measure groundedness, task success, safety, and cost.
  • Productionize with CI/CD, environment promotion, feature flags, and canary strategies; optimize cost-per-task and time-to-success.

Safety, Security & Governance

  • Enforce content and safety policies (redaction, classification, guardrails) with policy-as-code; implement role/tenant isolation and data minimization.
  • Collaborate with security teams to align to ISO 27001/SOC 2/NIST/HIPAA/GDPR contexts; deliver audit-ready evidence for agentic workflows.
  • Build privacy-first patterns (no data exfiltration by default, least-privilege tool access, secure prompt/trace storage).

Product & Client Impact

  • Work directly with enterprise client teams to translate business processes into agentic designs; present trade-offs and proofs-of-value that lead to production.
  • Partner with solution leads to create domain-specific agents (e.g., RFP assist, incident RCA drafting, knowledge ops) and reusable templates.

Qualifications

Must-have

  • 5–8+ years in software/platform engineering with recent production LLM applications (not just prototypes).
  • Hands-on expertise with agentic frameworks (one or more of: LangGraph/LangChain Agents, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex Agents, Semantic Kernel, Haystack Agents) and tool/function-calling patterns.
  • Strong RAG engineering across vector DBs, chunking/embedding strategies, metadata/search ranking, and grounding techniques.
  • Proven track record building observable, cost-aware, and secure LLM systems (tracing, evals, guardrails, secrets/IAM, PII handling).
  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: Python/TypeScript, async patterns, APIs, testing, CI/CD, containerization.
  • Clear communicator who can interface with clients and write crisp technical docs.

Nice to have

  • Azure-first experience (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Azure Functions/Container Apps/AKS, Private Link/VNet, Key Vault, Entra ID).
  • Cross-cloud exposure (AWS/GCP) and hybrid integrations; experience with enterprise connectors (SharePoint/OneDrive, ServiceNow, Salesforce).
  • Experience with structured output, constrained decoding, JSON Schemas, and program-of-thought planning.

Location

  • Remote, US-based candidates preferred. The role may involve working across multiple time zones.

How we work

  • Ownership & velocity: Small team, big surface area. You’ll design, ship, and iterate quickly.
  • Security by design: Data governance and safety are table stakes, not afterthoughts.
  • Evidence over vibes: We measure task success, grounding, and cost—and improve with data.
  • AI as leverage: We use LLMs to accelerate engineering—not replace it.

Compensation

  • We offer a competitive and flexible compensation package aligned to experience, scope, and engagement model. This may include base salary, performance incentives, and equity participation, designed to reward meaningful contributions and impact.

What we offer

  • Challenging work on meaningful, production agentic systems for enterprise clients.
  • Learning & sharing culture with deep dives, brown bags, and support for certifications/publication.
  • Inclusive, flexible workplace—bring your whole self; work where you do your best thinking.

How to Apply
Interested candidates are encouraged to submit their resumes and a brief cover letter outlining relevant experience and why they are a good fit for this role.

AI Technology Partners is committed to equal employment opportunity in all practices and reaffirms that there shall be no unlawful discrimination against any employee or applicant for employment on the grounds of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

raw.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead HawkAI, an enterprise AI venture for US logistics brokerages, carriers, and warehouse operators. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

HawkAIdeploys always-on, multi-channel "AI workers" that autonomously manage high-volume freight communications across calls, texts, and emails, integrating directly with core freight systems including TMS, load boards, and broker/carrier databases. The platform handles track-and-trace calls, appointment scheduling, carrier rate negotiation, proof-of-delivery capture, and shipment status updates end-to-end — autonomously resolving 90%+ of routine communications and escalating only exceptions to human staff. Rather than another point tool layered on top of existing systems, HawkAI is designed to operate as the always-on communication layer for logistics teams, enabling them to focus on exceptions and value-driving work.

We are now seeking the founder to lead the venture from here.

Market Context

  • The US logistics BPO market for outsourced communications is approximately $26B, representing a major automation opportunity in a labour-intensive industry

  • Approximately 150,000 US freight forwarders, 3PLs, and warehouses form the target market, with tiered subscription pricing yielding a $1.5B annual TAM

  • Mid-sized US brokerages handle thousands of daily calls, with staff unable to answer or follow up on every transaction, contributing to OTIF (On Time/In Full) penalties and costly delays

  • Early customers deploying AI communication assistants report approximately 33% lower operating costs and significantly faster call resolution

  • AI supply chain software is growing at approximately 23% CAGR globally from 2025–2031, with North America seeing 30–45% annual growth in AI-driven logistics spend

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning across freight brokerages, 3PLs, carriers, and warehouse operators

  • Customer Development — Lead pilots with mid-sized to enterprise freight brokerages, convert them to paid engagements, and build the go-to-market motion targeting Heads of Logistics, Supply Chain, and Operations

  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback, with a focus on TMS and load board integrations, conversational AI quality, and autonomous workflow execution

  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction

  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

  • Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement

  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

  • Direct exposure to logistics, supply chain, freight brokerage, transportation, or B2B enterprise software serving these industries, with familiarity in AI agents/LLMs

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

Unser Ziel ist es nicht, die Größte Google & YouTube Ads Agentur zu werden, sondern die Beste! Wir sind bereits eine der führenden Agenturen in Europa mit einem glasklaren Fokus: Wir implementieren Google & YouTube Ads als Growth Engine für internationale D2C-Brands ab 5 Mio. Jahresumsatz.

  • Fließendes Englisch und Deutsch ab B2-Niveau: Du arbeitest mit deutschsprachigen Anzeigentexten und Kundenfeedback.
Ein Plus, aber kein Muss: Du hast ein gutes Gespür für UGC-Formate, Direct-Response-Storytelling und die Besonderheiten der verschiedenen Plattformen.

ProPublica is an independent, nonprofit newsroom that produces investigative journalism in the public interest.

ProPublica’s Local Reporting Network helps produce vital, investigative journalism in communities where such stories would otherwise not be done. Now entering its ninth year, the program will be taking on 15 new partnerships over the course of 2026.

Applications for all 15 projects are open now and will be considered on a rolling basis using the deadlines below. There will be three fellowship periods and we will select five fellows for each round:

  • Spring cohort - This round is now closed.
    • Application deadline: Rolling, no later than Feb. 5, 2026, by 11:59 p.m. ET.
    • Open to: All applicants from English-language local and regional newsrooms in the United States and its territories.
    • Fellowship dates: April 1, 2026, through March 31, 2027.
  • Summer cohort. This round is now closed
    • Application deadline: Rolling, no later than May 1, 2026.
    • Open to: Newsrooms in the states listed as eligible through our 50 State Initiative.
    • Fellowships dates: July 1, 2026, through June 30, 2027.
  • Fall cohort
    • Application deadline: Rolling, no later thanJuly 27, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. ET.
    • Open to: Newsrooms in the remaining states listed as eligible through our 50 State Initiative. (Note: This list of states will be updated in July 2025.)
    • Fellowship dates: Oct. 1, 2026, through Sept. 30, 2027.

For these partnerships, ProPublica will provide a grant, to be paid in monthly installments, to the selected newsroom reflecting the annual salary (up to $80,000 plus a 25% allowance for benefits) for one full-time reporter in each newsroom. Successful candidates will have a proven track record of investigative reporting and impact, and will provide a memo about the project they’re proposing working on for the duration of the one-year partnership.

Strong applications will express why the project needs to be told in your community — we’re eager for projects that can’t be done anywhere else. They will also explain how the project would benefit from this collaboration, potentially including the role that our data, research and engagement reporting resources could play, and they will discuss how the project may resonate with both local and national audiences.

Once accepted, local reporters will work from and report to their home newsrooms while receiving extensive support and guidance for their work from ProPublica, including collaboration with a senior editor and access to the nonprofit newsroom’s expertise. The work will be published or broadcast by your newsroom and simultaneously by ProPublica.

ProPublica reporters and editors are available to answer questions or to give you feedback on your application before you submit it. Please reach us at .

We are unable to accept applications via email. No phone calls, please.

We know there are great candidates who may not fit into what we’ve described above or who have important skills we haven’t thought of. If that’s you, don’t hesitate to apply and tell us about yourself.

We are dedicated to improving our newsroom, in part by better reflecting the people we cover. (Here is a breakdown of our staff.) We are committed to diversity and building an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and ages. And we are taking steps to meet that commitment. We especially encourage members of traditionally underrepresented communities to apply, including women, people of color, LGBTQ+ people and people with disabilities. We are an equal opportunity employer and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age or any other status protected under applicable law.

About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, trusted by thousands of web publishers and app developers across the globe. By blending proprietary AI technology with elite optimization techniques, we safeguard and maximize publisher revenue. We are a culture-centric, 100% remote organization that heavily values Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen, and Collaboration. We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules.and schedule autonomy. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on.

About the Role

We are seeking a Group Product Manager (GPM) who is both a world-class operator and an player- coach. In this role, you will have the dual responsibility:

  1. Champion Product Excellence: You will mentor and guide other Product Managers across MonetizeMore, transforming our product organization into a best-in-class, outcome-driven Product Operating Model (inspired by modern frameworks like Marty Cagan’s Silicon Valley Product Group).
  2. Own the Product Management for Advanced Ads (Interim): You will drive the strategy, growth, and execution of Advanced Ads—our leading ad-management platform powering over 150,000 websites worldwide.

You don't just build features to check boxes; you build solutions that move the needle on business goals, and you enable the PMs on your team to do the same.

Core Responsibilities

1. Leadership & Product Operating Model Excellence

  • Mentorship & Coaching: Serve as a player-coach to other Product Managers, guiding them to elevate their product craft, execution, and strategic thinking.
  • Outcome over Output: Evangelize the shift from feature-factory mindsets to an outcome-driven culture. Train PMs to obsess over business results and customer impact rather than sprint velocity and story points.
  • Framework Standardizing: Implement modern product operating model principles (e.g., product trios, data-informed decision making, rapid prototyping, and de-risking assumptions).
  • Evangelize Kaizen: Introduce continuous feedback loops and structured retrospective frameworks to scale product management maturity across the entire organization.

2. Product Ownership: Advanced Ads

  • Strategy & Vision: Define and execute the long-term product vision for Advanced Ads, integrating its flexible ad injection, targeting, and Google Ad Manager capabilities deeper into the MonetizeMore ecosystem.
  • Continuous Discovery: Lead continuous product discovery to uncover publishers' deepest pain points, validating ideas for usability, feasibility, viability, and value before writing code.
  • Revenue & Growth: Take end-to-end ownership from monetization strategy to GTM. Prioritize the roadmap based on clear ROI, keeping a laser focus on customer lifetime value (LTV) and monthly recurring revenue (MRR).
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with Engineering, Design, and Growth to ensure features aren't just shipped, but successfully adopted and commercialized.
  • Long-Term Plan: Determine the long term needs of this business line: resource requirements, investment, propose and collaborate on the best organizational design for the success of the product.
Who You Are
  • The Experienced Leader: You have 8+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 3+ years leading or mentoring other PMs. Ad tech, SaaS, or WordPress ecosystem experience is a massive plus.
  • The Operating Model Expert: You have deeply practical experience working within a modern, empowerment-based Product Operating Model. You know what "good" looks like and possess the empathy and patience to coach others there.
  • The Owner Mindset: You treat your product like your own business. You aren't afraid to dive into raw data to find hidden patterns or jump on a customer call to understand friction points.
  • Data-Driven & Courageous: You monitor product health metrics religiously. If the data shows a feature is failing to deliver the expected outcome, you have the courage to pivot or kill it.
  • The Clear Communicator: You effortlessly translate complex technical logic or abstract product frameworks into digestible, high-impact value propositions for stakeholders, engineers, and your team.

What We Offer

  • True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with a flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle.
  • Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company.


Assessment Requirement: As part of our hiring process, all applicants who pass the resume screening will be required to complete a TestDome assessment. Only candidates who successfully pass the assessment will be invited to proceed to the Culture Fit Interview.

raw.description:
the role

This is a remote-first (UK-based) role, with access to our London office and/or other WeWork coworking spaces across the country. Some in-person attendance is expected for board and leadership meetings, plus international travel as required.

We are looking for a commercially intuitive General Counsel to lead the legal function of our established and rapidly scaling AI business as we launch our flagship innovation, Workspace, to market. This is a senior leadership role covering UK legal matters, with oversight across major international jurisdictions. You will support a growing global customer base in sectors including media and entertainment, retail, healthcare and the public sector.

You will be a trusted member of the executive leadership team, supported directly by the c suite and balancing legal risk management with pragmatic, business-focused advice.
You will build on the foundations of our existing legal function, with real freedom to shape how the department works moving forwards. The legal team’s structure, ways of working and tools are yours to design as you grow a high-performing in-house team. You will oversee external counsel relationships and own Stelia's legal, compliance, governance and regulatory frameworks as we expand globally.

Uniquely, you will build the legal function's technology on Stelia's own platform. You will act as an internal design partner to our product and engineering teams, and make legal a showcase for what our technology can do.

what you'll do

1. Corporate & Governance

  • Advise the Board and CEO on corporate structure, governance and shareholder matters.
  • Lead legal due diligence for upcoming funding rounds.
  • Oversee company secretarial duties, board meetings and statutory filings in the UK and internationally.
  • Draft, review and negotiate shareholder agreements and investment documentation.

2. Product Launch & Go-to-Market

  • Ensure the legal and regulatory foundations for the continuous development of Stelia's technologies are in place, and scale them as adoption grows.
  • Own Stelia's customer-facing terms, including master services and SaaS agreements, acceptable use policies, SLAs and data processing agreements.
  • Maintain Stelia's positions on AI-specific contract issues, including ownership of outputs, IP indemnities for generated content, use of customer data for model training and performance disclaimers.
  • Review marketing materials and product claims so that statements about AI capabilities are accurate and defensible.
  • Advise on sector-specific requirements in target markets with external support, such as medical device and clinical safety rules in healthcare, and procurement, security accreditation and transparency obligations in the public sector.

3. Commercial Contracts

  • Introduce tools and processes that streamline contracting, balancing efficiency with Stelia's risk appetite and growth trajectory.
  • Establish playbooks for scalable contract management across a global client base.
  • Lead the negotiation and drafting of complex technology, SaaS, licensing, distribution and strategic partnership agreements.

4. Data Protection, AI Regulation & Compliance

  • Act as the company's lead on data privacy, leading compliance with the UK GDPR, EU GDPR, CCPA and other international frameworks.
  • Classify Stelia's products under the EU AI Act and other emerging AI regimes, and run the resulting transparency, documentation and governance obligations.
  • Monitor and advise on developing AI legislation and ethical frameworks globally, and lead the strategy for managing conflicting requirements between jurisdictions.
  • Oversee export controls and sanctions compliance as Stelia sells internationally.
  • Partner with product and engineering teams to embed legal and regulatory compliance in product development.
  • Develop internal compliance policies and training programmes.

5. Legal Technology & Operations

  • Build the legal function's technology stack on Stelia's own platform and in-house models.
  • Act as an internal design partner to product and engineering, translating legal workflows into clear product requirements and feeding back on early tools.
  • Position the legal function as a reference use case for Stelia's technology, supporting customer conversations where useful.
  • Set governance for using AI tools on confidential and privileged material, covering legal privilege, access controls and data retention.

6. Employment & People

  • Line-manage Stelia's VP of People (or equivalent).
  • Oversee employment law compliance in the UK and coordinate with international counsel and employers of record for global hiring.
  • Own the legal framework for remote-first working, including staff working from abroad (tax, permanent establishment and immigration risk), remote working policies and health and safety for home workers.
  • Keep employment contracts compliant and maintain consultancy agreements.
  • Manage the administration of employee and advisor incentive schemes, including liaising with accountants on valuations.
  • Advise on employee disputes, restructurings and cross-border HR matters.

7. Intellectual Property

  • Lead IP strategy to protect proprietary AI models, code, datasets and related technology.
  • Manage Stelia's trademark and patent portfolios, working with the COO and CAIO to identify new registration needs through the product development lifecycle.
  • Advise on open-source software use and licensing risks.

8. Disputes & Risk Management

  • Proactively identify, assess and mitigate legal and regulatory risks.
  • Manage litigation, arbitration and IP disputes globally, working with external counsel where needed.
  • Advise on client and vendor disputes, settlement negotiations and contract enforcement.
  • Provide legal input into crisis management, incident response and data breach notification processes.

9. Leadership & Strategy

  • Build and manage a high-performing in-house legal team as we scale.
  • Act as a key strategic advisor to the CEO and executive team on growth, customer sectors and international expansion.
  • Build strong relationships with regulators, industry bodies and external stakeholders.
  • Represent Stelia publicly on the regulatory pressures facing the AI industry.

Your First 12 Months

  • Continue to develop the legal and regulatory foundations for Workspace, and scale them as customer adoption grows.
  • Build out the company's global legal framework, policies and compliance programme.
  • Stand up the legal function's technology stack on Stelia's own platform, and implement scalable processes for contract negotiation and management.
  • Provide executive-level legal input on fundraising, partnerships and international expansion.
  • Oversee international subsidiary incorporation as customer or employee growth requires.
  • Position Stelia as a leader in ethical and legally compliant AI deployment.

who we're looking for

Experience & Qualifications

  • Qualified lawyer in England & Wales with at least 7 years' PQE.
  • Experience in a high-growth technology company (AI or deep tech preferred).
  • Background in commercial contracts, IP and data protection preferred but other specialisms considered.
  • Experience taking a technology product to market, including customer terms and regulatory readiness (preferred).
  • Familiarity with international regulatory frameworks governing technology, data and AI, and insight into the ethical considerations surrounding AI.
  • Experience managing legal issues across multiple jurisdictions (preferred).
  • Previous exposure to fundraising and M&A (preferred).

Skills & Competencies

  • Ability to balance risk with business objectives, and to prioritise the work that enables growth.
  • Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong leadership, with experience building and managing legal teams.
  • Ability to translate complex legal issues into clear, actionable advice for non-lawyers.
  • Comfortable working directly with engineers, testing early-stage tools and articulating legal workflows as product requirements.
  • High ethical standards, with a proactive approach to governance and compliance.

Personal Attributes

  • Strategic thinker with a growth mindset.
  • Collaborative, resilient and adaptable, and comfortable with fast-shifting priorities in a dynamic market.
  • Comfortable creating structure where it does not yet exist.
  • Effective in a remote-first team, communicating clearly in writing and across time zones.
  • Willing and enthusiastic to provide industry commentary, with a legal slant, as part of Stelia's leadership team.
  • Global outlook, with cultural awareness and sensitivity to diverse jurisdictions.
  • Passion for AI and emerging technologies, with curiosity about their legal and ethical implications and about legal technology's potential to improve compliance and company management.
  • Understands the importance of strategic partnerships within the tech ecosystem, and is willing to build relationships beyond the legal sector.

what you can expect from us

  • Meaningful work on problems that are still being defined
  • Early ownership and the opportunity to shape your work
  • A culture where ideas are openly challenged and explored
  • Working alongside highly capable, ambitious peers
  • A remote-first, flexible environment built on trust
And let’s not forget some of our benefits… With us, you can enjoy:
  • £120,000 - £140,000 depending on experience
  • Unlimited holiday
  • £200 equipment budget to get you set up to work best, whether that’s at home or in our office
  • Enhanced sick pay and family leave offerings
  • Company-wide bonus scheme
  • Share options
  • Access to our London office and other WeWork locations

raw.description:
How will you make a difference to PMI? The Manager, Marketing Data and Analytics owns the business data architecture and metric definitions behind Marketing's numbers, and leads the team that measures Marketing. The role defines how marketing, customer, product, and revenue data should be modeled, decides what each metric means, and ensures those definitions are implemented consistently across Snowflake, BI, and natural-language analytics. The role combines hands-on technical depth with team leadership. The individual is expected to be advanced in SQL, to design analytical data models, and to profile, reconcile, and diagnose data directly, so they can specify what engineering builds and verify that the result represents the business correctly. They are equally expected to lead three to four analysts, set the standards those analysts work to, and develop the team's technical capability. Data Engineering and the Snowflake team own ingestion, infrastructure, orchestration, transformation pipelines, and semantic view implementation. This role represents Marketing in the design of the data layer, writes the specifications those teams build against, and is accountable for ensuring the resulting data products correctly represent the business.

What you’ll bring to the role:

Business Data Architecture, Metric Definitions, and Context

Own Marketing's canonical metric definitions and the business logic the governed semantic layer implements, and arbitrate those definitions when marketing, finance, and reporting platforms disagree. Specify the semantic models for the most complex and cross-domain marketing use cases, and validate what the Snowflake team builds against that specification. Own the business data architecture for Marketing, defining the facts, dimensions, grain, relationships, hierarchies, and conformed dimensions that connect marketing, customer, product, transaction, and engagement data. Design analytical models that answer cross-domain questions spanning acquisition, engagement, conversion, certification, membership, renewal, and revenue. Write advanced SQL to profile data, validate sources, reconcile metrics, build reusable datasets, and investigate complex customer and business questions. Determine what unstructured content, such as business documentation, definitions, and prior analyses, must be retrievable alongside structured metrics for natural-language and agent-based analysis, and maintain source-to-metric mappings and lineage. Own the business questions, expected results, and synonym glossary behind the Verified Query Repository supporting Cortex Analyst and natural-language analytics. Own the context layer that makes Marketing's data interpretable to analysts and AI agents, including entity descriptions, metric documentation, approved analytical uses, and known limitations of each source. Diagnose discrepancies across Snowflake, BI, Adobe Analytics, marketing platforms, finance reporting, and operational systems. Identify gaps in source data, identity resolution, event structures, and dimensional consistency before they become downstream reporting issues. Define ownership boundaries between source systems, engineered data products, semantic models, and reporting layers.

Team Leadership and Capability

Lead, coach, and develop a team of three to four analysts spanning paid media, customer and lifecycle analytics, and digital analytics. Set the Marketing Analytics roadmap, allocate the team against it, and manage intake and prioritization from across Marketing. Establish and enforce analytical standards including SQL quality, peer review, testing, documentation, and reuse. Review the team's models, queries, and analyses before they reach stakeholders, and hold the quality bar for what gets published. Grow the team's depth in dimensional modeling, data modeling practice, and analytical rigor through direct coaching and review. Manage performance, hiring, and development planning for the team.

Marketing Measurement and Performance Analytics

Define and govern core marketing KPIs including revenue, conversion, CAC and CPA, ROAS, retention, funnel progression, pacing to plan, and channel efficiency. Own the integrity and narrative of recurring executive performance reporting, including monthly business reviews and QBR analytics, with the team producing the underlying analysis. Determine how platform-reported, attribution-based, financial, and incrementality-based measures reconcile, and establish where each is appropriately used. Lead attribution, cohort, and incrementality work so it produces decision-grade guidance on marketing investment, building the harder analyses directly. Own predictive modeling for Marketing, including membership churn and renewal propensity, certification lapse and recertification likelihood, and product and cross-sell propensity, alongside segmentation, lifecycle, and cohort analysis across CRM, web, campaign, commerce, certification, and membership data. Define the features, target definitions, validation approach, and performance thresholds for predictive models, determine when a score is reliable enough to act on, and establish how scores are refreshed, monitored for drift, and activated in campaign, lifecycle, and retention programs. Set analytical standards for A/B testing, holdouts, geo experiments, and conversion-lift studies within the marketing analytics practice, including hypotheses, test populations, success metrics, and readouts. Partner with Product and Marketing to define measurable funnels, customer states, lifecycle stages, and behavioral signals for considered-purchase journeys, and hold a clear distinction between attribution, correlation, prediction, and causal measurement when results are communicated.

Analytics Delivery and Enablement

Govern Marketing's analytical products in enterprise BI and visualization platforms, ensuring definitions are sourced from the semantic layer rather than rebuilt in the tool. Use Adobe Analytics to investigate digital behavior, traffic, customer journeys, and conversion performance, and work with data from Adobe Experience Platform, CRM, commerce, and paid media systems. Apply working knowledge of digital event instrumentation, tagging, identity, and schemas to identify measurement and architecture issues at the source, and establish where AI-assisted tooling is applied to SQL development, analysis, documentation, and testing. Expand governed self-service and AI-assisted analytics for Marketing across Snowflake, BI, and natural-language surfaces, and represent Marketing data and context requirements in the Marketing AI reference architecture. Define what Marketing data and context AI agents and natural-language tools are permitted to reach, at what grain, and under what access and accuracy controls, and own the evaluation approach that tests answer accuracy before release and monitors it as data and definitions change.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Serve as Marketing's primary analytical counterpart to Data Engineering, Data Architecture, and Data Governance. Translate business questions into analytical requirements and data-product specifications that engineering can build against. Partner with Data Engineering on transformation logic, data contracts, source integration, model design, and data-quality requirements. Partner with Performance Marketing, Brand, Digital, Product, Lifecycle, and Regional Marketing on measurement needs and analytical priorities. Present analytical findings, performance trends, and recommendations to senior leadership.

Scope of Role Leads a team of three to four analysts covering marketing, customer, and performance analytics, while personally designing analytical data models and validating them. Accountable for Marketing's business data architecture, metric definitions, context layer, predictive models, and executive performance reporting across certification, membership, e-learning, events, and other product lines. Hands-on ownership concentrates in data model design, metric reconciliation, predictive model validation, evaluation of analytical accuracy, and diagnosis of cross-system discrepancies. Semantic view implementation sits with the Snowflake team, built to this role's specification. Routine reporting, campaign analysis, and dashboard production sit with the team, under this role's review and standards. Data Engineering, Technology, and the Snowflake team own ingestion, infrastructure, orchestration, platform access, transformation pipelines, and semantic view implementation. Enterprise data governance policy, cataloging, and cross-domain stewardship sit outside this role; the incumbent partners with Data Governance and applies those standards within Marketing.

Role Qualifications:

10+ years across marketing analytics, customer analytics, analytics engineering, or related disciplines, including prior leadership of an analytics team. Demonstrated experience leading and developing an analytics team while remaining hands-on technically. Working knowledge of ETL and ELT concepts, transformation pipelines, data dependencies, and data-quality controls, with the ability to read, review, and challenge logic developed by engineering teams. Experience working within layered, dimensional, or medallion data architectures. Experience integrating and analyzing data across CRM, marketing, digital, commerce, and transactional systems. Development and governance of analytical products in an enterprise BI platform, preferred. Customer data platform architecture including identity resolution, event schema design, and audience activation. Marketing measurement including attribution, experimentation, incrementality, conversion, CAC and CPA, and ROAS, and experience directing or building predictive and propensity models such as churn or retention. Advanced SQL including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, transformations, data profiling, reconciliation, and validation, applied to large-scale datasets. Working hands-on experience with Snowflake or another modern cloud data platform, sufficient to profile, query, validate, and reconcile at scale. Demonstrated experience designing business and analytical data models, and specifying them for engineering teams to build against. Dimensional modeling including facts, dimensions, grain, cardinality, slowly changing dimensions, hierarchies, and conformed dimensions. Metric governance, lineage, and reconciliation across multiple enterprise systems. Strong analytical storytelling and executive communication. Familiarity with semantic layer and context technologies such as Snowflake Semantic Views, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, dbt Semantic Layer, or Looker, preferred. Digital analytics using an enterprise web analytics platform, preferred. dbt or comparable SQL transformation framework, preferred. Python or R for advanced analysis, automation, or modeling, preferred. Git and version-controlled analytics development, preferred. Data testing and observability frameworks, preferred. Marketing mix modeling, geo experimentation, conversion lift, causal-inference methods, and machine learning applied to churn, propensity, or lifetime value, preferred. Up to 10% if required.

raw.title: Analog Design Engineer (Graduate)
raw.excerpt: THE COMPANY Established in early 2024, at Analogue Insight we are bridging the Analogue and Digital Worlds for Tomorrow through our Chiplet Solutions.
raw.description:
THE COMPANY
Established in early 2024, at Analogue Insight we are bridging the Analogue and Digital Worlds for Tomorrow through our Chiplet Solutions. Our core expertise lies in developing cutting-edge Chiplet technology that serves as the building block for advanced communication systems. Our Chiplets are designed to offer high performance, scalability, and integration flexibility, enabling our clients to achieve breakthroughs in computation speed, data processing, and connectivity. For more information about us, check out our website (Analogue Insight) and LinkedIn Page (Analogue Insight™: Overview | LinkedIn).

THE ROLE
We are seeking a talented and motivated Graduate Analog Design Engineer to join our team and contribute to the design of high-performance serial links and data converters for our chiplet solutions. Working alongside experienced analog designers, you will help design, simulate and verify ADC, DAC, RX, TX and PLL building blocks on advanced FinFET technology nodes, and see your work go into customer silicon. This role is well suited to recent graduates with a strong foundation in analog circuit design who want to learn fast through deep, hands-on work in a small, high-impact team.
Hiring Manager:Christian Borelli, Founder and CSO.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Analog & Mixed-Signal Block Design: Design and optimise sub-blocks of ADC, DAC, RX, TX and PLL circuits (e.g. amplifiers, comparators, bias circuits, references, clock buffers) under the guidance of senior designers.
  • Simulation and Validation: Run transistor-level simulations (DC, AC, transient, noise, Monte Carlo and PVT corners) and mixed-signal verification using Cadence, AMS and SystemVerilog to confirm robust performance across operating conditions.
  • Performance Optimisation: Learn and apply design techniques to improve key parameters such as gain, bandwidth, linearity, noise, jitter, power consumption and speed.
  • Layout Collaboration: Work closely with layout engineers to communicate matching, symmetry and parasitic-sensitive nets, and run post-layout extracted simulations to close the design.
  • Modelling & Scripting: Build behavioural models (e.g. Verilog-A) and scripts (e.g. Python, SKILL or OCEAN) to speed up simulation, analysis and design-check flows.
  • Silicon Characterization Support: Help prepare test plans and support lab characterisation and debug of silicon as projects progress.
  • Design Documentation: Document your designs, simulation results and design-review material clearly, supporting efficient knowledge sharing within the team.
  • Technology Awareness: Keep learning about advances in high-speed SerDes, data converters and chiplet interfaces such as UCIe.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
Must-have Technical skills:
  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Electrical/Electronic Engineering or a related field, with a focus on analog/mixed-signal circuit design (recent graduates and those graduating within the next 6 months are welcome)
  • 0–2 years of industry experience, including internships, placements or research projects
  • Strong grasp of analog fundamentals: CMOS device physics, small-signal analysis, feedback and stability, noise, and mismatch
  • Hands-on circuit design and simulation experience with Cadence Virtuoso/Spectre or similar tools, through coursework, thesis or internship projects
  • Understanding of at least one of: data converters (ADC/DAC), PLLs/clocking, or high-speed TX/RX circuits
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for detail
Nice-to-have:
  • Thesis, research or internship work on FinFET or other advanced-node technologies
  • A completed tape-out and/or lab measurement experience
  • Familiarity with Verilog/SystemVerilog, Verilog-A or AMS modelling
  • Scripting experience (Python, MATLAB, SKILL or shell) and comfort in a Linux environment
  • Publications or conference contributions in circuits (e.g. ISSCC, VLSI, CICC, ESSCIRC)

Soft & Professional Skills:
  • Clear, structured communication in professional English—able to explain complex results concisely
  • Collaborative and feedback-oriented mindset, open to learning from design reviews
  • Strong ownership, reliability, and follow-through
  • Curious, self-motivated attitude, eager to learn and explore new tools or methods
  • High level of integrity and professionalism in representing the company and handling sensitive information.

OUR CULTURE
We’re a fully remote team of around 45 people distributed across the UK, Armenia, Italy, the US, Estonia, India, and beyond. We believe great talent is everywhere!
  • Our values are our north star:We Grow Together, We Win Together. Excellence Builds Relationships. Trust Is Our Currency. Results Matter, but People Create Them.
  • Connected, even remotely:We invest intentionally in staying connected through regular all-hands, 1:1s, technical reviews, and informal coffee chats, so collaboration feels natural and human despite the distance.
  • High ownership, real impact:Everyone contributes directly to customer-facing IP. Your work doesn’t disappear into layers of management – it ships.
  • How we work:We move fast but thoughtfully, communicate openly, and balance autonomy with support. Technical decisions are debated openly and grounded in data, trade-offs, and first-principles thinking.

WHY JOIN US
  • Remote-first flexibility – work from anywhere, with flexible hours
  • Equipment & setup – we’ll provide the tools you need to succeed
  • High-impact projects – design real analog IP used in customer silicon
  • Supportive team culture – a dedicated manager and a team of colleagues ready to help
  • Competitive, transparent compensation– adjusted for your location and engagement model
  • Learning & growth – AI–DLP sessions, technical deep dives, and peer-led knowledge sharing that build both technical depth and system-level perspective

RECRUITMENT PROCESS
  1. Founder Call (30 min) – mutual introduction and interest alignment
  2. Technical Interview(90 min) – fundamentals, reasoning, and problem-solving
  3. Optional: Second Technical Interview (60 min) – another deep-dive into specific topics, which might include a presentation that we'll let you know about in advance
  4. HR & Culture Call (45 min)–values, collaboration style, and ways of working
  5. Offer & Next Steps– we send the offer and kick off the onboarding process.
Disclaimer: This is our standard process for most roles. For more senior, specialized, or higher-authority positions, we reserve the right to amend or tailor these steps as we see fit.

If you don’t meet every requirement but feel excited about the role, apply anyway. We value curiosity, integrity, and potential as much as experience.

raw.description:
about the role:

Location: Barcelona, Spain / Eastern Europe / Remote (for those countries only)
Duration: 3–6 months (6 months strongly preferred, with potential to convert to a full-time role)

Crisalix is looking for a hands-on, technically capable individual who is confident using modern AI tools and can apply them to solve real business challenges.
This is not a research role or a theoretical AI position. The focus is on using current AI technologies, automation platforms and programming skills to quickly develop practical applications, prototypes and working solutions that improve internal workflows and business efficiency.
The role involves working closely with colleagues across different departments to understand business needs and turn ideas into functioning solutions.
While speed and creativity are important, we also value technical quality. Applications should not only work but also be well-structured, reliable and maintainable so they can be improved or developed further.
What the role involves
  • Participating in internal discussions to understand business problems and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Building rapid prototypes using AI tools, programming and automation platforms.
  • Developing internal applications, AI assistants and automated workflows.
  • Connecting different tools and business systems through APIs and integrations.
  • Reviewing, debugging and improving code, including AI-generated code.
  • Testing solutions, gathering feedback and making improvements.
  • Ensuring applications are properly structured, documented and maintainable.
  • Preparing prototypes that can be handed over to developers for further development or production.
  • Identifying opportunities where AI can improve efficiency and automate manual processes.
The expectation is that candidates can move quickly from concept to working prototype while understanding the technology behind what they build.

our ideal candidate would have:

We are looking for someone who is already comfortable working with modern AI tools and automation platforms. This is not an internship designed to teach someone AI from scratch.

Candidates should be practical, technically curious and capable of building applications rather than simply discussing ideas.
Importantly, we are looking for someone with enough programming knowledge to understand, troubleshoot and improve the code behind their solutions, including code generated with AI assistance.
Ideally, candidates will have experience with:
  • Modern AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Grok, Microsoft Copilot and OpenAI APIs / GPT Agents.
  • Prompt engineering and developing structured AI workflows.
  • Automation platforms such as Zapier, Jotform, Make, n8n, Airtable Automations, Pipedream, Retool, Bubble and Flowise.
  • Basic-to-intermediate programming skills, preferably Python and/or JavaScript.
  • Understanding and improving AI-generated code rather than relying entirely on AI to produce working solutions.
  • Connecting applications through APIs, webhooks and integrations.
  • Low-code or no-code development environments.
  • Basic software development principles, including clean code, debugging, testing and documentation.
  • Rapid prototyping, testing and improving applications based on feedback.
Essential requirements
  • Practical experience building AI-powered applications, automations or workflows.
  • A good understanding of at least one programming language.
  • Strong spoken and written English, allowing effective communication within an international team.
  • The ability to work independently and solve technical problems.
  • Availability for a minimum of 3 months, ideally 6 months.
We are not looking for an experienced software engineer, but candidates should have sufficient technical knowledge to build solutions that can be understood, maintained and improved by others.

we also value very positively:

Additional qualities

  • Sharp, analytical thinking and the ability to understand new problems quickly.
  • Strong business understanding, ideally with a background or interest in business operations.
  • A genuine passion for AI and regularly experimenting with new technologies, tools and integrations.
  • A hands-on mindset and the ability to turn ideas into practical solutions quickly.
  • Experience with Git, version control or collaborative development.
  • The ability to explain technical solutions clearly to non-technical colleagues.
  • Good organisational skills, attention to detail and a willingness to learn from feedback.
  • Previous personal, academic or professional projects demonstrating practical AI or programming experience.
A strong interest in business operations and efficiency is important. Understanding how companies work and identifying where technology can make a meaningful difference is just as valuable as technical curiosity.
What this internship offers
  • The opportunity to work on real internal AI and automation initiatives.
  • Direct exposure to business operations and product development.
  • Hands-on experience creating applications that can have a measurable impact.
  • An international working environment with collaboration across departments.
  • The opportunity to explore and experiment with modern AI technologies.
  • A fast-moving environment where ideas can quickly become working solutions.
  • The possibility of continuing in a full-time role depending on performance and company needs.
Locations

Our preferred locations are:

  • Barcelona, Spain (preferred).
  • Other locations within Spain.
  • Eastern Europe
    NB: Please only apply if you are in one of the locations listed above (even for a remote role)
Duration
The minimum internship duration is 3 months, although a 6-month commitment is strongly preferred to allow sufficient time to develop, implement and evaluate the results of AI initiatives.
Compensation
This is a paid internship with a monthly stipend depending on location.
How to apply
Please submit your CV in English, together with a short description of AI tools, automations or applications you have already built. Links to GitHub repositories, project demonstrations or examples of your work are particularly welcome.
To strengthen your application, we also encourage you to include a short video introduction (1–2 minutes) in English, explaining:
  • The AI tools and technologies you regularly use.
  • Examples of automations, applications or prototypes you have developed.
  • Your personal contribution to these projects and the programming skills you used.
  • Why you are interested in this opportunity.
This helps us better understand your communication skills, technical experience and how you approach practical challenges.
