Job title:Site Reliability Engineer

Reports to:Director, Site Reliability Engineering

Department:Central Services

Location:Alpharetta, GA or Remote

Grade:19

About Priority:

Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy-to-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue - empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter.

We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities.

At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people tobe known for results- bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive.

About the Role:

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will keep Priority's payment, payables and banking platforms available, fast and recoverable. You will be the dedicated SRE for a product workstream: owning its monitoring, alerting and runbooks, taking on-call, and helping lead incident response and postmortems alongside development teams and Senior SREs.

This is a hands-on role for an engineer with a few years of production experience who wants to grow into owning reliability for a domain end to end.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and tune monitoring, dashboards and alerts; reduce alert noise and close detection gaps.

  • Help resolve production incidents, and lead triage of lower severity alerts.

  • Facilitate blameless postmortems and drive follow-up actions to closure.

  • Define SLIs and SLOs for critical user flows.

  • Write runbooks and playbooks for AI-assisted alert triage.

  • Automate toil through scripting, infrastructure as code and CI/CD improvements.

  • Support safer releases through readiness reviews, load testing and canary deployments.

  • Contribute to failover and disaster recovery testing.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Delivery & Execution: You participate in incident response, and manage post incident workflows, ensuring effective postmortems occur within SLA.

  • Product Quality & Reliability: Your services have SLOs, actionable alerts and current runbooks. Alert noise trends down, and detection and recovery times improve.

  • Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing: Engineers and monitoring teams use your dashboards and runbooks day to day, and postmortems lead to fixes rather than blame.

  • Business & Product Impact: Fewer incidents reach customers or affect business operations, and new features ship without losing stability.

  • Professional Growth: You lead at least one reliability project from design to rollout and are on a clear path toward Senior SRE.

Candidate Requirements:

Required:

  • 3-5 years of software, systems or DevOps engineering experience, including 2+ years in SRE or production operations.

  • Production on-call experience, including incident response and postmortems.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS and Kubernetes.

  • Experience building monitoring and alerting with modern observability tools.

  • Proficiency in a scripting or programming language (e.g., Python, Go, TypeScript).

  • Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred) and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Working knowledge of Linux, networking fundamentals and relational databases.

  • Clear written communication.

Preferred:

  • Experience in payments, fintech or banking, especially PCI DSS environments.

  • Familiarity with Kafka or other event-driven architectures.

  • Experience designing SLOs and error budgets.

  • Experience using AI tools in operations.

  • Cloud or Kubernetes certifications (e.g., AWS Associate, CKA).

Work Environment & Culture:

We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand -an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution. We are a results-driven team, grounded in our core values: ownership, authenticity, service, trust, innovation, and camaraderie.

Our culture is built for those who want to make an impact. We challenge each other to grow, celebrate progress, and support one another through shared goals and real connection. Whether you're building technology, serving clients, or supporting internal teams, you’ll be part of a company that empowers you to perform at your best and be known for results.

Compensation and Benefits:

Compensation range: [$111k-$143k]

We invest in the whole employee - personally and professionally. Our benefits package is designed to support your well-being, growth, and success - both inside and outside of work.

Financial Wellness

  • Bonus programs

  • 401(k) match

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • HSA and FSA options

  • Financial wellness resources and employee discount programs

Health & Well-being

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Mental health support for employees and dependents through Lyra Health

  • Family planning and women’s health benefits through Carrot

  • Gym membership reimbursement and virtual wellness programs (including yoga)

Time Off

  • 3 weeks PTO to start, with unlimited PTO after year one

Growth & Development

  • Education expense reimbursement

  • Leadership development programs

  • Certified Payments Professional (CPP) certification support

We believe great performance starts with feeling supported - and we’ve built our benefits with that in mind.

Traditional Physical Requirements:

  • Requires prolonged sitting, standing, bending, stooping and stretching.

  • Requires the ability to lift 10 pounds.

  • Requires eye-hand coordination, manual dexterity and a normal range of hearing and vision (with or without correction).

Join our team at Priority Technology Holdings, Inc. and be part of a dynamic and innovative company that is transforming the financial technology landscape. Together, we can shape the future of payments and banking solutions while providing unmatched value to our clients.

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

The Solutions Consultant is the evolution of the traditional Sales Engineering role, aligning how we best serve our customers in understanding their environment, providing solution guidance and ensuring value realization in their investment with Palo Alto Networks. As a Solutions Consultant you provide technical leadership and expertise and guidance in your customer’s security transformation journey. You will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives and ensuring value realization of their investment with Palo Alto Networks. You evangelize our industry leadership in on-prem, cloud, and security operations services that establish PANW as your customer’s cybersecurity partner of choice.


Your Impact


Curiosity is core to the Solutions Consultant role, and you see complex problems as opportunities to learn and deliver innovative solutions! You define your impact by:

  • Meeting and exceeding sales quotas by building and implementing strategic, technical account plans that target cross-platform solutions.

  • Ability to drive customer adoption of Palo Alto Networks Platform. Building customer relationships by helping customers achieve increased productivity, operational efficiency, security efficacy, and greater flexibility to innovate.

  • Continuously investing in yourself to develop technical and professional skills that drive your ever-increasing contributions to success of our customers while actively participating within the Solutions Consultant community and at industry events
  • Identifying technical stakeholders and cultivating relationships with key personas to build and drive a security architecture transformation roadmap

Qualifications

  • 6+ years experience in pre-sales/sales engineering

  • Experience in delivering cybersecurity solutions that solve technical challenges and influence new business initiatives is preferred
  • Influencing and gaining buy-in from key stakeholders, either in a customer-facing or internal role; prior experience in a pre-sales role is ideal
  • Creating and delivering technical presentations, workshops, or technical validation engagements
  • Experience in selling, designing, implementing, or managing one or more of the following solutions: Network Security, SASE, SaaS, CNAPP and/or SOC Transformation Technologies
  • Partnering with Customer Support functions to ensure successful implementation and adoption of sold solutions
  • Experience in complex sales involving long sales processes with multiple buying centers and multi-product solutions are preferred
  • This is a field sales position where travel requirements may be required to support in person customer meetings, please discuss with the recruiter on the specifics for this position.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Job Description

NetImpact Strategies is seeking a Senior Functional Specialist to join our delivery team supporting Federal clients. The ideal candidate combines client-facing leadership skills with hands-on functional expertise, bridging the gap between business needs and technical implementation. This role will lead delivery activities, manage project scope and timelines, and work directly with stakeholders to define and document business requirements, ensuring successful outcomes aligned with mission objectives. Ideal candidates are strong problem solvers, technically superb, naturally curious, and driven to deliver high-quality outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide thought leadership for product development, solution implementation, and continuous improvement.
  • Serve as the primary client-facing lead, managing communication, expectations, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Lead project planning, coordination, and execution across Agile or hybrid delivery methodologies.
  • Manage project scope, schedules, risks, dependencies, and quality to ensure successful delivery.
  • Facilitate requirements-gathering sessions and develop clear functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Act as the functional expert for a proprietary toolset, advising on capabilities, constraints, and solution feasibility.
  • Collaborate with technical teams, architects, and QA to ensure alignment between business needs, system design, and implementation.
  • Provide functional guidance during solution design, recommending approaches that balance usability, performance, and system constraints.
  • Review and guide development of functional deliverables including process flows, configuration documentation, and design artifacts.
  • Analyze existing business processes and recommend improvements that drive efficiency and mission success.
  • Support development of test scenarios, provide guidance throughout testing cycles, and assist with UAT execution.
  • Support training, deployment planning, and transition-to-operations activities.
  • Ensure all deliverables and project artifacts comply with Federal standards and quality assurance requirements.
  • Apply strong problem-solving, technical understanding, curiosity, and delivery focus to proactively address issues and identify opportunities for improvement.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Business Administration, Information Systems, or related field
  • 5-10 years of experience in IT project delivery roles, including at least 3 years in project management or business analysis within Federal environments
  • Experience interacting with AI (Artificial Intelligence) to support delivery of software modernization projects
  • Proven ability to interface with clients and senior stakeholders, facilitating discussions and driving consensus
  • Experience with requirements elicitation, process mapping, and functional documentation
  • Strong understanding of software delivery methodologies
  • Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor communication to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • US Citizenship required; must be eligible for a Secret clearance

Preferred

  • Prior Software Development background
  • Prior experience in Federal IT consulting or program delivery
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) or Certified Scrum Master (CSM) certification
  • ITIL or Agile Certification
  • Experience supporting modernization or digital transformation initiatives
  • Familiarity with Software Development and SaaS platforms in Federal environments
  • Knowledge of Federal acquisition, governance, and reporting processes

About Us

At NetImpact Strategies, we post salary ranges in compliance with the specific labor laws and regulations of each county and state, ensuring transparency and fairness in our hiring practices. This approach reflects our commitment to adhering to legal requirements and promoting equitable pay standards across all regions where we operate. The posted salary range for this role is $140,000-175,000. The posted salary range is not an exact indication of the actual compensation offered and is instead a range of what NetImpact, in good faith, could compensate at the lowest and most high end of the salary market. In general, NetImpact may not pay the top of the salary range. Compensations are determined by several mitigating factors including skillset, experience, trainings, location, and other factors including benefits packages.

Perks of working at NetImpact Strategies

  • Your health comes first – we offer comprehensive medical, dental, & vision insurance that starts the first of the month after you join the team
  • Invest in your future – 401(k) Plan – Immediately vested employer contributions; no matching required
  • Work hard, play hard – we offer a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) policy, one (1) additional day of paid wellness leave per calendar year, and observe ten (10) federal holidays
  • Pawsitively pawesome – Pet Insurance (because our little critters are part of our families, too!)
  • Invest in your education – Tuition reimbursement, internal training programs, & company-sponsored industry certifications!
  • Be part of a dynamic and collaborative work environment recently ranked by The Washington Post as a Top Work Place in 2019, 2021,2022, 2023, & 2024!
  • Have fun and celebrate and give back – Team building activities, community volunteering, quarterly HQ days, wellness events, happy hours, family fun events, and more!

NetImpact Strategies Inc. (NetImpact) has been a Trusted Advisor driving impact through digital transformation for the Federal Government for over a decade. We solve complex problems with innovation and agility to create meaningful, transformative, and enduring change. As Trusted Advisors, NetImpact professionals partner with customer agencies to deliver solutions that empower them to not only meet their missions but also realize their strategic vision through agile, outcome-focused solutions addressing both strategic and tactical requirements. We design and implement comprehensive, tailored solutions that are both mindful of the client's culture and organizational dynamics. NetImpact’s core values and commitment to a customer and results-oriented delivery approach has propelled our growth and enabled us to deliver impactful value across Strategic Consulting, Process Automation, Cloud, DevSecOps, Data and Analytics, and Cyber Security for the Federal Government.

ACCESSIBILITY NOTE

  • Data & Analytics Strategy: Oversee the application of advanced data analytics and AI solutions to solve complex challenges within the insurance space. Guide teams in developing data-driven insights that inform decision-making for clients.
  • Project Delivery & Execution: Ensure the successful and timely delivery of analytics projects, including P&C insurance data models, AI algorithms, dashboards, and reporting tools. Ensure all projects are aligned with client goals and industry standards.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Act as a trusted advisor to clients, managing communication and expectations while keeping internal stakeholders updated on project progress, challenges, and successes.

Candidate Profile:

  • Education: Bachelors or Masters degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field. An advanced degree is preferred.

  • Strong in SQL, Python, Spark, and data pipeline architecture
  • Deep understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Experience with BI tools like Power BI, Tableau, or Looker
  • Familiarity with MLOps and deploying machine learning models into production
  • Experience with Generative AI and other advanced data analytics tools.
  • Strong skills in data modeling, visualization, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Leadership Skills: Proven experience in managing and developing high-performance teams.
  • Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving: Ability to think strategically, analyze complex data, and provide innovative solutions to meet client objectives.
  • Preferred Skills: Exposure to other analytical tools and languages (Python, R) is a plus.
  • Familiarity with machine learning and AI algorithms relevant to the insurance domain.
  • Experience in consulting or with a professional services firm is an advantage.
  • This role is ideal for a seasoned data analytics professional with deep insurance expertise, ready to lead impactful analytics initiatives and develop client relationships.

raw.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are looking for a Head of Underwriting to drive underwriting activities across Digital Asset Financing. This is a senior, hands-on role requiring strong financial and credit analysis capabilities, sound commercial judgement and a deep understanding of counterparty risk.

You will assess financing opportunities, evaluate institutional counterparties and structure transactions that balance commercial objectives with robust risk management. Working closely with internal stakeholders, you will play a key role in evaluating complex transactions and supporting informed, timely decisions in a dynamic market.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the credit assessment of borrowers (funds, miners, trading firms, corporates) from initial due diligence through transaction evaluation and approval recommendations.

  • Analyse counterparty financial statements, liquidity, leverage, trading strategy, business models and overall creditworthiness.

  • Evaluate digital asset collateral, collateral coverage, market volatility, liquidity and liquidation risks, where applicable.

  • Assess operational and custodial setup of counterparties

  • Structure terms, recommending appropriate LTV, tenor, covenants and margining.

  • Identify and assess counterparty, market, concentration and operational risks associated with proposed transactions.

  • Prepare clear, evidence-based underwriting assessments and present recommendations to relevant decision-makers.

  • Monitor existing exposures, identify emerging risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to facilitate efficient transaction execution while maintaining disciplined underwriting standards.

  • Continuously enhance underwriting methodologies in response to evolving digital asset markets, products and risk dynamics.

Requirements

Requirements

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in underwriting, lending, credit risk, digital asset financing or a comparable field.

  • Strong expertise in financial analysis, counterparty assessment, loan structuring (LTV, rates, thresholds) and credit risk evaluation.

  • Understanding of collaterals including BTC/ETC, custody and transfers

  • Margin mechanics awareness, including margin requirements, collateralisation, loan-to-value ratios, margin thresholds and liquidation processes.

  • Counterparty due diligence experience, being able to effectively assess business models, ownership structures, operational capabilities and relevant risk factors.

  • Skilled in ongoing risk monitoring, collateral coverage, margin calls, margin breaches and timely escalation of emerging risks.

  • Understanding of digital assets, collateralised financing, cryptocurrency markets and associated liquidity and volatility risks.

  • Experience evaluating complex transactions and making well-reasoned recommendations based on quantitative and qualitative analysis.

  • Strong commercial acumen and the ability to balance business opportunities with prudent risk management.

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with exceptional attention to detail.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to articulate complex risk considerations to senior decision-makers.

  • High levels of integrity, accountability and independent judgement.

  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, international environment, navigating ambiguity and making sound decisions under pressure.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Job Title: Senior Consultant - Vault PromoMats

Job Location: London, United Kingdom

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As a Senior Consultant in our European Professional Services team, you will partner with top global pharma organisations to solve critical business challenges. By implementing Veeva’s Commercial Cloud products (PromoMats/DAM, and Medical), you will deliver cutting-edge, AI-powered solutions that drive the life sciences industry toward more connected, data-driven customer relationships.

You’ll lead business process due diligence, design and implement robust and scalable solutions, and drive successful projects, through a variety of roles including Project Manager, Lead Solution Architect and PO/Business Analyst.

What makes us different:

    • Autonomy and high trust and ownership culture: passion and effort directly lead to opportunities and real ownership from the start
    • Collaboration without competition: peers root for each other’s success, leadership is entirely accessible, and we tackle complex problems with a strict "no-ego" approach.
    • Meaningful Industry Impact: know your work makes a difference, by helping life sciences companies operate more efficiently and effectively

The ability to travel domestically and abroad is required (VISA not being handled by Veeva). The ideal candidate will be fluent in English and ideally one of the following languages: French, German, Italian, or Spanish. The role is ideally based in the area of a Veeva office (Barcelona, London, Paris, Frankfurt, Berlin), but other EU locations will be considered.

What You'll Do

    • Own delivery for implementation projects in project manager, functional analyst, solution architect, and stream lead roles
    • Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to drive the optimization and harmonization of business processes, and translate them into actionable and scalable solutions
    • Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with customer stakeholders across enterprise and smb organizations
    • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to internal teams and implementation partners
    • Contribute to internal initiatives to continuously improve service quality and delivery frameworks

Requirements

    • 5+ years of experience in technology implementation projects in one of the following roles: Project Manager, Functional Analyst, Solution Architect
    • Hands-on experience and confidence with Veeva PromoMats, Veeva Vault Platform, or Salesforce.com Platform
    • Experience working with a Pharmaceutical, Consumer Health or Medical Device organization
    • Strong consulting background with proven ability to architect, drive best practices, and manage stakeholder relationships
    • Strong and effective communication and presentation skills
    • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment across multiple assignments
    • Able to travel approximately 20%
    • Fluent in English (written and spoken)

Nice To Have

    • Implementation of regulated content management systems such as Veeva Vault, OpenText, SharePoint, Documentum, FirstDoc/FirstPoint, NextDocs, CARA, Vodori, etc.
    • Experience working with a DAM tool such as Aprimo, Adobe, Bynder, Box, etc.
    • An understanding of Claims, DAM (Digital Asset Management), Modular Content, MLR review, and European regulatory requirements (e.g., ABPI, ANSM, AIFA)
    • Understanding of life sciences compliance and computer systems validation requirements (e.g. GxP, GcP)
    • Project management certification (e.g. PRINCE2, PMP)
    • Veeva certification
    • Experience with product pre-sales, solution consulting, or engagement management

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
#RemoteUK
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
As an equal opportunity employer, Veeva is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and growing a diverse workforce. Diversity makes us stronger. It comes in many forms. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. We value people for the individuals they are and the contributions they can bring to our teams.

Job Title: Senior Safety Domain Expert - Falcon

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced pharmacovigilance professional to serve as our Senior Safety Domain Expert for Veeva Falcon. This role bridges ground-level case execution with macro-level safety operations, using your deep knowledge of case processing, MedDRA coding, database reconciliation, and global compliance to inform our AI driven automation tools. You will spend your days collaborating with our internal technical teams and external early adopters, acting as the definitive "Voice of the Customer" to ensure our platform delivers flawless safety automation.

What You'll Do

    • End-to-End Workflow Guidance: Advise product and engineering teams on the detailed steps of safety case intake, triage, validation, and advanced data reconciliation workflows
    • Ground-Truth Verification: Actively review and verify platform outputs across initial data entry, automated MedDRA coding assignment, and generated follow-up queries to ensure absolute data precision
    • Early Adopter Engagement: Interact directly with PV leads and processing specialists at early adopter organizations, translating their feedback into actionable platform enhancements
    • Stress-Test Scenario Building: Map out highly complex, multi-variable safety case scenarios to rigorously evaluate and calibrate the platform's reasoning boundaries

Requirements

    • 5+ years of active experience in Pharmacovigilance / Drug Safety Operations
    • Extensive hands-on knowledge of the complete case lifecycle, including validation criteria, database reconciliation, and global expedited reporting timelines
    • High proficiency with MedDRA coding rules and deep familiarity with mainstream safety databases (e.g., Veeva Safety, Argus, ArisG)
    • Strong collaborative mindset with the ability to confidently present operational perspectives to non-clinical technical partners and customers

Nice to Have

    • Prior experience contributing to the design, implementation, or user-acceptance testing (UAT) of automated pharmacovigilance intake solutions
    • Prior experience with, or a strong baseline curiosity about, agentic AI, automated workflows, or next-generation cloud platforms in clinical trials

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $120,000 - $180,000
    • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. The Inside Sales Manager position is focused on generating orders/revenue and meeting sales targets. This role requires managing a portfolio of accounts within a designated market, leveraging effective communication and sales strategies. The Inside Sales Manager will work collaboratively with the team to drive customer engagement, foster relationships, and optimize sales processes. Additionally, the position may involve supervising and coaching other Inside Sales Managers to ensure cohesive and efficient team operations. Essential Duties

Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, ensuring their needs and expectations are met consistently. Sales Target Achievement: Develop and execute sales strategies to meet and exceed established targets, contributing to overall revenue goals. Team Leadership and Collaboration: Provide effective feedback to the team, fostering a collaborative and high-performance work environment. Voice of customer: Regularly communicate customer feedback internally, fostering a customer-centric culture and driving continuous improvement initiatives across the organization. Sales Process Optimization: Continuously review and enhance sales processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness. Performance Metrics Analysis: Analyze key performance indicators to assess team and individual performance, identifying areas for improvement. Training and Development: Participate in and lead training sessions for the sales team, ensuring continuous skill development and product knowledge.

Additional Duties

Market Research: Conduct periodic market research to identify trends, opportunities, and potential challenges. Share findings with marketing to develop lead generation strategies. Documentation and Reporting: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of sales activities (thru CRM process), preparing regular reports for management. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with other departments such as marketing, application support group, customer support and others to ensure alignment in overall business objectives. Workshop Participation: Participate in relevant committees or working groups to contribute insights and coordinate efforts across the organization. improvement initiatives across the organization. Special Assignments: Undertake special projects or assignments as designated by upper management, demonstrating flexibility and adaptability. CRM Software: Utilize Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software for client management and sales tracking.

Essential Requirements

Preferred candidate will have a minimum of three (3) year's sales experience in a related high technology field. Understanding of radiation detection fundamentals and of the nuclear industry as a whole. Ability to apply fundamental and technical sales skills. Understanding of government and common commercial procurement processes. Ability to manage, strategize, and coordinate sales activities. Strong focus and drive to close opportunities, win deals, grow the business. Excellent written and oral communication skills. Technical skills/understanding/ability to be able to quickly develop a thorough knowledge of Mirion equipment and understanding of customer applications; ability to recommend solutions; and ability to operate and demonstrate Mirion equipment. Ability to collaborate well and form good partnerships/relationships with other team members and departments needed for success (Engineering, Physics, Operations, Sales, Management, Marketing, Operations, etc). Self-motivated; Ability to function independently. Excellent time management skills. Strong organizational skills. Professional demeanor, appearance in representing the company.

Additional Requirements

Participation in local/regional/national conferences and meetings. Maintain knowledgeable on current sales techniques and fundamentals. Knowledge of and ability to utilize SalesForce. Strong knowledge and ability to utilize Microsoft suite of products (Excel, PPT, Word, etc).

Education & Experience Requirements

Education

Bachelor’s degree in technical area preferred, or equivalent training and experience.

Experience

Three (3) or more year's prior sales experience, preferably in a technical field. Demonstrated equivalent ability can provide equivalence to years of experience.

Mirion offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes Vacation & PTO Time, medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) retirement savings plan with matching, HSA and FSA options, life and disability insurance, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness resources, and several voluntary benefits including legal assistance, identity protection, and pet insurance.

Senior Project Manager

inecta Food | Remote (Canada) | Full-time

About Role

inecta is hiring a Senior Project Manager to own the full delivery of our ERP implementation projects. You’ll manage client relationships, keep projects on plan and on budget, and turn customers into long-term reference clients. You’ll also mentor other project managers and help improve how our delivery team works.

Key Responsibilities

Client Handling and Upselling.

  • Build and maintain strong client relationships that support inecta’s profitability and strategic goals, while identifying and developing new business opportunities.
  • Ensure all actions are aligned with inecta’s best interests, recognizing the importance of retaining profitable reference clients.
  • Proactively and effectively manage client expectations.
  • Lead client relationships with credibility, navigate sensitive conversations, resolve concerns and minimize escalations, and maintain client satisfaction as a means to further inecta’s business success.

Plan-Driven Project Execution

  • Ensures proactive, plan-driven project execution across multiple projects by using the project plan as the authoritative guide for tasks and timelines.
  • Drive accountability by ensuring assigned resources complete tasks as scheduled, with timely status updates reflecting actual progress.

Risk Management & Communication

  • Independently assess and escalate risks appropriately, keep stakeholders informed.
  • Identify potential deviations early and take corrective action to maintain alignment with the plan.

Financial Accountability & Scope Management

  • Anticipates and manages budget risks.
  • Manages change orders with clients and ensures alignment with internal stakeholders.
  • Trusted for reliable financial ownership.
  • Maintains and proactively communicates accurate and up to date scope and budget status.

Responsive Self-Starter

  • Responds promptly to internal and external communications.
  • Maintains consistent communication and follows through on open items.
  • Proactively drives workstreams forward, anticipates needs, and takes ownership of planning and delivery with little oversight.

Mentorship & Leadership

  • Leads internal initiatives, sets delivery standards, and trains others.
  • Champions onboarding, documentation, and team-wide process maturity.

Requirements

  • Degree in business, accounting, finance, MIS, or similar; or equivalent work experience.
  • Familiarity with current technology trends and AI tools; hands-on experience with Claude is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills; participates confidently in internal and client conversations.
  • Self-starter who works well independently but is also a team player.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering ERP or SaaS implementation projects.
  • Successfully managed 10+ projects with budgets in excess of $100K, including full lifecycle planning, execution, budget management, and delivery. Experience with complex projects such as ERP or construction is required. Experience simultaneously managing multiple projects is a strong plus.
  • Demonstrated track record of managing client issues independently and having difficult conversations with stakeholders. Successfully prevent and minimize escalations by proactively managing expectations.
  • Track record of anticipating budget risks. Managed change orders with clients and ensures alignment with internal stakeholders. Trusted for reliable financial ownership.
  • Demonstrated track record of proactive, plan-driven project execution, using the project plan as the authoritative guide for tasks and timelines.
  • Demonstrated track record of managing high-pressure client and internal situations effectively. History of balancing multiple tasks while maintaining strong relationships. Demonstrates proactive communication and collaboration across teams, fostering a positive, solutions-oriented work environment.
  • Track record of mentoring and coaching other project managers, and of initiating process improvements, tooling, and delivery standards that strengthen the wider team.
  • Must be willing and able to travel 15% to 20% and have or can get and keep a valid passport.
  • Physically and mentally able and willing to navigate food client facilities which can include standing and walking for several hours, loud noises, bright or flashing lights, climbing stairs and ladders, wearing protective/sanitary gear such as hair nets, gloves, boots or shoe covers, lab coats, or coveralls.
  • Proximity to food products including raw meat and/or live animals.
  • Reacting to visual and auditory safety cues.

Compensation

$120,000 – $150,000 CAD

Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Compensation Bonus opportunity
  • Remote work
  • Annual paid time off benefits
  • Medical, Dental, Life, and disability insurance plans
  • No waiting period on benefits
  • RRSP

About inecta

inecta Food is a cloud ERP platform purpose-built for the food and beverage industry — designed from the ground up for the way food companies actually operate. For over 20 years, we’ve partnered with processors, manufacturers, distributors, growers, and retailers across North America and around the globe.

We’re a ~80-person company with staff across Canada, the US, and India. We’re fast paced, cutting edge, highly technical, deeply knowledgeable. We value teamwork, energy, ownership, bias to action, and genuinely caring about our clients.

inecta is an equal opportunity employer.

Salary: $120,000 – $150,000 CAD

raw.description:
Position Title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
Location: Remote (In the U.S)

Other Considerations: U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident (Required)

POSITION SUMMARY

Sprezzatura is seeking a Senior DevSecOps Engineer to serve as the technical security engineering lead supporting cybersecurity modernization for the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA).

The Senior DevSecOps Engineer will lead hands-on engineering efforts to identify and remediate security and control deficiencies across the platform's cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, shared platform services, and supporting systems. This position will help move the Platform toward a modern, engineering-first approach to cybersecurity by translating security requirements and identified control gaps into durable technical solutions.

This role will work closely with security and RMF personnel to translate control deficiencies, vulnerabilities, assessment findings, and Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms) into actionable engineering work. The Senior DevSecOps Engineer will then lead or directly implement remediation through infrastructure, configuration, access policy, system rules, pipeline, and code changes.

The ideal candidate combines deep cloud and DevSecOps engineering experience with a strong understanding of cybersecurity, vulnerability remediation, secure software delivery, and federal security requirements. This individual should be comfortable operating as both a hands-on senior engineer and technical security SME in a complex, large-scale cloud environment.

This position will participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the team's senior technical security engineering lead and Security Engineering Subject Matter Expert (SME)
  • Lead hands-on remediation of security vulnerabilities, control deficiencies, and technical security debt across platform infrastructure and shared services
  • Translate security control requirements, assessment findings, vulnerabilities, and POA&Ms into actionable engineering solutions
  • Implement security remediation through code, infrastructure, configuration, system rules, access policies, and other technical changes
  • Design, implement, and maintain automated security quality gates within GitHub Actions and platform CI/CD pipelines
  • Integrate and improve capabilities including SAST, DAST, Software Composition Analysis (SCA), secrets detection, dependency scanning, and other automated security checks
  • Develop and maintain secure configuration baselines for cloud infrastructure and Platform components
  • Implement and improve centralized secrets management and secure credential-handling practices
  • Lead vulnerability remediation efforts across AWS infrastructure, containers, applications, dependencies, CI/CD pipelines, and shared Platform components
  • Provision, secure, and sustain resilient CI/CD runner infrastructure within VA cloud environments
  • Implement automation supporting patching, vulnerability remediation, and security configuration management
  • Improve security logging, monitoring, and alerting capabilities to support timely detection and response to security events
  • Integrate Platform systems with security monitoring and telemetry capabilities, including applicable CSOC and continuous-monitoring requirements
  • Configure and improve cloud-native security capabilities such as AWS GuardDuty, AWS Security Hub CSPM, and related AWS security services
  • Lead or support technical implementation associated with DAST/WASA, SAST, secrets detection, and runtime security
  • Partner with RMF and security personnel to determine appropriate technical remediation for NIST SP 800-53 control deficiencies
  • Partner with the Security Automation Engineer to ensure implemented controls generate reliable security evidence and measurable security posture data
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance to VA.gov product and engineering teams implementing security requirements
  • Lead technical planning and requirements definition when remediation requires coordination across multiple systems or engineering teams
  • Document implemented security controls, technical remediation, architecture decisions, and operational procedures necessary to sustain improvements
  • Participate in technical reviews, incident response, troubleshooting, and a 24/7 engineering on-call rotation as required

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree and 10+ years of relevant experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Significant hands-on experience in DevSecOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or security engineering
  • Advanced experience with AWS, preferably including experience supporting complex production cloud environments
  • Strong experience designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, preferably using GitHub Actions
  • Experience implementing security controls through infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, automation, or software development
  • Experience with vulnerability identification, prioritization, remediation, and validation
  • Experience implementing or operating application and infrastructure security tooling, including SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets detection, container scanning, or comparable capabilities
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management technologies
  • Strong knowledge of cloud security, IAM, secrets management, network security, logging, monitoring, and secure configuration practices
  • Experience working with containerized workloads and modern cloud-native architectures
  • Proficiency with one or more scripting or programming languages used for infrastructure and security automation
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex production infrastructure and security issues across multiple layers of a technology stack
  • Ability to communicate technical security risks and remediation approaches to engineering, security, product, and program stakeholders
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the background investigation and access required to support Department of Veterans Affairs systems
  • Ability to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience supporting federal systems operating under the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF)
  • Knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 security controls and experience translating control requirements into technical implementations
  • Experience supporting systems operating at FISMA Moderate or High impact levels.
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud or VA Enterprise Cloud (VAEC) environments
  • Experience with AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, IAM, CloudTrail, CloudWatch, or comparable cloud security capabilities
  • Experience developing or maintaining GitHub Actions runners and secure CI/CD execution infrastructure
  • Experience with Kubernetes, containers, and container security
  • Experience with Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation and software supply-chain security
  • Experience with continuous monitoring, security telemetry, or integration with enterprise security operations capabilities
  • Experience remediating findings resulting from security assessments, vulnerability scans, penetration testing, WASA/DAST, or similar activities
  • Familiarity with federal ATO processes, POA&Ms, control implementation evidence, and independent controls assessments
  • Experience serving as a technical lead or SME responsible for coordinating security engineering work across multiple teams

WORKING CONDITIONS

Standard Business hours are Monday through Friday. Occasional extended or weekend hours may be required based on operational needs. Travel may be required from time to time for customer meeting and industry events.

PAY RANGE

The base salary range for this position is $150,000 to $170,000 annually, depending on geographic work location, relevant experience, skills, education, internal equity, security clearance, and contract requirements. Geographic salary ranges are determined in accordance with the company's compensation practices and represent a good-faith estimate of the compensation for this position at the time of posting.

BENEFITS

Sprezzatura offers a comprehensive and flexible benefit package to include:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision
  • Health Saving Account (when enrolled in eligible plan) with Company contribution
  • Company paid Life, Accidental Death, Short-term & Long-term Disability
  • Voluntary Accident, Hospital Indemnity, & Critical Care Insurance
  • Voluntary Medical & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Accrued Paid Time Off & Company Paid Holidays
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company match

WORK AUTHORIZATION

Sprezzatura participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

Sprezzaturais a mission-driven, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) that thrives at the intersection of technology, innovation, and impact. We specialize in secure, scalable, and human-centered digital solutions that accelerate government transformation. Our work spans DevSecOps, health IT modernization, intelligent automation, benefits delivery, and digital communications. We partner with agencies ready to evolve—delivering not just strategy, but measurable execution. Rooted in operational excellence and driven by curiosity, we help our clients navigate complexity with clarity—turning ambitious ideas into real-world outcomes. No buzzwords. Just impact.

CLEARANCE REQUIREMENT

This position may require Public Trust clearance. Candidates must undergo a background investigation, including a review of employment history, education, criminal record, and financial history. The clearance process ensures that the candidate is reliable, trustworthy, and of good conduct and character. Employment offers are contingent upon successful passing a public trust clearance process.

EEO STATEMENT

Sprezzatura is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Applicants have the right to discuss, disclose, or inquire about compensation without retaliation. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities.

This job description is not intended to be an employment contract and does not guarantee employment for any specific duration.

raw.description:
How will you make a difference to PMI? We are looking for a Creator & Social Video Producer to develop engaging, social-first content across PMI’s organic and paid social channels. This hands-on role will partner closely with the Manager, Social Media to build and grow a strong user-generated content (UGC) pillar while bringing PMI’s brand and stories to life through compelling, platform-native content. You’ll own the creative process from concept to delivery, including concepting, scripting, capturing, editing, writing, and versioning video, photography, motion, and static assets. We’re looking for someone with strong production skills, sharp brand judgment, and a deep understanding of social platforms, trends, and audience behaviors who can turn briefs, insights, and real-time moments into timely, relevant content. You’ll also support content capture at PMI events, partnering with internal stakeholders to plan coverage, identify engaging moments, and quickly deliver polished, channel-ready assets.

What you’ll bring to the role:

Own the end-to-end development of trend-led and UGC-style social content, including ideation, research, scripting, storyboarding, shot planning, production, on-camera participation, editing, caption writing, versioning, exporting, and final delivery. Concept, film, photograph, and edit high-quality short-form video and visual content using both mobile devices and professional camera equipment, selecting the production approach that best fits the story, platform, timeline, and audience. Serve as a primary on-site content creator at PMI's premier events, capturing keynote moments, attendee experiences, behind-the-scenes stories, executive and subject matter expert interviews, community perspectives, and other real-time brand storytelling opportunities. Plan event coverage in close partnership with stakeholders and cross-team partners — developing content concepts, shot lists, interview prompts, schedules, equipment plans, and rapid-turn workflows — and publish or deliver timely content during and immediately following events. Create platform-native content for TikTok, Instagram Reels and Stories, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, Facebook, and emerging channels, adapting hooks, pacing, framing, audio, text treatments, aspect ratios, duration, and calls to action for each placement. Write and refine captions, headlines, scripts, interview questions, on-screen text, and calls to action in PMI's brand voice, ensuring content is clear, inclusive, accessible, and aligned with campaign and business objectives. Create, adapt, and export branded graphics, thumbnails, title cards, motion elements, and other visual assets using approved templates and brand systems; repurpose existing footage and design assets into new social-first executions. Monitor platform culture, audience behaviors, emerging creators, sounds, formats, visual styles, and cultural moments; identify relevant opportunities early and rapidly translate them into original, brand-appropriate concepts for the UGC-focused content pillar. Monitor content performance across the trends and UGC pillar and apply optimization insights — hooks, formats, pacing, creative approach — to continually improve results. Build repeatable content series and maintain an always-on pipeline that balances planned campaigns, educational storytelling, community content, event coverage, and timely trend-led opportunities. Partner with the Manager, Social Media and the broader Social team, along with cross-functional marketing stakeholders such as Creative, Brand, Product Marketing, Events, and Communications, to translate briefs and larger campaign ideas into effective social-first executions. Apply performance data, audience feedback, testing, and creative insights to strengthen hooks, retention, watch time, engagement, and other campaign outcomes; document learnings and use them to improve future content. Organize and maintain footage, project files, releases, selects, templates, and final assets using established naming, storage, rights-management, and archival practices. Manage multiple productions and rapid-turn assignments simultaneously, communicate status and risks, respond constructively to feedback, and deliver accurate, brand-safe work on deadline. Use AI-powered creative tools and modern production workflows responsibly to support ideation, transcription, captioning, editing, versioning, and efficiency while maintaining human accountability for accuracy, originality, rights, and final quality.

Role Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, film/video production, journalism, design, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 5-7 years of experience creating social-first content, short-form video, digital storytelling, or related creative work for a brand, agency, publisher, or creator-led organization. A portfolio or reel demonstrating personally created work across concepting, shooting, on-camera storytelling, editing, writing, and final delivery is required. Demonstrated experience capturing live events, interviews, behind-the-scenes content, and rapid-turn social assets in dynamic, high-visibility environments. Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders and external production or agency partners while independently owning day-to-day content creation. Creator-first mindset with strong instincts for concepts, hooks, pacing, visual composition, and concise social storytelling; comfortable both behind and in front of the camera. Proficiency with mobile and professional video production and editing — camera operation, lighting, audio capture, CapCut, and at least one professional non-linear editing platform such as Adobe Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro. Ability to create, resize, and export brand-aligned static and motion graphics using tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, or Canva. Deep platform fluency across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, and emerging channels — native formats, audience expectations, and publishing best practices. Strong writing skills, with the ability to distinguish fleeting trends from durable audience behaviors and translate both into clear, brand-appropriate content. Working knowledge of content performance metrics and brand/visual systems, with the ability to convert insights into specific creative improvements. Strong organization and production-planning skills — able to work independently, manage multiple deadlines, and make sound decisions in live event settings. Comfortable using AI tools to improve creative efficiency while maintaining accountability for accuracy, brand alignment, and final quality. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with proficiency in the business language for PMI (English). Up to 25%, including multi-day domestic and international events; evening and weekend availability may be required during event coverage.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $250k, and typically involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This role will be fully remote, based anywhere in the Pacific Northwest

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team.

Click here to learn about what we value at Samsara.

In this role you will:

  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within your territory
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
  • Strategically outbound prospect
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Minimum of 2+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
  • Experience selling full-cycle sales into complex environments (preferably within Public Sector - Local Gov, K-12, High Education)
  • Must have a strong track record of overachievement to quota
  • Cold calling, generating outreach, building relationships excites you
  • Solid understanding of SFDC and accurate forecasting methodology
  • Must be able to travel up to twice per quarter for onsites

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Awards for top achievement (President’s club, Winner’s circle, Top 10%)
  • Experience public speaking in front of executive level personas
  • Passion in closing large, complex deals

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$152,000—$190,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Job Title: Implementation Consultant - Commercial (Remote or Onsite)

Job Location: Milan, Italy

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. Join us in transforming the life sciences industry!

As a Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in the success of our commercial implementation projects of Vault CRM and connected products. You'll work directly with top pharma organizations, designing and building solutions that meet our customers' needs.

What makes us different:

    • High Trust, Ownership & Autonomy: Passion and effort directly lead to opportunities and real ownership from the start
    • Collaboration without competition: peers root for each other’s success, leadership is entirely accessible, and we tackle complex problems with a strict "no-ego" approach.
    • Meaningful Industry Impact: know your work makes a difference, by helping life sciences companies operate more efficiently and effectively

The role is ideally based in the area of a Veeva office (Barcelona, London, Paris, Frankfurt, Berlin, Milan, Budapest), but other EU locations will be considered.

Full right to work in the country of application is required.

What You'll Do

    • Implement Veeva Solutions: Participate in one or multiple Veeva product implementation or migration projects covering autonomously the assigned role (such as configuration specialist, functional analyst, solution architect or project manager: you’ll take different roles on different projects)
    • Configure and Customize: Get hands-on with Vault CRM, configuring and customizing solutions to meet our clients' specific needs
    • Lead Client Engagements: Take ownership of client-facing activities, including leading workshops, user acceptance testing (UAT), and training sessions. You will guide clients through the implementation process, from initial design to final delivery
    • Provide Expert Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to clients, supporting the optimization and harmonization of their business processes. You will translate complex requirements into scalable solution designs

Requirements

    • Demonstrated 3+ years of consulting experience or equivalent experience
    • Demonstrated ability to manage customer-facing activities and stakeholder relationships
    • Strong presentation skills
    • Able to travel approximately 20%
    • Fluent in English (written and spoken)

Nice to Have

    • Experience working on projects with a global scope or with international teams
    • certification and implementation experiences
    • Veeva certification and implementation experiences
    • Experience with software from other vendors (IQVIA, SAP, CVENT, etc)
    • Additional European language ( French, German, Spanish, or Italian)
    • Experience working with the Pharmaceutical, Consumer Health or an adjacent industry

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Work Anywhere policy - You can utilise our office spaces or work remotely
    • Stock bonus %
    • Private medical insurance
    • Life assurance
    • Veeva 1% giving
    • Wellness reimbursement
    • The chance to work with a genuine market leader
    • Incredible support from the wider team, and a best-in-class tech stack to help you be successful in your role

Compensation

    • Total compensation: 45,000 - 80,000 EUR
    • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
