raw.description:
About COROS

We are a sports technology company dedicated to developing the best training solutions for athletes worldwide. Our mission is to leverage technology to solve the challenges athletes and sports enthusiasts face, helping them train smarter and perform at their best. Our aim is to deliver the best product while staying approachable, customer-focused, and ensuring that customer feedback directly shapes our innovation.

Our team spans across the globe. Our hardware and product engineering power comes from our headquarters in China, whereas our local teams in North America and Europe run marketing, sales, operations, and customer support to stay firmly connected in the local communities we serve. We are a team of doers, creative heads, sports lovers, and curious learners who thrive on ownership, trust, flexibility and team spirit.

About the Role

We are looking for a collaborative, high-performingSales & Trade Marketing Specialist EMEA to support sales and marketing activity across a portfolio of markets within the EMEA region. Reporting to the Sales Manager EMEA, you will be the go-to person for distributors, retail partners, and localized marketing execution across our EMEA Markets, of which we don't yet have a direct presence.

While this role has clear milestones, we want a self-driven problem-solver who is excited to support new projects as our business evolves. Your main playground will be distributor relationships, localized marketing campaigns, retail activations and high-impact events.

Your playground

  • Be the go-to person for distributors across your assigned EMEA markets. Monitor sell-through performance, manage reorder cycles, demand forecasting, and ensure product availability.

  • Own distributor communication,serving as the primary point of contact to selected business partners. Communicate delivery timelines, product availability, and new product launches while maintaining strong business relationships.

  • Plan and execute localized marketing campaigns, community events, and retail activations, tailored to each market's unique culture and consumer behavior.

  • Represent COROS at trade shows, expos, and community events across your markets. Plan booth setup, product demonstrations, and partner engagement activities.

  • Conduct ongoing research on competitor activity and consumer trends. Provide actionable insights to shape regional strategy and product allocation.

  • Oversee retail display standards, POS material deployment, and merchandising consistency across partner stores in the region.

  • Track KPIs, including activations, sell-through rates, campaign ROI, and distributor performance, to measure business health and identify growth opportunities.

What you bring to the starting line

Professional Background

  • Experience: 3+ years of experience within the sporting goods industry across Sales, or Trade Marketing.

  • Multi-Market Exposure: Proven experience managing or operating across different European markets and regions simultaneously

  • Category Knowledge: Experience within the Running and Cycling categories is a significant advantage

  • Key competencies:Highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented with the ability to solve complex operational challenges independently and communicate clearly and consicely.

  • Analytical skills: Strong analytical skills with a proven track record of translating sell-through and POS data into strategic action plans

Other Key Requirements

  • Brand fit: Sports enthusiasm and genuine excitement to help us elevate sports performance for everyday and elite athletes through technology

  • Language: Fluency in Business English (written and spoken). Additional European languages are a plus

  • Flexibility: Willingness to travel for key trade events and market visits, including occasional weekend availability

  • Location: Being based in Europe, preferably in the UK (Manchester area)

The Setup

  • Reporting Line: Sales Manager EMEA

  • Working Mode: Flexible, remote- or hybrid working arrangement if being based close to one of our hubs in Skipton (GB), Almere (NL), Linz (AT), or Almería (ES)

  • Travel: Up to 30% travel required across assigned EMEA markets.

  • Work-Life Rhythm: This role is tied to the pace of the sports calendar and trade show season. To make up for work during weekend events, COROS offers days off in lieu so you can recharge.

  • Start Date: We are ready when you are

Package & Benefits

  • Work in a dynamic and motivated team.

  • Creative freedom and space for independent work.

  • Flat hierarchy with short decision-making processes.

  • 25 days of paid vacation plus standard local holidays.

  • Compensation:The base salary range for this position starts at £30.000,- (€35.000,-) annually with the possibility to earn a performance-based bonus on top. This is the least we can do for you. The final offer depends on your experience, background, and location.

raw.description:
About CoVet

At CoVet, we're building AI-powered tools that help veterinary professionals spend less time on paperwork and more time caring for animals.

Veterinary teams are stretched thin. Long hours, administrative burden, and burnout are challenges across the industry. We're on a mission to change that. Our AI copilot helps veterinary professionals save time, improve workflows, and focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional patient care.

We're a globally distributed team united by a shared mission to support veterinary professionals through thoughtful technology. We move quickly, collaborate openly, and believe great ideas can come from anyone.

If you're excited by the opportunity to shape the future of veterinary medicine while working alongside an ambitious and supportive team, we'd love to meet you.

What you'll do

We are hiring a Marketing Data Analyst / CRO to own marketing analytics, reporting and conversion rate optimisation at CoVet. You will report to the Product Marketing Manager and work closely with the performance marketing, lifecycle and product teams.

This is a hands-on role for an analyst who enjoys both the data and the decisions it drives. You will build reliable reporting, find where the funnel leaks, and run the tests that improve conversion from first visit to first record to paying subscription.

You will:

  • own marketing reporting and dashboards, so teams can see funnel performance by market, channel and source
  • analyse the full funnel from visit to sign-up, activation, subscription and retention, and find where conversion is lost
  • design, run and read A/B and multivariate tests on landing pages, sign-up flows, onboarding and email
  • improve attribution and measurement across paid channels, the website and the CRM
  • build and maintain cost, conversion and cohort analyses by market, replacing estimates with measured figures
  • turn findings into clear, prioritized recommendations for marketing, product and leadership
  • keep data definitions consistent, documented and trusted across teams

Cross-functional collaboration

This role will work closely with:

  • Product Marketing: to improve activation and onboarding, and to prioritise conversion work
  • Performance Marketing and Lifecycle: to measure channels and campaigns, and to design tests
  • Product and Engineering: to instrument events, ship experiments and understand in-app behaviour
  • RevOps, Sales and Enterprise: to align on lead and pipeline definitions and CRM data
  • Leadership: to supply the numbers behind planning and board reporting

What success looks like

In this role, success means conversion improves at every stage of the funnel, and the business can see why. It means reporting people trust, tests that give clear answers, and decisions made faster because the data is ready.

You should expect to be measured on conversion and activation gains, the number and quality of tests run, the reliability of reporting, and the impact of your recommendations.

Qualifications

We're looking for someone who is:

  • an experienced analyst in a marketing, growth or product analytics role
  • strong in SQL, and comfortable working in a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery
  • skilled at building dashboards in Looker Studio, Looker, Tableau or similar
  • experienced in designing and analysing experiments, with a sound grasp of statistical significance
  • familiar with web and product analytics, tagging, UTM tracking and attribution
  • able to explain findings plainly to non-analysts and recommend what to do next
  • organised, self-directed and comfortable handling requests from several teams

Preferred experience

  • SaaS with a self-serve or product-led funnel
  • CRO tools such as Optimizely, VWO or similar, and landing page builders
  • HubSpot or another CRM as a reporting source
  • Python or R for analysis
  • multi-market or multi-language businesses

Why this role matters

This role gives CoVet clear visibility of what drives growth. Every point of conversion this role recovers means more customers from the same spend, and faster, more confident decisions across marketing.

Why Join Us

  • Flexible remote-first work environment
  • Competitive compensation
  • Generous vacation and time-off policies
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth
  • A culture built on trust, collaboration, and impact

Compensation

We believe in paying our team members fairly and competitively. Compensation is determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and local market benchmarks.

As a globally distributed company, salary ranges are localized to reflect the market for comparable roles in a candidate's country or region. We'll discuss compensation expectations and provide transparency around our approach throughout the interview process.

CoVet is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace where everyone can do their best work. If you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We're happy to work with you to ensure an accessible and positive candidate experience.

raw.excerpt: Passionate about precision medicine and advancing the healthcare industry?
raw.description:
Passionate about precision medicine and advancing the healthcare industry?

Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way. Tempus' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real-world evidence to deliver real-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time.


About Tempus and the Outcomes Research Team

Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way. Tempus’ proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real-world evidence to deliver real-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time.


The Outcomes Research team partners with external Pharma, biotech, and academic institutions to provide best-in-class data, analysis, and methodological guidance for Tempus’s real-world data (RWD) offering. We are seeking a highly motivated and capable Sr. Data Scientist with extensive experience in the design and analysis of pharmacoepidemiologic and health economic outcomes research (HEOR) studies.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and execute HEOR and real-world evidence (RWE) projects (e.g., outcomes analysis, treatment patterns, healthcare resource utilization) with external Pharma, academic, and other partners.
  • Represent the Outcomes Research function and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders in the design, analysis, interpretation, and publication of real-world studies.
  • Work on complex problems, exercising judgment in selecting and adapting appropriate epidemiologic and health economic methodologies.
  • Partner with interdisciplinary groups of scientists, engineers, and product developers to translate research into clinically actionable insights for our clients.
  • Stay current with the latest methodological advances in RWE, including causal inference and pharmacoepidemiologic methods.
  • Build analytical infrastructure, including reusable code, templates, and workflows that improve speed and quality across engagements.
  • Comply with all applicable regulations, Tempus data governance, and company procedures related to real-world data use and reporting.

Required Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree (Master’s with 5+ years experience, PhD with 3+ years experience, or Bachelor’s with 8+ years experience) in data science, bioinformatics, biostatistics, epidemiology, public health, or a related quantitative field.
  • Demonstrated computational skills using R and SQL, specifically applied to large-scale healthcare datasets.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong data manipulation and analytical skills tailored to observational/real-world data.
  • Deep familiarity with HEOR and RWE methodologies, including approaches to address confounding (e.g., propensity score matching, weighting, inverse probability of treatment weighting).
  • Experience analyzing large, complex real-world datasets, such as administrative claims, electronic health records (EHR), and/or clinico-genomic databases.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex methodologies and findings for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Self-driven mindset with demonstrated ability to tackle ambiguous problems and work effectively in interdisciplinary teams.
  • Experience with time-to-event analysis and survival methodologies.
  • Experience working in oncology and/or analyzing outcomes related to cancer genetics, immunology, or molecular biology.
  • Collaborative working style, eagerness to learn, and high-integrity work ethic.
  • Sharp attention to detail and a passion for delivering high-quality, timely analytics.
  • Ability to draw appropriate inferences based on study design and explicitly assess and communicate study limitations.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with version control (e.g., Git) and software testing or validation processes.
  • Experience working in oncology Phase II–IV clinical trials and/or analysis of RWD studies (e.g., claims, EHR, registry data sources).
  • Hands-on experience contributing to regulatory submissions to the FDA or other health authorities.
  • Experience supporting data science teams in model building and validation, including feature engineering and performance assessment.
  • Client-facing or consulting experience and comfort presenting results and recommendations to external stakeholders.

raw.description:
Responsibilities

Highly skilled and experienced Automation Test Engineer with a strong background in both functional and automation testing of Salesforce applications built using OmniStudio and Lightning Web Components (LWC). The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise with automation tools such as Selenium, Java, Cucumber, Playwright, and AI-based testing tools. The position will play a critical role in ensuring quality across the development lifecycle. This role places a strong emphasis on in-sprint automation, enabling rapid feedback and continuous delivery within Agile teams. Additionally, the position involves API testing for complex insurance applications, using tools like SoapUI and Postman to validate integrations and ensure seamless data flow across systems.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and reusable automated test scripts for Salesforce applications using tools such as Selenium, Java, Cucumber, and Playwright
  • Utilize AI capabilities for self-healing locators, test data generation, and root cause analysis
  • Utilize AI-powered testing tools to improve manual and functional testing efficiency by enabling automated test case generation based on business requirements and user workflows, capturing test evidence without manual intervention, auto-generating automation scripts wherever feasible, and intelligently identifying scenarios that require manual execution
  • Collaborate closely with developers, product owners, and QA team members to implement in-sprint automation, ensuring test coverage is aligned with sprint goals and delivered within sprint timelines
  • Perform manual and functional testing to validate new features, identify edge cases, and ensure comprehensive test coverage where automation is not feasible
  • Lead the planning and execution of functional, regression, integration, end-to-end and API testing across multiple platforms and environments
  • Develop and execute API test cases using tools like SoapUI and Postman to validate service integrations and data accuracy
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and faster feedback loops
  • Analyze test results, identify root causes of failures, and work with development teams to resolve issues efficiently
  • Maintain and manage test environments, test data, and automation frameworks to support ongoing testing needs
  • Maintain the automation regression suites based on continuous enhancements or new features implemented
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and contribute to best practices in test automation and quality assurance
  • Explore/Innovate stable automation solutions to automate complex applications (Ex: salesforce)

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or other related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 7+ years of experience in software quality assurance with a strong focus on automation
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce testing (Salesforce Sales/Service/Experience Cloud/FSC)
  • Experience with AI-assisted testing platforms and generative AI tools used for test design, script generation, test maintenance, and defect analysis
  • Proficiency in automation tools and frameworks: Selenium, Java, Cucumber, Provar, Playwright
  • Explore/Innovate stable automation solutions to automate complex applications (Ex: Salesforce)
  • Strong understanding of QA methodologies, testing types, and software development life cycle (SDLC)
  • Experience designing and maintaining scalable automation frameworks using Page Object Model (POM), data-driven, and hybrid framework approaches
  • Experience testing RESTful APIs, JSON/XML payloads, OAuth authentication, and integration workflows
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, Azure DevOps)
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and in-sprint automation practices
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Property and Casualty Insurance knowledge is a plus
  • Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as JIRA, TestRail, or Zephyr
  • Experience with automating applications which are developed using Salesforce OmniStudio and Lightning Web Components would be a plus
  • Exposure to performance and load testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner is a plus.
  • Good understanding of Salesforce platform components including Flows, Validation Rules, Apex integrations, Profiles, Permission Sets, and security models is a plus

About Our Company

H.W. Kaufman Group is a powerful global network of companies dedicated to shaping the future of insurance. With thousands of dedicated professionals across an extensive network of over 60 offices around the world, we lead by offering innovative solutions that are at the forefront of the industry. We are privately owned and thus free from the influence of Wall Street. This allows us the ability to adapt to constantly fluctuating market conditions. From brokerage, underwriting, and real estate to claims, loss control and risk management services, our depth of services is unrivaled.

raw.description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

Salary: $64,000 per year (USD)

About the role

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and customer-focused Non-Standard Claims Adjuster to support our deposit replacement and surety programs. In this role, you will manage first-party claims involving non-standard policy language and complex contractual agreements. Success requires strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret policy forms, lease agreements, financial ledgers, and supporting addenda with accuracy and confidence.

You will work directly with property managers, policyholders, and internal stakeholders to drive fair, thorough, and timely claim outcomes. This role requires clear communication, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate nuanced coverage positions while maintaining a high level of professionalism and empathy.

This position is ideal for an adjuster who thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment and enjoys working within specialty programs. The right candidate is adaptable, solutions-oriented, and comfortable balancing high claim volume with exceptional service delivery and compliance standards.

Who You Are:

  • Highly motivated and growth-oriented. You’re excited about building a tech-driven claims organization.
  • Passionate adjuster. You care deeply about the customer experience and delivering fair, timely resolutions.
  • Empathetic. You exercise patience and understanding in every interaction.
  • Urgent but balanced. You work with a sense of urgency but understand that doesn’t mean working at all hours.
  • Creative problem-solver. You find innovative ways to resolve claims efficiently while keeping the insured’s best interests in mind.
  • Comfortable with conflict. You see conflict as a conversation, not a confrontation—an opportunity to collaborate and resolve issues.
  • Curious. You want to know the whole story to make informed decisions early and drive prompt resolutions.
  • Anti-status quo. You don’t just wish things were different—you take action to improve processes and outcomes.
  • Communicative. You can break down complex topics, actively listen, and ensure clarity in every interaction. (What does this mean to you? We’d love to know!)
  • Sense of humor. Claims are challenging—you know how to keep things light when needed.

What you'll do

  • Provide prompt, courteous, and high-quality customer service.
  • Manage a high volume of low-complexity claims; set and adjust reserves appropriately.
  • Gather necessary information and documentation to initiate the claims process, explain coverage, and outline the next steps.
  • Analyze contracts, financial ledgers, lease agreements, and addenda to determine claim validity and obligations.
  • Ensure compliance with state regulations, policy provisions, and internal procedures.
  • Communicate with all involved parties and issue payments within the set authority.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of claims guidelines, best practices, and workflows.
  • Oversee and direct investigative service providers, working closely with clients, counsel, and other stakeholders.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, legal decisions, and policy changes affecting claims handling.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred (but if you meet the other qualifications, don’t let that stop you from applying!).
  • 3 years of experience in general claims handling or related insurance roles.
  • Ability to interpret non-standard policy language, contract terms, and lease agreements.
  • Active adjuster license: resident-state license where available, otherwise a Designated Home State (DHS) license. Willing to obtain any additional required licenses within 60 days, including state testing.
  • Familiarity with state regulations, policy provisions, and claims procedures.
  • Strong analytical skills—able to evaluate complex data and make sound decisions.
  • Curious, proactive, and always looking for better ways to do things.
  • The desire for continuous learning and professional growth.
  • Willingness to travel for client and claim needs.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Superior organizational skills—able to prioritize and manage workload efficiently.
  • Comfortable with an Apple laptop, Google Docs, Sheets, and other relevant software.

Benefits

raw.description:
Job Title: Scrum Master

Term: 12 months

Location: Nairobi, Kenya

Reports to: Technical Program Manager

Level: Intermediate/ Senior (4-8 years of relevant experience).

Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate and coordinate Scrum ceremonies (Daily Scrum, Sprint Planning, Sprint Review, Retrospective) with clear agendas, time-boxing, and documented outcomes (decisions, risks, actions, owners, due dates).
  • Own and maintain the team's delivery metrics dashboard (sprint velocity, burndown/burnup, defect rates, cycle time, cumulative flow), surfacing trends and escalating concerns to the TPM.
  • Actively identify, track, and remove constraints blocking squad members from delivering sprint goals; escalate cross-organizational blockers to the TPM within agreed SLAs.
  • Coach squad members and relevant stakeholders on agile principles, Scrum practices, and delivery best practices, progressively building internal agile capability.
  • Facilitate cross-squad coordination where multiple technical work streams (Backend, Frontend, API, Data) have interdependent sprint commitments.
  • Support knowledge transfer by ensuring that process documentation, decision logs, and sprint artefacts are maintained in the agreed shared workspace.
  • Report on delivery health metrics at fortnightly steering cadence, partnering with the TPM for programme-level reporting.

Measurable Outcomes & Deliverables

First 30 Days

  • Attend all Scrum ceremonies and produce baseline assessment of ceremony health, compliance, and documentation gaps.
  • Own the delivery metrics dashboard and report on velocity, burndown, defect rates, and cycle time and report any present gaps.
  • Produce a cross-squad dependency register across Backend, Frontend, API, and Data workstreams.
  • Confirm fortnightly steering cadence with the TPM and key stakeholders.

Days 31–60

  • Sprint velocity stabilizing; at least two consecutive sprints with 80% sprint goal achievement.
  • DoD compliance rate tracked and reported; 90% of completed stories meet DoD criteria.
  • Backlog health confirmed: two sprints of stories refined and sprint-ready at all times.
  • At least one agile coaching session delivered to client counterparts or junior squad members.
  • Delivery metrics dashboard live and shared with TPM and stakeholders.

Days 61–90

  • Retrospective improvement actions tracked; demonstrable improvement in at least two delivery metrics since sprint 1.
  • Agile maturity assessment (informal) of squad completed; coaching plan for remaining engagement period produced.
  • All sprint ceremonies running to time and rated as useful by squad members (informal pulse check).
  • Knowledge transfer - one squad member or stakeholder who has visibly adopted improved Scrum practices through coaching

Ongoing KPIs

  • Enable the squad to consistently achieve agreed sprint goals through effective planning and execution.
  • Ensure stories meet the agreed Definition of Done before acceptance.
  • Proactively identify, escalate, and facilitate resolution of delivery blockers and dependencies.
  • Maintain a healthy, prioritized backlog that supports upcoming sprint planning and delivery.
  • Drive continuous improvement by facilitating effective sprint ceremonies and retrospectives and ensuring agreed improvement actions are followed through.

Stakeholders & Ways of Working

Agile Ceremonies Owned: Sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, backlog refinement.

Reporting Cadence:

  • Fortnightly delivery health summary to TPM.
  • Sprint metrics dashboard updated at end of each sprint.
  • Ad-hoc impediment escalation to TPM as required.

Cross-Functional Touchpoints:

  • All squad roles (API Engineer, Backend, Frontend, Data Scientist, UI/UX Designer).
  • Product Owners and stakeholders attending sprint reviews.
  • TPM for programme-level dependency and risk alignment.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 4–8 years of experience in Scrum Master or agile delivery roles, with at least 2 years in technology delivery environments.
  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent certification required.
  • Proven ability to facilitate agile ceremonies for cross-functional technical teams, including engineers, data scientists, and designers.
  • Experience tracking and improving delivery metrics (velocity, cycle time, burndown, DoD compliance).
  • Strong coaching and facilitation skills; ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and remove impediments at both team and organizational level.
  • Experience working in embedded client-side or consulting delivery contexts preferred.
  • Familiarity with backlog management tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent).
  • Understanding software development lifecycle (SDLC), including testing, integration, and release processes.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

  • SAFe Agilist or equivalent scaled agile certification.
  • Experience in fintech, payments, or mobile money delivery environments.
  • Familiarity with Kanban or hybrid Scrum/Kanban delivery models.
  • Prior experience embedding within a client organisation in a consulting or secondment capacity.
  • Experience facilitating agile transformations or team capability-building programmes.
  • Exposure to API integration, backend, or data science delivery workstreams.

Tools & Technologies

  • Backlog and sprint management: Jira / Azure DevOps / equivalent
  • Documentation and knowledge base: Confluence / SharePoint
  • Communication: Microsoft Teams
  • Metrics and reporting: Jira dashboards / Excel / Azure DevOps dashboards
  • Retrospective facilitation: Miro or equivalent
  • Collaboration: Miro / Mural / equivalent virtual whiteboard

raw.excerpt: The OpportunityFutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Foundry, an AI-Native Recruiting Agency currently in build at FutureSight.
raw.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Foundry, an AI-Native Recruiting Agency currently in build at FutureSight. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Recruiting has run on the same model for decades: firms charge a fixed percentage of a hire's first-year salary for work that is largely manual, sourcing, screening, and outreach done one candidate at a time. That pricing made sense when the work required a person doing it by hand. It doesn't anymore.

Market Context

Foundry is an AI-native recruiting firm built around a simple idea: use AI agents to handle sourcing, screening, and candidate evaluation, and keep a small human team focused on what still requires a person: building trust with clients and candidates, exercising judgment on close calls, and closing the placement. That shift in who does the work lets us offer clients a fee that's a fraction of what traditional firms charge, without cutting corners on quality.

This is where we believe recruiting is headed. AI-native service firms are starting to emerge and prove the model works, and we're building toward that shift deliberately.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning

  • Customer Development — Lead pilot placements with design-partner companies, convert them to paid retained relationships, and build the go-to-market motion

  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback

  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction

  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

  • Demonstrated success in B2B AI or B2B SaaS go-to-market, including consultative, relationship-driven sales and customer engagement

  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

  • Deep domain expertise in recruiting, staffing, or talent acquisition, as a builder operator or agency leader

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

raw.description:
At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods.
We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments.
If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.
As an Operations Lead, Strategic Growth Initiatives, you will be a strategic operator who brings structure to ambiguity, aligns cross-functional teams, and moves high-priority growth initiatives from idea to execution. Reporting to the VP of Operations, you will work across Product, Go-To-Market, Operations, Partnerships, Finance, Legal, and leadership to strengthen how In Tandem executes. You will move fluidly between strategy and hands-on implementation, using AI as a practical tool to increase speed, quality, and operating leverage.

What you will accomplish:

  • Run a tight executive operating cadence, including weekly leadership meetings, monthly business reviews, board preparation, leadership offsites, and the metrics and narratives that anchor decision-making.
  • Turn company goals into clear operating frameworks such as OKRs and KPIs, surface risks early, and drive follow-through on decisions and commitments.
  • Evaluate and execute partnership and business development opportunities through market mapping, research, opportunity sizing, diligence, outreach preparation, testing, and execution planning.
  • Lead high-priority, cross-functional special projects that matter to company growth, from strategic analyses and process redesigns to product launches, commercial experiments, and new-market opportunities.
  • Use AI tools daily to accelerate research, synthesis, planning, documentation, communication, and workflow design; build lightweight AI-enabled workflows, prompts, templates, and internal tools that help teams move faster.
  • Create repeatable playbooks, dashboards, launch plans, operating metrics, and other systems that improve clarity, accountability, speed, and measurement as the company grows.

Who you are:

  • A high-ownership operator who is energized by ambiguity and can create structure without waiting for perfectly defined responsibilities.
  • A structured, analytical problem-solver with strong business judgment who can move from sizing an opportunity to making sure the right follow-ups actually happen.
  • A trusted cross-functional partner who builds credibility across Product, GTM, Operations, Finance, Legal, Partnerships, and leadership.
  • Action-oriented and comfortable getting into the details; you care as much about implementation and outcomes as you do about the quality of the strategy.
  • Curious and pragmatic about AI, with a habit of actively using new tools to improve your own work and the way teams operate.

What you bring:

  • 5+ years of experience across strategy, operations, product operations, business operations, growth, partnerships, consulting, investing, banking, or a similarly high-ownership environment.
  • Ideally, a mix of strategy training and meaningful operating experience inside a company—for example, consulting or investing followed by 1–2 years in an operations, growth, product, partnerships, or business role.
  • Experience in SaaS, consumer technology, marketplaces, healthcare technology, fintech, or another technology-enabled business.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives in fast-moving environments while managing multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines.
  • Experience supporting product launches, GTM initiatives, strategic partnerships, commercial experiments, or growth projects.
  • High comfort with AI tools and genuine curiosity about how AI can improve business operations, productivity, and decision-making.
  • Nice to have: experience working closely with Product and Engineering; partnerships, BD, channel strategy, or ecosystem development; automation/workflow platforms such as Claude, Notion AI, Airtable, or Zapier; and building dashboards, operating metrics, launch plans, internal playbooks, or executive reporting.
What we're not looking for:
  • Someone who has only advised from the outside and has not owned execution inside a company.
  • Someone who is purely a project manager without strong strategic, analytical, or commercial judgment.
  • Someone who is interested in AI only conceptually, but does not actively use AI tools in their own work.
  • Someone who needs highly defined responsibilities and struggles with ambiguity.
  • Someone who produces strategy documents but does not enjoy driving implementation.
Why Join?
We’re redefining family technology.
In Tandem brings together a growing portfolio of trusted tools that support families, and the professionals who guide them, through the moments that matter most. We bring clarity to chaos and stability to daily family life, helping parents feel less stressed so kids can have healthier childhoods.
Scale meets startup energy.
With more than 20 years of impact and a strong market presence, we’re entering a bold new chapter of growth. We have the foundation, the momentum, and the ambition to go further: expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and elevating the tools families and professionals rely on every day.
Purpose-driven. Performance-focused. People-first.
Our culture is rooted in accountability, curiosity, and collaboration. We value diverse perspectives, thoughtful problem-solving, and teammates who care deeply about building something that matters.
How We Support You:
  • Medical: In Tandem pays 100% of the premium for employees AND 99% for all additional family members
  • 401k: Up to a 4% match with immediate vesting
  • Paid leave for all new parents
  • Learning & Development stipend for employees
  • Paid Time Off: 11 Holidays + Winter Break (3 Days) + Volunteer Time Off (1 Day) + Floating Holiday (1 Day)
  • Personal Time Off: 15 days for 0-1 years of employment + 20 days for 1-3 years of employment
  • Supportive and flexible working environment – work from anywhere!
Come As You Are!
In Tandem provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

General Description:

Compliance professionals supporting country- and site-level oversight. This role combines people leadership with
operational and strategic accountability to ensure consistent, high-quality execution of risk-based compliance

activities.

This role plays a critical role in building team capability, driving performance, and ensuring alignment with global

Identify systemic risks, recurring issues, and areas for improvement.

- Remote Compliance Activities

Resource & Capacity Management

study portfolio and risk profile.

Strategic Alignment & Cross-Functional Partnership

- RCC Inspection and Audit Lead

Core Competencies, Knowledge and Skill Requirements:

Communication & Interpersonal Skills:

year-end).

Qualifications

Job Title: Senior Health Data Operations Analyst - Compass

Job Location: New York City, NY

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As a Senior Health Data Analyst, you will focus on analyzing health data within the Veeva Compass product suite. Veeva Compass delivers record-level prescription and medical claims data to power longitudinal, de-identified patient analytics for commercial use cases—including patient journey, market landscape, and provider engagement.
You will be responsible for driving data quality, consistency, and standardization within the Terminology Reference Library (TRL) by managing reference data for key attributes found across prescription and medical claims—including drug information, ICD-10 diagnosis codes, procedure and lab codes, as well as payer and plan data. In this role, you will query prescription and medical claims datasets to support the evaluation and integration of new inbound data sources into core schemas. Additionally, you will define and track key quality metrics via interactive dashboards, contributing to technical documentation and validation reports to ensure our reference data remains accurate, scalable, and seamlessly integrated across all Veeva products.

What You’ll Do

    • Drive TRL Governance: Maintain and expand the Terminology Reference Library (TRL), managing core reference datasets across prescription and medical claims (including drug information, ICD-10 codes, procedure/lab codes, and payer/plan data).
    • Evaluate & Integrate New Data: Conduct deep-dive data querying, field mapping, and structural analysis on potential new data sources to evaluate fit and integrate them into existing core schemas.
    • Execute Quality & Cleansing Workflows: Perform exploratory data analysis to identify discrepancies, handle missing values, execute deduplication, and ensure data completeness, accuracy, and timeliness.
    • Continuous Product Improvement: Investigate data anomalies within the Veeva Compass product suite, testing both planned and unplanned data changes to assess downstream customer impact.
    • Build Metrics & Documentation: Develop interactive dashboards to track key data quality metrics, contributing to technical documentation, validation reports, and team process improvements.
    • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Data Scientists, Product Managers, and Developers to articulate data quality nuances, uncover root causes, and build robust data pipelines.

Requirements

    • 4+ years of experience analyzing record-level prescription and medical claims datasets.
    • 4+ years of experience in health data quality analysis, data profiling, and data governance principles.
    • Advanced SQL proficiency, with extensive experience querying, manipulating, and aggregating large-scale relational databases.
    • Deep working knowledge of healthcare code sets and industry standards, including NDC, ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS, LOINC, and payer/plan reference data.
    • Proven track record in data storytelling: Experience analyzing, visualizing, and demonstrating data quality findings to stakeholders using Excel, BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Sigma), or interactive dashboards.
    • Strong problem-solving mindset: Eagerness to dive deep into complex, unstructured healthcare data issues, identify root causes, and propose innovative solutions.
    • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM, quantitative, or healthcare informatics field, or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have

    • Experience in Python
    • Experience with the BI tool Sigma
    • Experience in life science industry

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

The Keet engine team works on the core that makes Keet tick: connecting peers, replicating data, syncing rooms, and keeping calls and file transfers fast and reliable across every kind of network. We're looking for an organized, curious Junior Project Manager to help keep that work moving.

You'll work closely with a globally distributed team of senior engineers, help turn priorities into clear plans, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks between releases. This is a great role for someone early in their career who wants to grow into technical project or product management in a deeply technical, open-source environment.

Responsibilities

  • Track engine work across sprints and releases, keeping issues, milestones, and roadmaps current

Requirements

  • Excellent written English communication; you can explain technical progress clearly and concisely

  • Highly organized, with strong attention to detail and follow-through

  • Comfortable working with engineers and learning technical concepts quickly

  • Experience with issue trackers and project tools (e.g. GitHub Issues/Projects, Jira, Linear)

  • Self-starter who thrives in a fully remote, async-first team

Preferred:

  • Basic understanding of networking or distributed systems concepts (P2P, DHTs, NAT traversal, replication)

  • Familiarity with software development lifecycles, Git, and release processes

  • Some exposure to JavaScript/ or experience working alongside a dev team

  • Interest in privacy, decentralization, or open-source software

  • Agile/Scrum knowledge or a certification (PSM, CAPM, etc.)

  • Experience working across many time zones

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Nossas fundadoras, Vanessa e Fátima Tenório, começaram na sala de aula, ensinando inglês, aos 14 anos. Não satisfeitas com métodos tradicionais do ensino do inglês, tiveram como propósito inovar o que é feito em sala de aula. Muito mais do que ensinar o inglês, elas colocaram como objetivo criar uma metodologia que possibilitasse educar em inglês. Foi assim que, em 2002, nasceu o Systemic, o primeiro programa bilíngue do Brasil.

Aqui, acreditamos no trabalho colaborativo. Nós somos o Systeam, o time de pessoas que acreditam no impacto e transformação que a educação gera. Temos como valores a honestidade de propósito, aprendizagem contínua, visão sistêmica, excelência e respeito.

Hoje, o Systemic está nas 5 regiões do Brasil e temos a oportunidade de impactar a vida de todos aqueles que vivem a experiência Systemic: os alunos, professores, coordenadores e diretores, comunidades escolares, além dos membros do nosso Systeam.

Se você, assim como nós, acredita na transformação que a educação pode fazer, venha fazer parte do nosso Systeam!

Você deverá prospectar e captar clientes e venda de programas de educação bilíngue para escolas públicas ou do terceiro setor, além de prefeituras, com apresentação para coordenadores, diretores, professores e pais:

  • Visitar prefeituras ou órgãos públicos para apresentação do programa de educação bilíngue;
  • Prospectar clientes potenciais para apresentação do programa Systemic Bilingual;
  • Criar relacionamentos significativos com os clientes (aproximação afetiva e efetiva);
  • Alimentar a estrutura estratégica e de inteligência de negócios com informações sobre o mercado alvo (CRM);

  • Participar do planejamento estratégico da área para saber o direcionamento, metas acordadas, regiões a serem trabalhadas, políticas de preços estabelecida e ações a serem executadas;
  • Fazer follow up de visitas e acompanhar o cliente até o fechamento do contrato;
  • Realizar reunião de pais com o intuito de apresentar o programa e disseminar a ideia de educação bilíngue, suas vantagens e benefícios;
  • Solicitar ao gestor direto o envio da minuta de contrato quando necessário e acompanhar até sua assinatura;
  • Participar de eventos da empresa com o objetivo de gerar leads e oportunidades;
  • Ter uma visão mais estratégica das escolas que devem ser visitadas, assim como otimizar custos nas viagens realizadas agendando o maior número possível de visitas;

The role includes overseeing backend operations, monitoring KPIs, generating performance insights, and ensuring product listings remain accurate and compliant while aligning ad strategy with broader e-commerce goals.

Core Tasks:
  • Build, launch, and optimize retail media campaigns (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Display, Video) across marketplaces including Home Depot, Lowe’s, Wayfair, Costco, and Sam’s Club
  • Manage backend marketplace operations: product listings, content updates, pricing adjustments, keyword optimization, compliance checks, and inventory alignment
  • Monitor campaign KPIs (CTR, ROAS, ACoS, conversion rates) and provide actionable insights for ongoing performance improvements
  • Partner with sales, merchandising, and marketing teams to align advertising strategy with broader e-commerce goals
  • Generate weekly and monthly reporting on ad spend, ROI, and operational metrics to guide budget allocation and strategy
  • Troubleshoot campaign or listing issues within seller portals (Wayfair Partner Home, Home Depot Supplier Hub, Lowe’s Marketplace, Sam’s Club MAP, etc.)
  • Track and boost organic ranking on various platforms using native platform tools
Must-Haves:
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing retail media ads (e.g., Amazon Advertising, Walmart Connect, Wayfair Sponsored Products, Home Depot Retail Media, etc.)
  • Strong working knowledge of PPC campaign structures (keyword targeting, bidding strategies, budget pacing, A/B testing)
  • Experience with seller backend systems (Wayfair Partner Home, Mirakl-based platforms, or similar)
  • Analytical skills with comfort using Excel/Sheets and reporting dashboards to evaluate KPIs and make optimization recommendations
  • Detail-oriented approach to maintaining clean product catalogs and ensuring compliance with platform requirements
  • Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal
  • Ability to work full-time CST
Nice-to-Haves:
  • Agency or multi-brand experience with a track record of scaling campaigns across multiple marketplace

Job Title: Manager - Veeva Batch Release Strategy - Europe

Job Location: Berlin, Germany

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Batch Release helps life sciences companies modernize the decision to release a batch by connecting the quality, manufacturing, laboratory, document, and enterprise resource planning (ERP) information needed for disposition. In this European Strategy role, you will work with customers, partners, and Veeva teams to shape how the market understands and adopts the application. This is a highly customer-facing role for someone who combines regulated-manufacturing knowledge with experience turning complex processes into practical software, services, and field strategies.

What You'll Do

    • Lead strategic discovery with European life sciences customers to understand their batch-disposition process, systems landscape, release bottlenecks, stakeholder model, and business case for change
    • Work with account teams to advance priority customers from working-level interest to senior-sponsored engagement and a clear next step
    • Act as the European domain lead, helping Sales, Strategy, Solution Consulting, Services, Product, Marketing, and partners understand how quality, manufacturing, laboratory, document, and ERP processes come together in release
    • Turn customer, partner, and market learning into clear product, services, implementation, and field recommendations
    • Build reusable European enablement, including discovery guides, stakeholder maps, account-entry plays, and positioning across ERP, manufacturing execution, laboratory, quality, and document systems
    • Develop relationships with systems integrators, consultancies, advisory partners, and industry organizations, and represent Veeva in customer meetings, executive discussions, webinars, and industry events

Requirements

    • 10+ years of combined experience in life sciences manufacturing, quality, or related enterprise software and consulting
    • Direct working knowledge of batch disposition or release and the regulated manufacturing evidence and stakeholders behind the decision
    • Experience translating manufacturing or quality processes into customer-facing software, consulting, implementation, or transformation programs
    • Senior customer-facing experience in strategy, solution consulting, implementation advisory, enterprise software, or management consulting
    • The judgment and presence to lead substantive conversations with Quality, Manufacturing, Qualified Person or release, IT, and executive stakeholders
    • Working knowledge of SAP or another ERP platform and several of manufacturing execution, laboratory, quality, document, and integration systems
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex processes into clear recommendations and reusable field material
    • Ability to travel within Europe and occasionally globally for customer meetings, internal workshops, and industry events

Nice to Have

    • Direct responsibility for batch disposition, Qualified Person certification, or release-process ownership
    • Experience with SAP Batch Release Hub, TrackWise, Veeva Vault Quality, or comparable manufacturing and quality platforms
    • Relationships with European systems integrators, consultancies, advisory firms, or organizations such as ISPE; or experience with external or contract manufacturing networks where release evidence crosses company and system boundaries

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A personality assessment
        3. A practical case exercise
        4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Work Anywhere
    • Flexible paid time off
    • An annual budget for health and wellness programs

Compensation

    • Total compensation: 75,000 - 140,000 EUR
    • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Team

This emerging team will report into a Product Specialist - Sales Director and consist of specialist sellers aligned by segment and product. AEs on the team are charged with Samsara Connected Maintenance, and will be incentivized on growth targets across a single AVP org. Sellers will drive growth through strategic, high-value deal execution; establishing the business case for emerging products at flagship reference customers; and cross-functionally partnering to establish the infrastructure and resources for other AEs across the segment to be successful.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United States.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a public utility. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customer's value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Co-develop an emerging product pipeline with AEs across major Pub Sec accounts
  • Drive pilot strategy and success metrics for early adoption
  • Own executive-level discovery and storytelling for emerging SKUs
  • Partner with GTM and Product to feed back insights and shape roadmap
  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts
  • Drive Maintenance sales cycles end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
  • Build frameworks, assets, and insights that scale across the sales org
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years in complex, full-cycle enterprise solution sales
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $500k+ ARR transactions
  • Experience working with line of business stakeholders in SLED/Government entities
  • Willing and comfortable with strategic outbound prospecting
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability thriving in a dynamic, fast paced environment
  • Clear, confident communicator with strong customer instincts
  • Demonstrated entrepreneurial spirit and ability to lead through influence

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Overlay or new product launch experience
  • Experience working with Product and Marketing to influence GTM strategy
  • Ability to operate in strategic partnership with senior AEs and account teams
  • Comfort in presenting to and influencing C-suite executives
  • Awards for top achievement (President’s club, Winner’s circle, Top 10%)
  • Passion for the world of operations!

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) for full-time employees for this position is below. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$350,000—$350,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

raw.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Software Engineer (L2) - for Voice Trust: helping ensure Twilio’s Voice customers have reliable voice communication with their customers that ensure their customers will answer their calls.

Who we are & why we’re hiring

Twilio powers real-time business communications and data solutions that help companies and developers worldwide build better applications and customer experiences.

Although we're headquartered in San Francisco, we have presence throughout South America, Europe, Asia and Australia. We're on a journey to becoming a global company that actively opposes racism and all forms of oppression and bias..

About the job

This position is needed to add to our Voice Connectivity Trust team in the US to enable Twilio to better support our customers using Voice in their solutions. As a Software Engineer on this team you will participate in all phases of the software development life cycle which includes requirements gathering with Product Managers, technical design, estimations, sprint planning, coding, testing, deployments and on-call support. This engineer will own, operate and maintain their teams’ services in a distributed production environment, employing Agile methodologies to continuously deliver value to customers.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Be an owner: Design and implement real-time services with high throughput and low latency requirements, verify, deploy and operationalize them
  • Wear the customer's shoes: Work closely with stakeholders to understand customer needs and, devise and deliver, simple, robust and scalable solutions
  • Write it down: Be comfortable expressing thoughts and ideas as detailed prose and use it as an effective means to collaborate with leads, architects and cross functional teams
  • Be bold: Embrace the challenge of scaling a complex distributed platform with points of presence globally, each one concerned with high availability, high reliability, high throughput, low latency, and media fidelity
  • Draw the owl: Figure out novel ways of solving customer problems for the Voice channel

Qualifications

Not all applicants will have skills that match a job description exactly. Twilio values diverse experiences in other industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. While having “desired” qualifications make for a strong candidate, we encourage applicants with alternative experiences to also apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • Minimum 2-3+ years of hands-on experience in a large scale, distributed applications environment on JVM based technologies
  • Experience building RESTful services, API design and event-driven architectures (Kafka, SQS)
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines
  • Hands on experience with cloud infrastructures such as AWS, GCP, OpenStack or Azure
  • Experience with on-call rotations, incident response, monitoring/alerting tools (Prometheus, Datadog, Grafana)
  • Excellent written communication skills - essential for effective AI prompting and for creating clear technical documentation (with or without AI assistance)
  • Proven ability to critically evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability
  • Strong Java fundamentals with the ability to architect, review, and debug code whether written by you, teammates, or AI agents
  • Demonstrated proficiency working with AI coding assistants (Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) - you should be able to describe your workflows and show examples
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related engineering field
  • Strong Computer Science fundamentals not limited to data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and distributed systems
  • Able to work well in a team setting and both highly motivated and motivating

Desired:

  • Can demonstrate with metrics how you have used AI to increase productivity
  • Experience scaling data tiers employing a variety of SQL/NoSQL database and caching technologies
  • Hands on experience scaling production backend systems, with the proven ability to design and develop horizontally-scalable, resilient and performing-under-load systems
  • Knowledge and experience working with SIP protocol
  • Knowledge and experience working with Stir/Shaken protocol

Location

This role will be Remote in the USA but is not eligible to be hired in CA, NY, WA, PA, CT. We prioritize connections and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

There are many benefits to working at Twilio, including, in addition to competitive pay, things like generous time-off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $138,700 - $173,400
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $146,800 - $183,600
  • Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $163,100 - $203,900.
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location..

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until 8/28/2026, but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.
