Job Title: Sr. Advisor, Molecular Pharmacology – Neuroscience

Job Location: Remote, Indiana, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Overview:

Centessa Pharmaceuticals, a wholly owned subsidiary of Eli Lilly and Company,is a clinical-stage company developing orexin receptor 2 (OX2R) agonists as a new class of medicines for the treatment of narcolepsy and potentially other sleep-wake disorders. Centessa’s lead investigational candidate – cleminorexton (formerly ORX750) – is being developed for narcolepsy type 1, narcolepsy type 2, and idiopathic hypersomnia. Centessa's OX2R agonist portfolio includes additional clinical and preclinical-stage assets with potential utility across a broader range of neurological, neurodegenerative, and neuropsychiatric conditions. Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, Centessa was recognized as aGreat Place to Work® in 2026.

Position Summary:

We are seeking an experienced, collaborative, and scientifically rigorous contributor (at the Associate Director level) to provide scientific leadership for molecular pharmacology activities supporting neuroscience discovery and development programs. The successful candidate will bring a strong foundation in pharmacology and apply broad scientific expertise to address questions related to compound pharmacology, receptor and target biology, signaling mechanisms, and translation across relevant experimental systems.

The ideal candidate will combine deep scientific expertise with curiosity, strategic thinking, and the ability to identify and implement experimental approaches that address evolving program needs. The individual will work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams and with internal and external scientific partners to develop pharmacology strategies, guide experimental work, interpret complex data, and advance therapeutic programs.

Responsibilities

  • Provide scientific leadership and strategic direction for molecular pharmacology activities supporting neuroscience discovery and development programs

  • Develop pharmacology strategies and experimental plans to address key questions related to compound activity, receptor and target biology, signaling, mechanism of action, and translation

  • Design, guide, and interpret pharmacological studies using recombinant, endogenous, native, or other relevant experimental systems

  • Guide advanced characterization of therapeutic compounds using appropriate functional, binding, mechanistic, cellular, molecular, or translational approaches

  • Apply expertise in molecular pharmacology and receptor biology to identify scientific questions and experimental approaches that can inform program decisions

  • Integrate pharmacological and biological data across experimental systems and disciplines to develop clear scientific conclusions and recommendations

  • Collaborate closely with medicinal chemistry, in vivo pharmacology, DMPK, translational sciences, and other scientific partners to advance program objectives

  • Establish productive scientific partnerships with internal collaborators and external research organizations; provide appropriate scientific direction while leveraging complementary expertise

  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex scientific and experimental challenges

  • Mentor scientists and contribute to a collaborative environment characterized by scientific rigor, intellectual curiosity, and high-quality execution

  • · Evaluate emerging technologies, methodologies, and scientific approaches and apply them where they can meaningfully advance research programs

  • · Communicate scientific strategy, results, and recommendations effectively to multidisciplinary project teams and research leadership

Basic Requirements:

  • · PhD in Pharmacology, Neuroscience, or a closely related scientific discipline with substantial experience in supporting drug discovery research

  • · 6+ years of experience within the biopharmaceutical industry

  • · Strong foundation in molecular pharmacology, with expertise in one or more areas such as receptor pharmacology, GPCR biology, cellular signaling, mechanistic pharmacology, neuroscience, or related disciplines

  • · Broad understanding of experimental approaches used to characterize compound pharmacology, receptor and target biology, and biological mechanisms

  • · Experience developing scientific strategy and independently addressing complex experimental and drug discovery questions

  • · Demonstrated ability to integrate data across experimental systems and scientific disciplines

  • · Experience directing collaborative research activities involving internal and/or external scientific partners

  • · Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop scientists

  • · Ability to operate effectively in a dynamic, multidisciplinary research environment and manage multiple scientific priorities

  • · Excellent scientific judgment, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills

Additional Preferences:

  • · Intrinsically curious and deeply passionate about the work we do.

  • · Embrace ambiguity and push for new practices and technologies.

  • · Adaptive problem solver - turn issues into opportunities and translates ideas into solutions, even when the path isn’t clear.

  • · Leverage technical depth and a growth mindset to make impact; imagine what’s possible and pursue it with intention and energy.

  • · Demonstrate curiosity and drive self-identified innovation, especially in the exploration of artificial intelligence and digital.

Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form () for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.


Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL).

$129,000 - $231,000

Full-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). In addition, Lilly offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees, including eligibility to participate in a company-sponsored 401(k); pension; vacation benefits; eligibility for medical, dental, vision and prescription drug benefits; flexible benefits (e.g., healthcare and/or dependent day care flexible spending accounts); life insurance and death benefits; certain time off and leave of absence benefits; and well-being benefits (e.g., employee assistance program, fitness benefits, and employee clubs and activities).Lilly reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion and Lilly’s compensation practices and guidelines will apply regarding the details of any promotion or transfer of Lilly employees.

Job Title: Senior Consultant - Clinical Data Programming

Job Location: London, United Kingdom

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva's Vault Clinical Data Management System (CDMS) is changing how life sciences companies manage clinical trial data, bringing EDC, coding, and Veeva Data Quality System (DQS) together in one platform. We're looking for a Senior Consultant with life sciences software programming experience to help customers get the most out of EDC while running their trials. This is a full-time, permanent, customer-facing role open to candidates working remotely from the EU or UK.

What You’ll Do

    • Act as a trusted advisor to customers and clinical sites, ensuring trial designs are configured to meet their goals, and providing training and mentorship along the way
    • Work with customers to interpret clinical protocol requirements and project specifications, applying industry and Veeva best practices
    • Lead database development activities per the project plan, coordinating with sponsor, CRO, and other vendor teams
    • Coordinate with clinical data providers (central labs, ECG, eCOA, IRT, etc.) to configure data transfers
    • Configure forms, rules, and other study items in Vault CDMS, and build custom SQL-based listings for customer data cleaning needs
    • Run on-site or remote user acceptance testing, managing feedback, issue resolution, and study acceptance
    • Support requirements gathering and specification writing for study integrations and go-live activities
    • Flag risks and contingency plans to project management to keep the project compliant with regulatory and Veeva procedures
    • Contribute to process, product, and best-practice initiatives, and support developers and testers throughout the project lifecycle
    • Share data management activities, challenges, and end-user feedback with the Vault CDMS product team
    • Configure and support data imports into Veeva DQS

Requirements

    • 5+ years of experience with EDC clinical software, covering end-to-end data management (database design, data collection, data analysis, query resolution, datasets, statistical reporting)
    • Solid understanding of clinical trial processes, particularly around data collection and review
    • Programming experience in languages such as SAS, R, JSON, Python, or SQL, with the ability to pick up new SQL-based languages
    • Background in the life sciences industry (pharma, biotech, medical device, CRO, or academic/public health), with experience across project assessment, planning, development, training, and implementation
    • Experience in a customer-facing role, ideally within software professional services or consulting
    • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while meeting project timelines
    • Strong verbal and written communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills
    • Willingness to travel up to 10%, potentially including international travel

Nice to Have

    • Familiarity with data management standards (GCDMP, CDISC, SDTMIG, CDASH, ADaM)
    • Experience working with system integrators for IVRS, medical coding, eSource, CTMS, eTMF, or similar clinical technologies
    • Experience integrating or programming with REST-based APIs
    • Experience translating clinical protocols into software specifications, including technical documentation
    • Experience with Veeva applications
    • Located near a major life sciences hub
    • Degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related field

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Private health insurance
    • Flexible paid time off plus local public holidays
    • Pension / retirement plan contributions
    • 1% charitable giving program

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
As an equal opportunity employer, Veeva is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and growing a diverse workforce. Diversity makes us stronger. It comes in many forms. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. raw.description:
Location: Remote, anywhere
Comp: Compensation discussed in the first call

One-liner

Run AI agents that research, draft and refresh Single Grain's long-form content at scale, so every page answers the question first, is accurate, and gets found in Google and cited in AI answers.

About the role

This is bigger than writing and editing. You'll be an AI-native content operator: you run agents and tools to research, draft and refresh long-form content on singlegrain.com at volume, and you own the result. That means answer-first structure, AEO and on-page SEO, and accuracy.

We want someone who is deeply AI-pilled. Editing time is coming down drastically, and the writers who win are the ones who already work that way: AI does the heavy lifting, and your time goes into judgment, structure and checking facts. You should already work like this every day and keep pushing it further, measuring your own hands-on time and cutting it.

Search is splitting between Google and answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. You'll work inside Single Grain's AEO/SEO Content OS, with search and visibility data from Google Search Console and ClickFlow.

What you will own

  • Run your own agent workflows for research, drafting and refresh. You choose the tools, design the workflows and keep improving them.

  • Ship publish-ready long-form pieces (1,500+ words) at volume.

  • Refresh existing singlegrain.com posts for AEO and SEO: answer-first leads, FAQ blocks, schema-ready structure, headings, internal links and meta.

  • Own accuracy. Cut or rewrite any claim you can't verify, and reject AI drafts that aren't ready to ship.

  • Pick which posts to refresh next from search data, and batch the work.

  • Build a batch refresh workflow that a teammate actually uses.

What success looks like

  • By day 30: Your agent workflow is live. 8 new long-form pieces and 20 refreshes have shipped. A teammate uses your batch refresh workflow on real pages.

  • By day 60: You're producing 15 new pieces and 40 refreshes a month. At least 85% pass our quality gate the first time, and at least 80% of output runs through documented agent workflows with a logged accuracy check.

  • By day 90: You're producing 25 new pieces and 60 refreshes a month. We read back search and AI-answer visibility on the pages you shipped.

  • By month 12: You're producing 30+ new pieces and 80+ refreshes a month, with visibility up on most of the pages you shipped or refreshed. Failure means volume goes up while quality or visibility stays flat, or an invented stat gets shipped.

Evidence we want to see

  • The agents and tools you run every day, and what each one does.

  • One long-form piece you shipped, shown end to end with real times.

  • How you've cut editing and fact-check time, with before and after numbers.

  • A link to a shipped piece you built with AI, and what you did vs what the AI did.

  • Hands-on AEO: pages built to be cited in AI answers.

What will rule you out

  • Any invented stat, fabricated source or unverifiable claim, in your samples, your answers or the trial.

  • Generic answers, or no proof link.

  • Only talking about tools without showing a working workflow.

  • Video, social or short copy as your only experience.

How to apply

  1. Apply with your resume or LinkedIn. If there's a fit, you'll get 7 short questions by email from Eric about how you work with AI. They matter most. Answer them yourself, with specifics and numbers. Please reply within about 48 hours. We won't send reminders.

  2. Strong answers move to a paid live trial (4 hours max). You run your own AI workflow live and ship 3 long-form drafts and 10 post refreshes from a brief we provide, then walk us through your choices for 20 minutes. Nothing from the trial gets published.

  3. We decide on the trial using the same scorecard for every candidate.

raw.description:
About the Role We're looking for a Performance Creative Lead who speaks both craft and performance fluently and can build a team that's capable of doing the same. You'll be a player-coach: raise the bar, hire and develop strong talent, and still get into the work yourself. At MoneyGram, everyone is an IC. You'll own the performance creative system: the strategy, team, testing frameworks and output that help us produce high-performing ads at scale across our global markets. We already produce a high volume of creative today. The next phase is about scaling that output with more intentionality: better systems, sharper creative strategy, stronger testing loops, better localisation and clear answers on which creative investments are driving more sign-ups at lower cost. Paid social will be your core focus, but your creative thinking will extend across our wider paid media channels. This isn't a role where you'll just manage a team and review creative. You'll work closely with Growth Marketing to turn performance data into creative decisions, defining what gets tested, what gets improved and what gets scaled. Alongside Creative Operations, you'll make sure the team has the capacity and workflows to deliver great work at pace. AI will be central to how you work, both in the creative you produce and in building smarter, faster ways of working across the team. If you bring the fire to raise the bar, think like a customer and aren't afraid to roll up your sleeves to get things done, you're our person! What success looks like within a year: A creative team producing winning ads: customer centric, on brand, compliant, channel-native and relentlessly tested. A growing library of creative intelligence, stronger team capability and measurable improvements in creative performance that contribute to reducing customer acquisition cost (CAC). How You'll Make an Impact

Build a team that thinks. Hire, coach and develop strong creative talent. Set expectations, raise the bar and build a team that brings ideas, not just takes briefs. Decide what gets made. The concepts, hooks, scripts and formats the team creates. Challenge the obvious, push for better ideas and give feedback people can act on. Find the idea worth testing. Get close to the customer. Understand what makes people stop, pay attention and take action. Turn those insights into creative ideas that do more than look good. Test the creative. Hook against hook, purchase driver against purchase driver, format against format. Know what you're trying to learn and let the results decide what gets stopped, improved or scaled. Find out what converts. Work with Growth Marketing to understand what happens after the click. Turn creative performance data into decisions that help bring CAC down. Spread what wins. When something works in one market, get it into other markets, channels and languages fast. Know what travels, what needs adapting and when it's time for a new idea. Make the learnings stick. Build the tracking, tagging and creative libraries that make winning patterns easy to find, understand and repeat. Don't let good ideas or useful insights disappear after a test. Stay in the work. Develop concepts, write hooks and scripts, make examples and step into production. Show the team what good looks like, not just what's wrong with the work. Get content finished. Work with Creative Operations to manage capacity, workflows and production priorities. Use in-house talent, contractors and external partners to get great work out at pace. Push the creative, protect the brand. Don't confuse more variations with better ideas. Make work that stands out, feels native to the channel and stays accurate, on brand and compliant. Put AI to work. Use it to explore ideas, create content, test new approaches and move faster. Help the team do the same, without losing creative judgement.

What You'll Bring

8+ years in creative. You've led creative teams, shaped creative strategy and made decisions that improved performance. Show us what changed under your leadership, creatively and commercially. A portfolio, not a résumé. Paid media creative you've owned, your own or a brand's. Bring the work, explain the thinking and tell us what the numbers did. Ideas worth testing. You've turned customer insights into concepts, hooks and messages with clear hypotheses behind them. Show us the ideas, what you tested, what you learned and how the results shaped what came next. A team you've led and developed. Direct people management, not just creative direction. You've hired, coached, managed performance and handled difficult conversations. Tell us who got better under you. A performance creative system you've built. Testing frameworks, creative analytics, tagging and workflows. Show us what you built, what you learned and how it changed the team's decisions and results. You know your CTR, CVR and CAC, and how creative influences them. Content you've made yourself. Concepts, hooks, scripts, statics, motion and video. You can still get into the work, not just give feedback on what others have made. Creative that works across markets. You understand different audiences, cultures and channels. You know which ideas travel, which need adapting and how to make creative feel relevant, not simply translated. Proof you can deliver at scale. You've managed high-volume creative output without losing quality or control. You know how to move fast, make decisions and keep the work getting better. Real use of AI creative tools. You've made things with them, improved workflows and helped your team do the same. Show us what you've built. Conviction backed by evidence. You have opinions, challenge assumptions and aren't afraid to push an idea. But you're not precious about being right. When the results tell you something different, you listen. Clear thinking, clear communication. A brief a creator can follow, feedback a team can act on and a creative recommendation you can defend with both ideas and evidence.

As a Customer Experience & Operations (CXO) Consultant, you will contribute to Sirva’s success by serving as the primary point of coordination to Sirva’s customers in their mobility journey. This role is service focused, with the organizational ability to support, monitor and consult with customers across a large client base. Additionally, this role will seek out opportunities to enhance the customer experience, both by proactively contacting the customer in recognition or critical milestones in their journey and by offering additional program services, where appropriate.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

% of time (must total to 100%)

80%

Direct Customer Interaction

Places proactive calls with customer to welcome them, advise on the authorized services and policies to be provided, connecting at meaningful moments throughout the move. Engages and adopts new technology enhancements and features, sharing these updates and promoting them internally and with customers to encourage high usage of tools and self-service support. Serves as a trusted advisor in the mobility programs across a client base, learning and understanding about available services, and translating those services confidently when speaking to each individual customer’s needs. Partners internally with other customer support teams to ensure all customer needs are promptly met, coordinating and responding as a single support team for the customer. Collaborates externally with supplier partners as appropriate, to coordinate authorized services for the customer, recognizing these suppliers are an extension of the customer experience. Dedicated to strong data integrity, ensuring system accuracy through regular upkeep of file notes, updates, and information, so that system data can be used confidently and reliably to drive and inform other company processes and to contribute to a smoother customer experience. Ensures outlined Key Experience Metrics and customer/client SLAs (e.g. customer satisfaction, responsiveness, cost savings) are met or exceeded. High school diploma or equivalent. University/college degree preferred. 1 year in a customer experience, business operations role preferred. International experience a plus, but not necessary Must be fluent in English, but other languages are highly desired.

Experience providing highly organized delivery, demonstrable problem-solving skills and high attention to detail. Experience of exercising judgement in owning complex processes, through to completion and resolution. Able to think creatively and successfully navigate ambiguity to solve problems quickly and efficiently. Strong accountability for success of customer experience. Curiosity and hunger to learn and to grow alongside a transforming organization.

Technology Skills

Digitally focused with demonstrated comfort utilizing multiple technology platforms as an integrated component of their day to day role. Embraces new technology and can easily incorporate into ways of working. Ability to navigate multiple technology platforms simultaneously.

Social & Emotional Skills

Strong customer service and trusted advisor mindset in both proactive and reactive scenarios. Able to easily and quickly build trust across many persona/personality customer types. Able to operate in a team environment with shared goals and responsibilities, in support of positive customer experiences. Displays confident, calm demeanor, particularly in difficult, emotional, or stressful situations. Strong collaborator and team player. Excellent written, verbal communication and interpersonal skills. You foster belonging and encourage authenticity. Job Duties: S&P Global Inc. seeks a Lead, Information Security who will perform security analysis and communicating vulnerabilities identified in web applications with stakeholders, developers, and senior management. Provide scoping data to assist in developing project proposals. Create detailed assessment reports describing identified security weaknesses, potential business risks, and prioritizes mitigation recommendations. Develop improved methodologies, processes, infrastructure, tools, and deliverables that contribute to the ongoing enhancement of vulnerability assessment capabilities. Gather requirements from Business Analysts and Application Owners. Incorporate and define security requirements, map security requirements and define the data flow diagrams, and deliver threat models in the design phase. Provide strategic direction and tactical oversight for major security projects, including penetration tests, patch management, change control, application security, and infrastructure security. Perform application security assessments for native, web, and hybrid applications using open source and commercial tools. Report key metrics to executive management and reporting on the health of applications and infrastructure components, interacting with application owners and product engineering team to share the assessment results.


Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related IT field plus 5 years of experience in the job offered or related occupation. 5 years of experience must include: Utilizing enterprise-grade Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tools, including Fortify, to tune rulesets, integrate SAST into complex pipelines, and interpret false positives with accuracy. Using Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) tools, including Burp Suite Pro and OWASP Zap, to review black-box and gray-box testing efforts, including logic flaw exploitation. Managing open-source risk across large codebases, using Mend to perform Software Composition Analysis (SCA), and conducting manual code reviews across multiple programming languages, including Java, Python, C# and either JavaScript or Node.js. Conducting formal threat modeling using frameworks, including STRIDE, PASTA, or MITRE framework, and integrating threat modeling into architectural and design phases of the SDLC. Building, scaling, and managing secure SDLC programs in large organizations, including embedding security into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Azure DevOps. Applying or mapping application security controls to regulations, including DORA, ISO/IEC 27034, NIST 800-53 / SSDF, and SOC 2 Type II and performing remediation efforts or assessments tied to audits and regulatory reviews. Application security across distributed product teams, including managing security for hundreds of applications across varied stacks and creating centralized risk dashboards using ServiceNow or similar platforms. Scoping, coordinating, and validating results from external/internal pentests and translating test findings into actionable development tasks, prioritizing remediation based on risk. Securing applications in multi-cloud environments, including AWS (IAM, Cognito, API Gateway, Lambda) and Azure (App Services, Key Vault, Defender for Cloud), as well as integrating application security tooling and controls within cloud-native CI/CD workflows.

raw.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
deine aufgaben

Das Procurement-Team innerhalb unseres Carrier-Bereichs kümmert sich um die Beschaffung von Transportpartnern und Frachtraum für Spot-Anfragen und Festeinsätze. Als Teil des Procurement-Teams sorgst du an der Schnittstelle zwischen Lieferpartnernetzwerk und Kunde dafür, dass unsere Partner passende Anfragen und unsere Kunden passende Angebote erhalten. So trägst du zum Wachstum und Erfolg des Unternehmens bei.

  • Anfragen bearbeiten: Du nimmst Transportanfragen auf, klärst offene Punkte und findest die passende Transportlösung.
  • Transporte einkaufen: Du holst Angebote von unseren Lieferpartnern ein, verhandelst Preise und wählst nach Fahrzeugklasse, Route, Vorlaufzeit und Servicelevel aus.
  • Schnell & verbindlich handeln: Du arbeitest entlang klarer Prozesse und gibst dem Kunden verlässliche Rückmeldungen.
  • Preisfindung & Angebot: Du kalkulierst Verkaufspreise und bietest unsere Lösung aktiv beim Kunden an.
  • Dokumentation: Du pflegst Anfragen, Preise und Aufträge zuverlässig in unserem System. Gute Datenqualität ist Teil deines Jobs.
  • Netzwerk stärken: Du gibst Rückmeldung zu Carrier-Performance und hilfst mit, unser Lieferpartnernetzwerk weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Prozesse mitbauen: Aus wiederkehrenden Fällen entwickelst du gemeinsam mit dem Team Standards und Prozesse.

dein profil

  • 2 bis 5 Jahre Arbeitserfahrung in Spedition, Disposition, Transportlogistik, dem Einkauf von Frachtraum oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und schnell und behältst den Überblick.
  • Du kommunizierst gern, kannst verhandeln und triffst Entscheidungen.
  • Zahlenverständnis: Preise, Margen und einfache Kalkulationen sind für dich kein Problem.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools (CRM, Tabellen, TMS etc.); Offenheit für neue Software und Automatisierung.
  • Einwandfreies Deutsch in Wort und Schrift; Englisch traust du dir zu, weitere Sprachen sind von Vorteil.
  • Zuverlässigkeit, Eigenverantwortung und proaktive Kommunikation sind für dich selbstverständlich.

unser angebot

  • Remote-first, du arbeitest von zu Hause, es gibt keine Präsenzpflicht im Büro
  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung mit aktueller Software und KI-Tools
  • Bodenständiges, junges Unternehmen (Startup) mit 40 Teammitgliedern
  • HRmony Sachbezug: 50 € steuer- und sozialabgabenfrei monatlich für frei wählbare Angebote (z.B. REWE, IKEA, Spotify etc.)
  • 30 Urlaubstage (bei Vollzeit)
  • bAV-Bezuschussung mit 20%
  • Erstklassige IT-Ausstattung (Apple)
  • Klare Onboardingprozesse, regelmäßiges Feedback sowie Leistungsbeurteilung auf Augenhöhe

Sr. Director, Corporate Development

Remote-First

Company Overview: AMSURG is an independent leader in ambulatory surgery center services, operating a network of more than 250 surgery centers nationwide. In partnership with physicians and health systems, the organization delivers high-quality care for patients across a diverse spectrum of medical specialties, including gastroenterology, ophthalmology and orthopedics. To learn more about AMSURG, visit www.amsurg.com.

Position Summary:

The Senior Director, Corporate Development supports AmSurg’s growth strategy by leading the evaluation and execution of strategic partnerships and development opportunities across the organization. The role will focus on de novo development, joint ventures, practice partnerships and acquisitions, and other strategic transactions that expand and strengthen AmSurg’s market presence. The individual will work closely with Business Development, Business Operations, physician partners and other internal stakeholders to assess opportunities, develop business cases and financial models, structure transactions, coordinate due diligence, and drive opportunities from initial evaluation through closing and implementation. The ideal candidate will combine strong financial and analytical capabilities with sound strategic judgment, project leadership skills and the ability to build effective relationships with physicians, health systems and other partners. Experience in healthcare services, corporate development, investment banking, consulting or a related field is preferred.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate strategic growth opportunities, including de novo developments, joint ventures, physician and practice acquisitions, and other partnership structures.
  • Develop strategic and financial analyses to assess market opportunities, partnership alternatives, investment returns and key transaction considerations.
  • Build detailed financial models, business cases, pro formas and valuation analyses to support investment decisions.
  • Partner with Business Development and Business Operations leaders to advance priority growth initiatives from initial concept through execution.
  • Support the development and structuring of partnerships with physicians, physician groups, health systems and other strategic partners.
  • Coordinate cross-functional diligence and execution activities across operations, finance, legal, compliance, accounting and other functional teams.
  • Analyze and interpret operating agreements, letters of intent, term sheets, partnership agreements and other transaction documents.
  • Lead or coordinate financial and operational due diligence, identifying key risks, opportunities and value-creation considerations.
  • Support negotiation and execution of transaction terms, including ownership structures, governance, economics, service arrangements and other key partnership provisions.
  • Develop de novo business plans, including market assessment, physician alignment, volume assumptions, capital requirements, ramp-up economics and return analysis.
  • Support practice acquisition opportunities and physician alignment strategies that complement AmSurg’s broader market and partnership objectives.
  • Coordinate transaction closing and transition activities and partner with operating teams to support successful implementation.
  • Prepare clear recommendations, investment materials and executive-level presentations for senior leadership and investment approval processes.
  • Maintain active project plans and communicate status, key decisions, risks and next steps across multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Aggregate, analyze and synthesize large data sets using Microsoft Excel and other analytical tools.
  • Consistently meet deadlines and quality expectations while maintaining an organized, collaborative and professional approach.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%
  • Regular and reliable attendance required.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Position Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential responsibility satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required:

  • Bachelor’s or graduate degree in finance, accounting, business, management or a related field.
  • At least 10 years of relevant experience in corporate development, strategic development, M&A, investment banking, consulting, healthcare services, business analysis or project leadership.
  • Demonstrated experience evaluating and executing complex partnerships, joint ventures, de novo developments or acquisitions is strongly preferred.
  • Healthcare services experience and familiarity with physician alignment and multi-site provider models are preferred.
  • Advanced financial modeling and valuation capabilities are required; a professional designation such as CFA, CPA or similar is a plus.

Physical Requirements:
Must be able to sit or stand for extended periods, operate a computer and other office equipment, and communicate clearly in person and/or over the phone. Requires occasional walking, bending, reaching, and lifting. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

raw.description:
See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as our next Principal engineer (L5) on Twilio’s Segment, Data Pipelines team.

About the job

As a Principal Engineer on the Twilio Segment Data platform/pipelines team, you won’t just design systems—you will be the design anchor for data platforms that processes hundreds of thousands of data points per second. We are looking for a visionary, deeply inquisitive engineer who has built 0-1 architectures, scaled them to global proportions, and collected the battle scars that come from pushing cloud-native systems to their absolute limits. You will guide our engineering organization through complex distributed design choices, ensuring reliability, performance, and cost-efficiency while querying petabytes of data for the world's leading Customer Data Platform (CDP). If you are naturally curious, obsessed with knowing exactly how systems break under intense load, and eager to pioneer the integration of AI into real-world data processing, this is your ultimate playground.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Own the technical north star and deliver robust, highly composable routing experiences for the core Data platform and pipelines at Twilio Segment.
  • Design and pioneer always-available, fault-tolerant distributed systems in cloud environments, using past system failures to design out-of-the-box resilience.
  • Lead through technical influence, masterfully guiding high-stakes design decisions and articulating the precise trade-offs between cost, performance, and reliability to both engineers and executives.
  • Translate complex technical strategies into clear, elegant, and actionable blueprints that align diverse stakeholders, including Product Managers, Architects, and engineering teams.
  • Actively prototype and experiment, bringing an inquisitive mindset to the platform by identifying where emerging AI technologies and LLMs can solve systemic data processing challenges.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 12+ years of programming experience. Deep battle-tested experience with high-scale messaging/streaming systems and distributed processing engines (handling several thousand events/sec minimum).
  • Mastery of high-level service design, with a proven ability to model complex interfaces and internals in a properly modular, composable, and extensible way.
  • Expert programming experience in Go or similar concurrent, object-oriented languages, with a sharp eye for performance bottlenecks.
  • An active "AI story"—demonstrated, hands-on experience identifying, prototyping, and deploying GenAI/LLM solutions to solve real-world engineering or data processing challenges.
  • Profound technical depth in distributed systems, high-scale ingestion, and cutting-edge cloud-native architecture.
  • Superb communication and problem-solving skills, with a natural inclination to mentor others and a relentless drive for operational excellence

Desired:

  • Advanced proficiency with high-throughput datastores, distributed caching layers, and container orchestrators (Docker/Kubernetes).
  • Experience with modern CI/CD pipelines and robust observability frameworks (Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus) to predict and diagnose failures.
  • Deep familiarity with broader AI/ML infrastructure and data workflows.
  • Hands-on experience managing, optimizing, and operating large-scale AWS cloud infrastructure.
  • A proven track record of driving technical alignment and collaboration across a geographically distributed engineering team.

Location

This role will be based in any of the permitted 5 India states (Delhi, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Telangana & TamilNadu)

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

raw.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Neobank App
raw.excerpt: About KIRAOur mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
raw.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.title: Prinicipal Multi Media Designer - Creative Stategy & Enablement
raw.excerpt: designIQ is a full-service creative, design, and pre-media group supporting internal and external partners across print, digital, social, video, branding, campaign creative, imaging, and ad production services.
raw.description:
designIQ is a full-service creative, design, and pre-media group supporting internal and external partners across print, digital, social, video, branding, campaign creative, imaging, and ad production services. Our work ranges from high-volume production to agency-level creative solutions. That includes print and digital advertising, social media creative, short-form video, logos, brand identity systems, company stationery, branded materials, direct mail, billboards, packaging, product design, glossy and newsprint products, campaign assets, and custom creative solutions. We’re looking for a senior creative leader who can operate beyond execution. This person will serve as creative counsel to the Sr. Director of Creative Operations, support sales and partner conversations, help shape creative standards, and assist with training and enablement across the creative operation. This role is ideal for someone who can think like an agency creative, work like a production expert, communicate like a client-facing partner, and help move a large creative operation forward.

Role Summary:

The Principal Multimedia Designer, Creative Strategy & Enablement is a highly experienced creative professional responsible for supporting elevated creative work, client-facing creative conversations, internal training, sales enablement, and quality improvement across designIQ. This role sits at the intersection of creative strategy, multimedia design, production excellence, client consultation, and operational enablement. The person in this position should be able to understand a business need, translate it into a creative approach, guide others toward stronger work, and produce high-quality creative when needed. The role will regularly partner with the Sr. Director of Creative Operations to help shape creative direction, review strategic opportunities, support new business conversations, advise on creative capabilities, and strengthen the overall quality and consistency of designIQ’s work. This person may attend internal meetings, external partner meetings, sales calls, discovery calls, client-facing creative discussions, and training sessions. They should be comfortable speaking with sales teams, customers, creative teams, production teams, leadership, and external partners. The ideal candidate brings agency-level design experience, strong multimedia capability, polished communication skills, and the ability to teach, coach, and influence without needing direct authority in every situation.

Key Responsibilities:

Serve as creative counsel and strategic design partner to the Sr. Director of Creative Operations. Support sales calls, discovery calls, partner meetings, and client-facing conversations where creative expertise is needed. Help translate client goals, sales objectives, and business challenges into clear creative recommendations. Provide creative direction and guidance on complex, high-value, or strategically important work. Create, review, or advise on agency-level creative across print, digital, social, video, branding, direct mail, billboards, packaging, product design, glossy publications, newsprint products, and campaign-based deliverables. Assist in shaping creative approaches for new business opportunities, partner onboarding, premium creative services, and custom creative requests. Help determine whether a creative request belongs in standard production, premium creative, Studio-level work, or a custom scope. Support the development of creative briefs, intake standards, client discovery questions, and creative readiness requirements. Join internal planning meetings to represent creative quality, design feasibility, production needs, and client experience. Partner with sales and customer-facing teams to explain design recommendations, creative limitations, available solutions, and best-fit options. Present and explain creative work, design direction, and creative recommendations to internal and external stakeholders. Create polished finished creative when needed, especially for strategic work, sample work, pitch support, training examples, or high-priority client needs. Assist with creative training across the operation, including design fundamentals, multimedia best practices, AI-assisted workflows, social creative, video, brand consistency, production standards, and quality expectations. Help develop training materials, creative playbooks, design examples, before-and-after reviews, checklists, templates, and quality standards. Mentor designers and creative team members by providing thoughtful feedback, coaching, and design guidance. Review creative work for concept, execution, accuracy, visual hierarchy, brand alignment, production readiness, and overall effectiveness. Help identify quality gaps, workflow issues, training needs, and recurring creative weaknesses across the operation. Use AI-assisted creative tools to improve ideation, versioning, image exploration, workflow efficiency, and scalable creative output. Guide responsible use of AI across creative work, making sure final output remains accurate, brand-safe, original, legally appropriate, and professionally finished. Stay current on design trends, digital advertising trends, social media formats, video trends, AI tools, print production practices, and evolving client expectations. Support the creation of scalable templates, design systems, campaign frameworks, and repeatable creative solutions. Design with performance in mind, including audience behavior, offer clarity, mobile-first composition, visual hooks, readability, and conversion-focused calls to action. Apply accessibility-minded design practices, including legibility, contrast, hierarchy, mobile readability, and inclusive digital design principles. Serve as a trusted creative voice in conversations about workflow, staffing, capabilities, quality, training, AI adoption, and creative operations strategy.

Required Qualifications:

Portfolio required. Portfolio must show advanced creative work across multiple media types and demonstrate strong design thinking. Significant professional experience in multimedia design, graphic design, advertising, agency creative, publishing, brand design, digital media, or a related creative field. Proven ability to create and guide agency-level creative across print, digital, social, video, branding, and campaign-based work. Experience creating or directing logos, brand identity systems, corporate stationery, branded collateral, direct mail, billboards, packaging, product-related creative, glossy publications, newsprint products, digital campaigns, and social media assets. Strong understanding of design fundamentals, including typography, layout, hierarchy, color, composition, branding, messaging, visual storytelling, and production accuracy. Ability to create polished finished work with limited direction. Ability to evaluate incomplete briefs, identify missing information, and still move work forward with sound creative judgment. Strong client-facing communication skills. Ability to interact confidently with internal teams, external customers, sales leaders, creative teams, production stakeholders, and senior leadership. Ability to explain creative decisions clearly to non-design audiences. Experience participating in client meetings, sales conversations, creative reviews, or discovery calls. Strong understanding of print, digital, social, video, branding, and production workflows. Working knowledge of digital advertising, social platform requirements, mobile-first design, paid social formats, display creative, email graphics, and campaign extensions. Experience with video, motion graphics, animation, HTML5-style creative, short-form content, or multimedia storytelling. Working knowledge of AI-assisted creative tools and how to use them responsibly in a professional design workflow. Ability to write effective prompts, refine AI-assisted outputs, identify weak results, and avoid generic or low-quality creative. Strong ability to teach, coach, mentor, and influence other creative professionals. Strong organizational skills with the ability to balance strategic work, meetings, training, creative reviews, and hands-on design needs. Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment while maintaining high creative standards.

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, visual communication, digital media, advertising, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Experience working in an agency, media company, publishing organization, creative studio, in-house agency, or high-volume production environment. Experience supporting local, regional, and national advertisers. Experience developing creative for new business, pitch support, client presentations, sales enablement, or strategic account growth. Experience building or improving creative training programs. Experience developing creative playbooks, design standards, quality checklists, templates, or internal enablement materials. Experience mentoring designers or serving as a senior creative reviewer. Experience supporting brand development, campaign concepts, product launches, promotional campaigns, or multi-channel marketing efforts. Experience creating campaign extensions across print, digital, social, email, outdoor, video, and branded materials. Experience reviewing creative performance or designing with campaign outcomes in mind. Understanding of accessibility standards, including WCAG-informed digital design practices. Experience helping teams adopt new tools, including AI, automation, design systems, or workflow platforms

Technical Skills:

Advanced working knowledge of Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator required. Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Adobe Express, Figma, Canva, or similar creative tools preferred. Experience with AI-assisted creative tools such as Adobe Firefly, Photoshop generative tools, Canva AI, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Runway, or similar platforms preferred. Experience with tools that support motion graphics, digital animation, short-form video, HTML5-style creative, social creative, and platform-ready digital assets preferred. Strong understanding of print specs, prepress standards, file packaging, bleed, trim, resolution, color profiles, image quality, vendor requirements, and production-ready file preparation. Familiarity with digital campaign specs, social media specs, display ad specs, email creative requirements, and landing page asset needs. Microsoft Office experience required. Ability to learn company-specific workflow tools, ad tracking systems, digital asset systems, approval platforms, and production processes.

Leadership and Influence:

This role may not require direct people management, but it does require strong creative leadership. The Principal Multimedia Designer should be able to influence through expertise, clarity, collaboration, and credibility. This person should be trusted by designers, sales teams, customers, production partners, and leadership. They should be able to step into unclear situations, bring creative order to the conversation, and help move the work toward a better outcome. This person should know when to teach, when to challenge, when to simplify, and when to raise concerns.

What Success Looks Like:

Serves as a trusted creative advisor to the Sr. Director of Creative Operations. Improves the quality, consistency, and strategic value of creative work across designIQ. Supports sales and client conversations with confidence, clarity, and practical creative guidance. Helps turn vague requests into clear creative direction. Strengthens creative training and helps raise the skill level of the broader team. Creates or guides polished creative across print, digital, social, video, branding, and multimedia channels. Balances creative excellence with production realities, deadlines, scalability, and business needs. Uses AI and emerging tools to improve speed, quality, exploration, and efficiency without weakening creative standards. Helps identify gaps in intake, workflow, training, quality, and client communication. Builds trust with internal and external customers. Can move between strategy, consultation, training, review, and hands-on execution with ease. Helps designIQ present itself as a serious creative partner, not just a production resource.

Portfolio RequirementsL

Applicants must submit a portfolio that demonstrates: Advanced print and digital advertising work. Branding, logo, or identity system work. Social media and digital campaign creative. Agency-level creative, such as billboards, direct mail, packaging, product design, branded materials, signage, glossy layouts, newsprint layouts, campaign assets, or client presentations. Strong typography, layout, composition, and visual hierarchy. Ability to create finished work from limited direction. Examples of campaign thinking, concept development, or multi-channel creative. Examples of performance-minded creative, audience-focused design, or conversion-driven layout. Video, motion, animation, or multimedia samples preferred. Training, presentation, creative review, or before-and-after examples preferred. AI-assisted creative examples are welcome when the candidate can explain their process, judgment, and role in the final work.

The annualized base salary for this role will be $70 000,00 - $85,000.00.  Variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, location, and union representation, if applicable.

raw.title: Senior Manager, Performance Marketing
raw.excerpt: About CoVet At CoVet, we're building AI-powered tools that help veterinary professionals spend less time on paperwork and more time caring for animals.
raw.description:
About CoVet

At CoVet, we're building AI-powered tools that help veterinary professionals spend less time on paperwork and more time caring for animals.

Veterinary teams are stretched thin. Long hours, administrative burden, and burnout are challenges across the industry. We're on a mission to change that. Our AI copilot helps veterinary professionals save time, improve workflows, and focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional patient care.

We're a globally distributed team united by a shared mission to support veterinary professionals through thoughtful technology. We move quickly, collaborate openly, and believe great ideas can come from anyone.

If you're excited by the opportunity to shape the future of veterinary medicine while working alongside an ambitious and supportive team, we'd love to meet you.

What you'll do

We are hiring a Senior Manager, Performance Marketing to lead acquisition, lifecycle and B2B marketing at CoVet.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role. You will own the full funnel from first click to paying subscriber and beyond, set the testing agenda, and run the daily and weekly operating rhythm against target, taking day-to-day ownership of performance.

You will:

  • own paid acquisition strategy and budget across search, paid social and other channels, by market and by channel
  • hold cost per sign-up and cost per subscription as spend scales, through disciplined testing, creative iteration and channel mix
  • lead lifecycle marketing, so that more sign-ups activate, convert and stay
  • set up and run a structured testing programme across channels, landing pages, onboarding and email
  • build the forecasting and pacing routine that tells the business, daily and weekly, where we stand against target and what we are changing
  • manage, coach and grow a team of five
  • report performance clearly to the head of marketing, with a point of view on what to do next

Cross-functional collaboration

This role will work closely with:

  • Head of Marketing: to set strategy, priorities and budget, and to report against plan
  • Analytics and CRO: to define measurement, attribution and test design, and to act on what the data shows
  • Product Marketing: to improve activation and conversion from sign-up to first use
  • Design: to brief and iterate creative at the volume paid media needs
  • Sales, Enterprise and RevOps: to align on lead definitions, handoffs and pipeline
  • Regional and content teams: to localize campaigns so they work in-market

What success looks like

In this role, success means the paid programme scales several times over without losing efficiency. It means the business always knows where acquisition stands against target and why, and that conversion improves at every stage of the funnel.

You should expect to be measured on sign-ups and subscriptions against target, cost per acquisition, funnel conversion, retention outcomes from lifecycle work, and the strength of the team you build.

Qualifications

We're looking for someone who is:

  • an experienced performance marketing leader, with a track record of scaling paid acquisition budgets several times over while holding efficiency
  • deeply hands-on with paid search and paid social platforms, and able to go into the account themselves
  • strong in funnel analysis, attribution and experimentation, and comfortable with numbers as the basis for decisions
  • experienced in lifecycle and email marketing, and how it lifts conversion and retention
  • a proven people manager who can coach an experienced team and build management depth
  • able to run a clear operating rhythm and communicate performance plainly
  • comfortable with the pace and ambiguity of a fast-growing company

Preferred experience

  • B2B or B2B2C SaaS with a self-serve or product-led motion
  • healthtech, medtech, AI or another regulated or professional audience
  • running acquisition across many markets and languages at once
  • working with enterprise and partner channels alongside self-serve
  • working with BigQuery, HubSpot, Looker Studio or similar tools

Why this role matters

This role turns CoVet's growth ambition into a predictable engine. It gives the marketing team a dedicated leader for acquisition and lifecycle, and gives the business confidence that every dollar of spend is working as hard as it can.

Why Join Us

  • Flexible remote-first work environment
  • Competitive compensation
  • Generous vacation and time-off policies
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth
  • A culture built on trust, collaboration, and impact

Compensation

We believe in paying our team members fairly and competitively. Compensation is determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and local market benchmarks.

As a globally distributed company, salary ranges are localized to reflect the market for comparable roles in a candidate's country or region. We'll discuss compensation expectations and provide transparency around our approach throughout the interview process.

CoVet is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace where everyone can do their best work. If you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We're happy to work with you to ensure an accessible and positive candidate experience.
